authority: Six canonical Markdown volumes own the full requirements and acceptance; this is a derived index, not independent authority.

requirements.title: Preserve one coherent experience and exact source ownership
requirements.text: As a staff member working across Asym, I want document controls to behave coherently while respecting each record's meaning, so that convenient access does not change business truth.

acceptance.text: An embedded file control and File Manager action targeting the same permitted source use produce the same authoritative result and current access decision; neither creates a competing document/status record.

Uploading, renaming, linking, previewing, restoring or moving bytes does not issue a receipt, approve an expense, sign/end an agreement, fulfill a request, publish a page, import rows or start a build unless the independently authorized owning command explicitly performs that effect.
A generic action incompatible with a source is absent or honestly unavailable with permitted recovery; it never falls back to ordinary semantics or a public URL.

Each existing and future consumer has a separately identifiable producer/profile, safe unavailable outcome, owner and qualification evidence. A missing future consumer does not block independent qualified native requests or force a second custody store.

App routes stay thin and shared business mutations remain with the established server/API owner; public CMS content and CRM operational facts retain their separate authorities. Twenty CRM is not restored.

requirements.title: Resolve current native identity, tenant and exact capabilities
requirements.text: As a person using an authorized document task, I want access to follow my actual identity and current purpose, so that I receive exactly the capability intended for me.

acceptance.text: Wrong-tenant, revoked, expired, suspended, wrong-purpose and wrong-subject callers cannot discover or mutate protected material through any role or recipient branch.
A qualified limited recipient can complete their exact task without unrelated enrollment; an existing account retains its independently valid affiliations without gaining new ones.

Changing a submitted tenant/actor/approval field cannot move an operation into another scope or forge attribution; a supported selector resolves to the same current trusted context through application and database.
A non-human identity uses its own qualified single-Tenant grants and live owner ceiling; queued work cannot freeze a departed human's authority or use ambient service-role power.

Protected-action admission, final mutation/dispatch and result disclosure re-evaluate the current dependencies required by their owners after waits. Missing native identity/context fails safely without a profile-role or demo fallback.
A view-as or relationship display helper cannot mutate source state or widen file disclosure. Operators use the actual audited, purpose-bound, time-boxed source path.

requirements.title: Enforce database integrity and authorization through every door
requirements.text: As a tenant administrator, I want database and alternate access paths to enforce the same boundaries as the interface, so that a valid account cannot bypass document rules.
requirements.basis: Founder §§11/14/16/19; Q21/Q41/Q52/Q60 database clauses; Q61-C14; Q63-C16; Q66 database and context clauses; Q67-C13.

acceptance.text: Real database roles cannot insert or update a permitted row into another tenant/source/subject, spoof an acceptance or approval, clear independent restrictions or replace an immutable byte identity.
SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, RETURNING, UPSERT, MERGE and trigger-adjusted rows preserve actual authorization; a zero-row result is not reported as successful business acceptance.
Views/materializations, REST/GraphQL/RPC, Storage, import/worker/operator paths and legacy scripts cannot bypass the same restrictions. Unsafe doors are removed or narrowly denied before activation.

Tests exercise actual named/default/inherited/PUBLIC grants, function ownership/search paths and owner/FORCE/BYPASS/invoker/definer/service combinations, rather than asserting safety from keywords alone.
Reused connections after commit, rollback, cancellation and retry do not retain another principal's tenant or security context; missing or mismatched context fails closed.

Deleting or retiring a person, source record or policy cannot cascade away still-required history, controls, uses or copy evidence. Authorized lawful retention/redaction is a separate owning operation.

requirements.title: Protect every disclosure and invalidate stale access
requirements.text: As a person whose documents may contain sensitive information, I want every representation and discovery path to respect current access, so that hiding a screen does not leave another leak.
requirements.basis: Founder §§8/11/12/16/19; Q04/Q05/Q38/Q41/Q44/Q54/Q58/Q59; Q63-C15; Q66-C18; Q67-C14; source field projection contracts.

acceptance.text: A forbidden object cannot be inferred from names, duplicate warnings, counts, sort order, error shape, stale cache, hidden fields or authorized use of a related record.
Full, range, conditional, original, thumbnail and derivative reads independently enforce the relevant current authority; a prior successful request does not open unlimited later access.
Source-safe unavailable errors and protected operator explanations disclose only what each actual viewer may receive. Broadening access to explain a denial is forbidden.
Account/Tenant/purpose switching or revocation prevents old requests, cached selections and asynchronous results from appearing in the new context or silently retargeting accepted work.

Short expiry, disabled Download, watermarks or hidden UI are not represented as immediate revocation or prevention of copying. Revocation blocks future authorized delivery without claiming recall of bytes already received.
Private evidence/body/token/URL data does not enter analytics, general traces, search indexes or external processing without its separately qualified purpose and egress rules.

requirements.title: Bind retries to complete business intent and recover original results
requirements.text: As a user recovering from a slow or lost response, I want Asym to recover the action I already submitted, so that retrying cannot create duplicate work or undo a later change.

acceptance.text: Duplicate same-intent submissions return the one attributable original result and do not create additional versions, acceptances, access issuances, reminders, publications or physical effects.
Changed scope, evidence, requested action or relevant expected basis under a reused key cannot be silently applied or described as the original action.
A replay of an old success after correction, withdrawal, retraction, expiry or Stop does not revive applicability or effects; current state is separately projected under present disclosure.
A lost response, navigation, browser abort or closed dialog is not proof of rollback. Recovery precedes new-key, reduced-selection or successor-basis work.
Legitimately repeated events or new review on unchanged bytes are not permanently blocked by an inadequate subject-plus-digest/date key; source-defined occurrence/basis determines equivalence.
Old commands after cleanup, restore or deployment cannot become fresh business intent because their prior bookkeeping is unavailable.

requirements.title: Commit authoritative effects coherently and preserve safety before background work
requirements.text: As a staff member acting on a document, I want accepted actions and their required history and controls to agree, so that partial infrastructure failure cannot leave misleading or unsafe state.
requirements.basis: Founder §§9/10/14/16/19; Q21/Q22/Q49/Q52/Q60/Q62/Q63/Q65/Q66/Q67 transaction, fencing and follow-through clauses.

acceptance.text: Fault injection before authoritative commitment yields no partial new source facts; after commitment, original outcomes/history and necessary fences remain recoverable even if refresh or follow-through fails.
New selected Q52 acceptances commit together or none do; independently existing exact acceptances keep their original attribution. No hidden partial batch is represented as an all-or-none command.

Both race orders are tested for acceptance/correction/withdrawal, fulfillment/replacement, access issuance/expiry and use/hold/promotion/disposition. The winning source boundary controls subsequent admissibility.
A pending protective policy/correction impact cannot leave a stale permissive disposer or serving path eligible while only a UI badge is updated.
External IO is not held inside a long database transaction to claim distributed atomicity. Partial/unknown physical outcomes remain exact and do not undo true source history.

requirements.title: Preserve source clocks, date precision and boundary conditions
requirements.text: As a user working across time zones, I want deadlines and event dates to mean what the source says, so that display settings or retries do not change my allowed work.

acceptance.text: Tests cover the exact inclusive/exclusive deadline boundary, late operation arrival, delayed responses and both orderings against fulfillment or expiry; the server's actual source rule decides.
Changing Requested by, review date, locale, timezone display or a storage provider does not extend access, restart retention or create a new business event.
Date-only, leap/calendar boundary, offset/day crossing, ambiguous/nonexistent local time and late occurrence cases retain the declared meaning or produce a specific safe correction path.
Missing/unknown/not-yet and legitimately continuing/review-based treatment remain distinct; no convenient today/midnight/zero/forever default fills missing authority.
Queued or resumed work rechecks actual admission/permit validity after waits; expiry never proves an already possible external effect stopped.

requirements.title: Preserve immutable history and separately govern current applicability
requirements.text: As an authorized reviewer or records operator, I want to see what actually happened and what is currently applicable, so that correction is possible without rewriting history.

acceptance.text: Correcting an acceptance, policy assignment, external recording or resource publication preserves the original fact and shows the source-qualified current outcome without changing historical fulfillment/access.
Equal content bytes do not establish equal provenance, rights, consent, authority or business significance; source-specific evidence and uses remain independently represented.
Mutable presentation/current-head data cannot become approval or immutable history authority, and a new version cannot inherit an older version's acceptance automatically.
Lawful anonymization/erasure does not orphan required references, forge attribution or re-enable stale commands; retaining minimal control evidence does not retain unnecessary sensitive content.
Original-copy fidelity follows its source: stricter required discard/sanitization rules are preserved for specialized public media rather than overwritten by a universal retain-original policy.

requirements.title: Reuse exact communication, task and workflow effects
requirements.text: As a recipient or staff reviewer, I want notices and work cues to reflect real actionable changes, so that document work does not produce duplicate or misleading messages.
requirements.basis: Founder §§3/10/16; Q20/Q24–Q27/Q30–Q32/Q35/Q40/Q48/Q51/Q52/Q60; Q64; Q67-C10; Phase 6/17 and Workflow owners.

acceptance.text: Duplicate callbacks, overlapping staff/workflow actions and repeated jobs cannot send or create the same business effect twice or broaden its audience.
Correction/review/attention does not manufacture a Q27/Q40 producer; each actual notice has the exact selected source cause and only permitted payload fields.

Q48 stops/counts/settings and already possible sends survive correction and recovery; the Q60 corrective lane cannot escape its automatic-reminder exclusion through clone, unlink, new key or default inheritance.
Late historical event recording can update explicitly qualified current records duties without replaying old communications, enrollment, access or collection.
Source acceptance, message preparation, provider acceptance/delivery and human reading remain distinguishable; a failed notification never silently reverses an accepted business fact.

requirements.title: Give truthful failure states and capable recovery
requirements.text: As a user whose document action encounters a problem, I want a clear status and a real next step, so that I can recover without guessing whether to repeat the action.

acceptance.text: Known committed success survives a failed refresh; unknown commitment is not reported as failure with an invitation to create another intent.
Closing or navigating away from a submitted form does not promise cancellation. The actor can recover the permitted original outcome through the actual source route.
Wrong-target containment or retraction remains usable under its own current authority even when unrelated replacement preparation is invalid or unavailable.
A failed independent module leaves other safe source work usable; missing material authority blocks the affected consequential action without a permissive fallback.
Operator reassignment after departure preserves actual attribution and required control state; it does not impersonate the former actor or require their account to remain active.

requirements.title: Deliver accessible, consistent and efficient task interfaces
requirements.text: As a staff member, recipient or resource reader, I want usable document controls across devices and assistive technologies, so that I can finish my task with clear feedback and few reasonable steps.
requirements.basis: Founder §§1/6/8–12/16/19; Q61-C12; Q63-C14; Q66-C17; Q67-C06/C15; all source-specific UX decisions.

acceptance.text: Complete tasks are usable by keyboard, non-drag pointer, touch and assistive technology, with visible unobscured focus, meaningful labels, predictable focus restoration and no hover/color-only essential information.
Ordinary vertical content reflows at 320 CSS pixels and supported zoom; long/international names, RTL/localized text and source dates remain understandable without changing identity or authority.

Upload and processing status persists where needed; meaningful changes are announced without focus theft or noisy announcements on every progress refresh. Errors identify the affected input and actual repair.
Drag reorder/move/upload has a fully functional non-drag alternative. Historical date entry is not calendar-only. Focused Enter/Space works while IME, selection/blur, GET and prefetch remain inert.
File icons/avatars/badges communicate presentation only; adjacent readable text and actual composed contrast are tested, including known component variants that need adaptation.
Weak connections, repeated submission and sign-in/context recovery preserve safe work without silent restricted offline queues or a fabricated success state.

Real staff/recipient/missionary pilot evidence includes task completion, understood state, correction and practical interaction/time measurements. Automated axe or a library's accessibility claim alone does not establish conformance.

requirements.title: Treat files and extracted material as hostile until qualified
requirements.text: As a reviewer opening submitted material, I want processing to respect the source's safety and fidelity rules, so that a useful preview does not execute hostile content or misrepresent evidence.
requirements.basis: Founder §§5/9/11/13/19; Q02/Q04/Q29/Q53/Q56; Q61-C05/C11; Phase 26 D32 and public-media owners.

acceptance.text: Hostile, unsupported, encrypted, oversized, malformed and interrupted inputs get source-specific bounded outcomes without public promotion, unsafe parsing or false business acceptance.
Scanner/converter outage or unknown safety evidence cannot become safe-by-timeout; independent lawful reading paths remain only where the source explicitly permits them.
Preview failure does not auto-download, open an external office viewer or share a private URL. Source-required inspection has a sufficient authorized alternative or remains blocked.
Late processor output, source revocation and cleanup/promotion races have a single qualified winner; stale cleanup cannot remove accepted output and deletion-claimed bytes cannot become Ready.
Extraction/AI output has explicit egress, language/coverage, retention and correction qualification and cannot become financial/legal evidence truth or broaden a search corpus by default.

requirements.title: Bound workload and preserve tenant fairness
requirements.text: As a tenant staff member, I want large uploads and background jobs to remain predictable, so that another workload cannot starve my document task or weaken security.
requirements.basis: Founder §§15/19; Q38/Q44/Q48/Q52/Q56/Q61; Q63/Q66/Q67 finite-profile clauses; exact Phase 12 R6, Phase 23 and D32 budgets.

acceptance.text: Published capability profiles have measured finite values and supported workload/environment evidence; undefined bounds make the affected profile unavailable rather than silently unlimited.
Current authorization/projection is stable, unique and setwise per page/chunk; restricted rows do not leak through pagination, counts, timing or changing visible selection.
Large files, assembly/export/scan jobs and a large individual tenant cannot starve independent requests or receipts beyond the qualified fairness/recovery bounds.
Saturation, quota pressure and dependency outage remain visible and bounded; no fallback makes a private file public or omits required checks.
Performance proof tests actual supported maximum/boundary inputs, concurrency and tenant skew, with rejection and recovery beyond the bound; numerical claims are tied to measured evidence.

requirements.title: Provide durable business evidence and accountable operations
requirements.text: As a records or service operator, I want failures and history to identify what happened and who can resolve it, so that normal recovery does not require developer access to production data.

acceptance.text: Operators can diagnose stuck intake, processing failure, integrity mismatch, stale use coverage, unknown copies, pending disposition and restore/exit failure using safe correlation and actual outcomes.
Every required unresolved operation has a capable accountable owner and recorded finite response/recovery boundary; missing owner or exceeded deadline produces an actionable escalation.

At least one confirmed authorization, attribution, duplicate-effect, missing-control or unauthorized historical-effect violation triggers scoped containment and reconciliation, preserving true evidence before requalification.
Access audit reports actual authorization/transport observations and does not claim reading, signing, receipt acceptance or external-copy deletion without its owning evidence.
Logs/audits/history themselves obey their classification, current access and lawful retention; high-cardinality sensitive filenames or identities are not metric labels.

requirements.title: Migrate actual retained data and block incompatible old writers
requirements.text: As a tenant relying on existing documents, I want migration to preserve usable evidence and its restrictions, so that a new File Manager does not discard or expose my files.
requirements.basis: Founder §§4/16/19; Q61-C08/C16 and R-LEGACY; Q63 migration/restore; Q66-C20; Q67-C17; current source cutover contracts.

acceptance.text: The actual environment census classifies every reached file family and states supported mapping, unqualified lane, retained obligations and repair owner; unknown data is not labeled zero or disposable.
Old-code/new-schema, new-code/old-schema, unknown semantic version, renamed identity and stale-worker cases deny unsupported effects while preserving lawful reads/original-result recovery.
A source or custody cutover preserves byte digests, references, lineage, current policy/holds and exact access behavior before obsolete paths are retired.
Feature disable stops new affected admissions while preserving accepted facts, current protective controls and capable correction/reconciliation; rollback cannot revive unsafe old writers or shares.
A failed mapping or control recovery blocks the affected cohort and is actionable; it does not require all unrelated future phases or silently remove a promised source outcome.

requirements.title: Qualify physical custody, recovery and provider exit
requirements.text: As a records owner, I want preservation, disposal and recovery claims to be proved against actual copies, so that database metadata cannot falsely stand in for the document.
requirements.basis: Founder §§5/14/15/19; Q61 R-CUSTODY/R-RESTORE; Q63-C06–C12; Q65 continuing use; Q66-C15; Q67-C11.

acceptance.text: Representative actual bytes plus metadata/manifests/references recover within the approved source RPO/RTO, with verified integrity and required key/configuration access; a three-row database smoke is not this proof.
Revocation/disposition/withdrawal history and current controls are applied before restored content can be served, linked, promoted or publicly released.

Every required copy has qualified verified removal/absence, failure or unknown status. A metadata delete, UI absence, generic404, delete marker or envelope success cannot falsely complete disposition.

Expired lease/permit/worker generation does not clear a possible earlier provider effect. Every fresh destructive submission requalifies against current policy/holds/Stop; evidence-only reconciliation remains independently possible.
Provider exit preserves identities, exact versions, rights, references and obligations; destination verification and closed coverage precede any separately authorized source removal.
No prototype, sandbox adapter or vendor documentation alone counts as qualified hosted/copy behavior; missing physical proof blocks affected activation.

requirements.title: Prove outcomes at the confirmed highest practical seams
requirements.text: As an implementation reviewer, I want tests to prove observable document outcomes and real safety boundaries, so that passing helper mocks cannot disguise a broken user journey.
requirements.basis: Founder §19; Q61 proof register; Q62–Q67 proof groups; explicit 2026-10-29 testing-seam confirmation under /to-spec.

acceptance.text: Tests cover happy/negative/boundary outcomes, all ratified recovery routes, duplicate/changed intent, both relevant race orders, migration and constrained workloads at the actual source boundary.
A real two-tenant/role matrix tests all alternate doors, grants/context mutation, authenticated limited recipients, revocation and current disclosure; service-role-only tests do not pass this gate.

At minimum, one private request-to-review-to-authorized-share journey and one public asset-to-placement-to-withdrawal journey complete with real source state and actual required bytes, then the other source-specific acceptance groups pass.

Browser tests use stable accessible roles/text and real state polling, not sleeps, fixture-only successes or network-aborted simulations as end-to-end proof. Manual keyboard/AT and intended-user tasks supplement automated accessibility checks.
Missing mandatory fixture, unavailable provider or skipped protected path produces explicit unqualified/blocked evidence; it never silently turns the release suite green for that capability.

Source/decision, document-generation, model/unit, native integration, hosted/provider and actual user evidence are reported separately with exact scope/version/environment and retained failure/recovery results.

requirements.title: Keep prerequisites precise and the complete contract traceable
requirements.text: As an AI coding agent implementing Phase 29, I want exact requirements, acceptance and predecessor boundaries, so that I can build the approved behavior without inventing missing authority or overlooking a consumer.
requirements.basis: Founder §§3/16/19; Q61-C01/C13–C16; Q64 reference; Q66-C22; Q67-C18–C19; explicit /to-spec authorization.

acceptance.text: Every ratified decision/main normative paragraph and incorporated proof obligation maps to specific requirements/acceptance or an explicitly justified historical/stage-only/superseded disposition; unmatched requirements fail documentation verification.

Each of the 23 existing and 11 future consumer rows is mapped separately with exact producer, owner, scope/gate and safe repair. No invented issue ID or closed-title inference substitutes for actual source evidence.
Defined tenant-configurable values remain configurable; missing operative GF/tenant values are not guessed, shipped as universal rules or used to block unrelated fully specified capability work.

The specification can be followed from numbered user story to exact contract, acceptance, source decision, design and prerequisite task; later implementation tickets/tests/release evidence use the same stable IDs.

Current/archived source bodies remain distinct, generators are deterministic and check-only mode detects drift, and the final published tracker artifacts are read back and compared with the reviewed package.

No feature implementation, actual policy/event/disposal, hosted-data change, real-user outreach or separate implementation-ticket graph is performed by specification publication. All runtime acceptance checklist items remain unchecked until actual evidence exists.

requirements.title: Confirm recipients for external private document requests
requirements.text: As an intended recipient, I want to confirm access to one private document request without unnecessary enrollment, so that I can respond without exposing it to someone who only has its link.
requirements.basis: Q01, complete incorporated source clauses and current explicit later refinements; REQ29-P01–P18. Exact paragraph, clause, proof and journey locators are mapped individually.

acceptance.text: An intended recipient who has no donor, missionary, staff, organization membership or Party completes the exact qualified request-confirmation route without acquiring any of those affiliations.
Possession of an invitation, a forwarded/scanned link, an equal email string, an email-verified flag or unrelated sign-in exposes no protected request and admits no document action.

Current confirmation proof is reused only for its qualified principal, mailbox revision, request, purpose and freshness; any mismatch or stronger source requirement produces the actual qualified confirmation/assurance route.

An initial GET, HEAD, prefetch or scanner visit neither discloses protected metadata nor grants authority. Deliberate entry and proof preserve the frozen qualified mailbox/host and cannot be redirected by caller input.

Expiry, revocation or supersession prevents newly affected participant operations, including late finalization and result disclosure, while independently authorized admitted processing/review/retention can continue without renewing participant access.

Shared-mailbox and representation cases retain truthful limited mailbox-control evidence; the result never claims legal identity, exclusive human identity, signing authority, authenticity or business acceptance.

requirements.title: Files for Asym work and exact submitted-file readback
requirements.text: As a person supplying requested material, I want to see truthful receipt and safely read my exact received file, so that I can check what was supplied without unrelated access.
requirements.basis: Q02, complete incorporated source clauses and current explicit later refinements; REQ29-P01–P18. Exact paragraph, clause, proof and journey locators are mapped individually.

acceptance.text: An admitted upload has an actual source owner and purpose, including eligible draft, resource, generation, import, hold or recovery work; no fake live placement or ceremonial business record is required solely to admit lawful bytes.
After durable source receipt, the intended participant sees the exact received submission and current technical/source status; upload, preview readiness and staff acceptance remain distinguishable.
View my submitted file resolves only the permitted received occurrence/version and qualified rendition. A same-email account, another source use or the file digest cannot grant the reader more scope.

Unsupported, unsafe, encrypted, oversized, incomplete or unavailable preview has an honest source-safe result and capable alternative only where separately permitted; it never opens a public URL or external viewer.

The representation identifies meaningful coverage/fidelity limits and preserves the required native text, semantics and exact values; a source-required inspection cannot succeed using an insufficient rendition.

Two independent uses of equal bytes keep different rights, currentness, provenance and retention. Contextual entry selects only actual admitted destinations and never creates an ownerless general drive.

requirements.title: Recipient corrections with exact review lineage
requirements.text: As an intended recipient, I want to correct the exact pending submission while preserving its history, so that staff review the right evidence without losing the earlier receipt.
requirements.basis: Q03, complete incorporated source clauses and current explicit later refinements; REQ29-P01–P18. Exact paragraph, clause, proof and journey locators are mapped individually.

acceptance.text: Only the exact current eligible unaccepted submission/item can be corrected; request-open or preview access alone cannot override freeze, closure, deadline, recipient or source restrictions.

Local selection and transfer leave the current review set unchanged. Qualified authoritative correction admission records the immutable successor and immediately fences its predecessor from current acceptance, preserving other supporting files.
Correction-first rejects stale predecessor acceptance; acceptance-first rejects an ineligible correction. A stale command never retargets the new version or silently widens its evidence set.

A received successor that fails checks stays truthfully received/blocked and never automatically restores the predecessor. A checker outage recovers the same attempt where possible without needless reupload.

A repeated correction intent returns the original source outcome without another version or effect; a genuine later correction has its own qualified lineage and cannot be merged solely by equal names or bytes.

The recipient has one contextual Send corrected file action with exact target/selection and persistent progress/result. Staff reading an older version receive an in-context change warning without silent content replacement or focus theft.
A Q56 assembly correction admits only the complete qualified unit; raw page staging cannot fence the predecessor. Q60 current applicability changes preserve the earlier acceptance history.

requirements.title: Submitted-original download under current source authority
requirements.text: As an intended recipient, I want to deliberately download my permitted exact Submitted Original, so that I can retain the received file without confusing a preview with the original.
requirements.basis: Q04, complete incorporated source clauses and current explicit later refinements; REQ29-P01–P18. Exact paragraph, clause, proof and journey locators are mapped individually.

acceptance.text: Download submitted file returns the unchanged exact Submitted Original only when whole-original disclosure is independently permitted; preview approval or staff acceptance alone is insufficient.

Every full/range/conditional/new recovery read rechecks current source authority and the exact immutable copy; expiry and revocation obey the source streaming boundary without a public or reusable unqualified URL fallback.
Browser-managed attachment delivery uses safe source-qualified naming and type handling without renaming source bytes or confusing an assembled output with its protected input originals.
An interrupted transfer remains a truthful partial/unknown local outcome; neither click nor completed server stream is reported as browser saving, human reading or business acceptance.
Download does not extend access/retention, grant other-person or historical bytes, or create sharing/export authority. Separately qualified source uses retain their own routes.
An authorized user completes or safely retries the download using keyboard/mobile/assistive technology without a routine reason form, forced preview or extra confirmation.

requirements.title: Current files and a concise participant submission history
requirements.text: As an intended recipient, I want to see current submissions and concise permitted history, so that I understand what changed and what action remains.
requirements.basis: Q05, complete incorporated source clauses and current explicit later refinements; REQ29-P01–P18. Exact paragraph, clause, proof and journey locators are mapped individually.

acceptance.text: Current supporting files remain independent; only the exact corrected predecessor becomes superseded, and it is not silently restored when a successor fails.
The participant sees concise permitted source history with truthful receipt/correction state, without internal audit, another recipient or a prior-version byte archive.
Superseded-content restrictions hold for original, preview, thumbnail, extraction, search and export; hiding a current-list button is not the only enforcement.
A failed history/status read is shown as unavailable or unknown rather than no submission, and independently known receipt/success remains visible where permitted.
Historical help produces an actual source-authorized explanation or next action without an automatic old-file release, restored grant, new account or retention extension.
Long histories use current-authorized bounded navigation and preserve relevant focus/state without leaking denied existence through ordering or counts.

requirements.title: Bounded read-only access after normal request fulfillment
requirements.text: As an intended recipient, I want to return to the completed request while read access remains valid, so that I can understand its outcome without reopening collection.
requirements.basis: Q06, complete incorporated source clauses and current explicit later refinements; REQ29-P01–P18. Exact paragraph, clause, proof and journey locators are mapped individually.

acceptance.text: Only actual durable source fulfillment can establish completed-request meaning; upload, scan, task completion and a cached badge cannot do so.
Completed recipient access is business read-only for the admitted scope. Qualified technical rendition/delivery recovery and audit can continue without reopening intake.
Protected completed reading is unavailable until its finite source end and historical recipient eligibility are established; unknown policy is not an indefinite or default grant.
Independent staff/source work can finish after recipient access ends while preserving the original outcome; it neither renews recipient access nor discloses protected status without current rights.
The same request context distinguishes completed, expired, restricted, temporarily unavailable and unknown states and supplies its actual source help route.
Access ending does not dispose retained evidence, release a hold or recall delivered copies; exact original/preview qualification and superseded-content restrictions remain.

requirements.title: Fixed source-owned completed-request access end
requirements.text: As an intended recipient, I want to see a trustworthy fixed completed-access deadline, so that reading and delayed messages do not silently change my time.
requirements.basis: Q07, complete incorporated source clauses and current explicit later refinements; REQ29-P01–P18. Exact paragraph, clause, proof and journey locators are mapped individually.

acceptance.text: Eligible source fulfillment fixes the original completed end from that occurrence and its qualified policy, at most720 elapsed hours and actual applicable earlier limits; first reading and delayed delivery cannot restart it.
At the exclusive end, newly affected protected operations are denied even when cleanup is delayed, the browser clock is wrong or an old session still exists.
A genuine applicable adverse shortening remains binding; removing or relaxing its cause does not revive the formerly longer admission.
A delayed consumer can recover only the historical transition/end actually earned at fulfillment, then applies current rights; it cannot manufacture recipient admission from current facts.
Missing optional completed-read readiness does not prevent independently valid source fulfillment; the recipient view remains unavailable until its own historical/current proof is established.
Localized dates/timezones show the actual effective end with sufficient precision; display choices, help, opening or download do not change the authoritative instant.

requirements.title: Source-authorized fresh completed-request access
requirements.text: As an authorized source staff member, I want to grant separately reviewed fresh completed reading, so that a legitimate recipient can return without reviving old rights.
requirements.basis: Q08, complete incorporated source clauses and current explicit later refinements; REQ29-P01–P18. Exact paragraph, clause, proof and journey locators are mapped individually.

acceptance.text: Fresh completed reading requires a lawful Q16 completed-view root and the relevant eligible ordinary expiry/current lineage. Security revocation, binding shortening, disposed material or a generic Expired badge cannot bypass that proof.

The fresh reviewed member/version/action scope is bounded by the original completed-view ceiling and current eligibility; never-viewed admitted members remain eligible without download telemetry, while later unrelated files, other recipients and superseded bytes do not enter.

One deliberate source-qualified Grant read access applies Q17–Q19 terms and current issuer/recipient restrictions, including exact expected basis after waits; no arbitrary recipient or date is accepted.
A matching lost-response retry recovers the original grant/end before considering new work. Changed material conflicts, and closing the form cannot promise the original command was canceled.
The recipient returns through current Q01 proof into the same bounded completed read-only context; proof, representation, grant and optional Q20 notice failures remain separate recoverable states.
Fresh access changes neither original fulfillment/history nor retention, membership, intake or resharing authority, and it cannot automatically renew itself.

requirements.title: Requested-by targets preserve otherwise-authorized intake
requirements.text: As a recipient or reviewer, I want to understand Requested by separately from access and receipt, so that coordination dates do not fabricate rejection or completion.
requirements.basis: Q09, complete incorporated source clauses and current explicit later refinements; REQ29-P01–P18. Exact paragraph, clause, proof and journey locators are mapped individually.

acceptance.text: Passing Requested by alone neither closes otherwise authorized intake nor grants access, rejects evidence or fulfills the request; the actual hard source access boundary still applies.
Durable receipt uses trusted source admission time and immutable target-applicability evidence. For an instant target, receipt strictly after it is late and equality is not late.
Timely material awaiting technical checks or staff review is not shown as recipient-overdue merely because fulfillment is still pending.

requirements.basis: Q32, complete incorporated source clauses and current explicit later refinements; REQ29-P01–P18. Exact paragraph, clause, proof and journey locators are mapped individually.

acceptance.text: Only a genuinely new durably admitted participant clarification produces this optional staff-awareness occurrence; drafts, staff replies, file events, reads and assignment changes cannot impersonate it.

The source’s qualified clarification-handling route resolves staff recipients; it is not automatically the document reviewer, creator, last author or generic team. Existing explicit narrower authority is preserved.

The original policy/resolver/binding and enabled-cohort basis are recorded at the source occurrence. Off/unknown/zero remain distinct, and current settings cannot fabricate an old audience during recovery.
Participant receipt/history/required handling remain complete without mail. A lost handoff recovers its original basis without a duplicate message, new unread state or dropped obligation.
Published Off stops affected unsubmitted work at actual P6 admission; later On, member remove/readd or identifier recreation cannot broaden or revive original membership.

Participant expiry or fulfillment alone neither grants nor universally stops independently useful staff notice/handling. Current utility/privacy controls prevent stale demands without copying a fresh participant grant.

Minimal staff content and doorway disclose no participant body/excerpt, filenames, private labels or attachments. Participant UI never exposes internal recipient addresses/settings/provider diagnostics or requires message repetition.

requirements.title: Source-owned No longer required for ordinary requested items
requirements.text: As an authorized source staff member, I want to remove an actual mistaken or no-longer-applicable ordinary demand, so that the recipient need not satisfy work the source no longer needs.
requirements.basis: Q33, complete incorporated source clauses and current explicit later refinements; REQ29-P01–P18. Exact paragraph, clause, proof and journey locators are mapped individually.

acceptance.text: Only an outstanding not-currently-accepted ordinary item that was mistaken or is no longer applicable can be deliberately marked No longer required; requirement-change authority is distinct from review or grant administration.

The decision preserves earlier evidence/receipt/history and independent duties while stopping the ended ordinary demand. It does not unaccept, delete, cancel the whole request or waive another source obligation.

Both orders against acceptance, correction, instruction/clarification changes and closure preserve one current source result; a stale human decision must review affected new facts rather than silently rebase.
Q22 reevaluates the complete current predicate after removal. A last lawful removal may fulfill, but a failed/filtered/merely zero-item read cannot prove completion.

An eligible unfinished mistaken removal can be superseded by a fresh source decision with current authority and a usable route; terminal work stays historical and uses its actual remedy, not generic Undo.

The participant sees No longer required distinctly from Accepted and Changes requested, with safe next work; obsolete demand-only guidance cannot remain a hidden blocker and no new email/reminder occurrence is fabricated.

requirements.title: Source-owned cancellation of unfinished ordinary requests
requirements.text: As an authorized source staff member, I want to cancel an eligible issued request whose purpose ended or was mistaken, so that further collection stops while evidence and history remain truthful.
requirements.basis: Q34, complete incorporated source clauses and current explicit later refinements; REQ29-P01–P18. Exact paragraph, clause, proof and journey locators are mapped individually.

acceptance.text: Current authorized staff can cancel an issued eligible unfinished ordinary request because it was issued in error or its legitimate purpose ended; difficult evidence alone does not cancel a still-binding obligation.

Fulfillment-first rejects ordinary cancellation; cancellation-first prevents later fulfillment. Queued reevaluation or a final review click is not durable F, and the actual source instant is not backdated.

Cancellation immediately fences new affected intake, corrections, ordinary review/item changes and clarification while preserving received/accepted facts and independent safety/retention/source duties.

Only a then-current independently valid finite unfinished participant admission may narrow to Canceled plus safe help, with its same end/caps and current proof. No old admission means no new canceled-status grant, file access or timer.

Canceled remains terminal. A mistake gets an attributed source remedy and, where genuinely needed, a separately authorized new request; Q49 different-person and Q60 same-person pathways are not interchangeable.

Original cancellation survives mail/projection failure, and replay cannot recancel, reopen or issue a replacement. Q35 notice is separately qualified; other notices follow their own current purpose rather than a blanket all-mail stop.

requirements.title: Tenant-controlled participant cancellation notices
requirements.text: As an authorized source staff member, I want to include or decline the qualified cancellation email, so that the recipient can understand cancellation without sensitive internal reasons.
requirements.basis: Q35, complete incorporated source clauses and current explicit later refinements; REQ29-P01–P18. Exact paragraph, clause, proof and journey locators are mapped individually.

acceptance.text: Only one genuinely new committed Q34 cancellation produces its optional awareness purpose. Draft, expiry, fulfillment, item removal, retry and unknown/failed cancellation cannot produce it.

The qualified system starts Enabled with staff choice On; authorized tenant publication can disable the purpose or choose its future-review initial On/Off seed. Staff may decline but cannot override Disabled or retarget Who/How.

Cancellation-only remains lawful when optional mail is unavailable. A selected original handoff recovers only its original policy/recipient facts; inability to prove them yields truthful blocked/no-send rather than later-On catch-up or invented zero.

The complete bounded P6 release, including zero only under proved top-level Live authority, retains exact immutable occurrence, plan, choice and members; retries cannot append recipients or create another cancellation.

Published Disable before provider admission stops affected pending work and later Enable does not revive it. Already possibly submitted effects remain factual, with no recall or sealed-content rewrite.

A known-wrong former address is never notified. A formerly legitimate recipient may receive a currently useful factual notice under independent contact/disclosure authority even without Q34 web access, using only a qualified optional return if any.

Only safe stable request identification and finite source-qualified material/utility are used; no private reason, filename, text, location or attachment. Recent copy and no-Party incompatibility remain independent of valid cancellation/email.

requirements.title: Source-owned ordinary item additions
requirements.text: As an authorized source staff member, I want to publish a genuinely needed new item with a capable lawful route, so that continuing work can evolve without resetting history or access.
requirements.basis: Q36, complete incorporated source clauses and current explicit later refinements; REQ29-P01–P18. Exact paragraph, clause, proof and journey locators are mapped individually.

acceptance.text: Authorized staff may add a genuinely needed ordinary item to the same continuing purpose/recipient of an eligible issued unfinished request, creating a distinct item identity without rewriting earlier items, evidence or decisions.
Participant-required new work is published only with a capable currently qualified route/scope and actual finite access; an uncommitted promise of a later grant is not usable publication.
Independently lawful staff-only satisfaction can proceed where the source permits it without manufacturing recipient action or forcing recipient access as a universal prerequisite.

Actual review coverage qualifies the new work, with existing sufficient responsibility reused. New publication and Q22/Q34 terminal ordering preserve unaffected work and fence only materially affected stale operations.
The added item does not reset requested-by/access clocks, copy old acceptance or impose a hidden hold. Eligible completed-view formation carries only the explicitly admitted amended scope.

An eligible outstanding mistake uses Q33; accepted/terminal mistakes use Q60’s actual attributed remedy. The UI shows added work, route, next actor and possible completion consequence without a redundant approval or forced reupload.
Q40 alone supplies the separately qualified optional update notice. Item addition cannot impersonate review/submission/clarification mail, create automatic reminders or add another channel.

requirements.title: Versioned ordinary item instructions
requirements.text: As an authorized source staff member, I want to publish revised instructions with explicit consequences, so that recipients and reviewers understand what applies without fabricated resubmission.
requirements.basis: Q37, complete incorporated source clauses and current explicit later refinements; REQ29-P01–P18. Exact paragraph, clause, proof and journey locators are mapped individually.

acceptance.text: Authorized staff may publish a material prospective instruction revision only for the same continuing ordinary item/need while its current source eligibility holds; an inert draft or full semantic no-op creates no publication effect.

Original published instructions, each receipt’s submitted-under basis, current instruction head and later review decisions remain distinct; existing bytes stay received and no new submission/acceptance is fabricated.

The publication establishes a usable current handling route and review coverage, including explicit participant scope successor or separately qualified fresh access where required; hidden inaccessible demands are not published as usable work.

Publication-first fences materially affected stale decisions; acceptance/removal/freeze/closure-first denies an ineligible revision. Receipt-first evidence keeps its original basis, while unadmitted transfers are revalidated without silent retargeting.

Current review evaluates real concerns against the revised criterion: independently binding concerns remain, obsolete criterion-only concerns do not become hidden blockers, and an actual human resolution remains deliberate.

Correction of mistaken instructions is a fresh qualified revision; current eligibility does not mean never historically accepted, and Q60 remains separate. No target/access clock or historical lateness is rewritten.

The recipient sees clear current instructions/update time plus relevant progress and submitted-under context. Q40 optional notice requires its own source/contact authority; no read receipt, reply, second approval or automatic awareness claim is imposed.

requirements.title: Prepare a linked request for a different person
requirements.text: As an authorized source staff member, I want to prepare and issue a linked replacement for the actual different recipient, so that continuing work moves safely without copied grants or repeated unaffected evidence.
requirements.basis: Q49, complete incorporated source clauses and current explicit later refinements; REQ29-P01–P18. Exact paragraph, clause, proof and journey locators are mapped individually.

acceptance.text: One eligible predecessor has at most one active source-owned replacement preparation. Repeated Start resumes it; discarded/ended preparation and a genuine later permitted need retain source history rather than creating parallel drafts.

Only currently permitted ordinary item definitions are reused into new independently editable identities; evidence, answers, comments, acceptance, grants, proofs, recipients, clock ends and notice plans are never cloned.

The preparation stays in the exact source/Tenant/environment and continuing legitimate purpose for a different intended person; the new recipient’s actual identity/assurance/readiness is proved rather than guessed from email.
Only genuinely remaining work is proposed. Old acceptance neither automatically satisfies the new person nor forces unaffected recollection; required personal material remains legitimately distinct.
Current authority separately governs prepare/edit/reuse/responsibility/cancel/issue. A saved draft, creator status or repair of readiness never becomes a standing auto-issue subscription.

requirements.title: Commit a linked replacement handoff
requirements.text: As an authorized source staff member, I want to commit a qualified linked replacement handoff once, so that the right new person can continue legitimate work without a half-completed transition.
requirements.basis: Q49, complete incorporated source clauses and current explicit later refinements; REQ29-P01–P18. Exact paragraph, clause, proof and journey locators are mapped individually.

acceptance.text: The normal final source handoff atomically commits eligible predecessor cancellation/fence, Q25-qualified new original issuance and immutable linkage; no acknowledged half-canceled/half-issued handoff is exposed.

Fulfillment-first blocks that cancellation/replacement; cancellation/handoff-first fences old ordinary work. Newly admitted evidence or clarification before handoff remains in the predecessor and requires current remaining-work review.
At most one ever-issued direct replacement successor and one predecessor per successor exist in the exact context. New transport keys, draft recreation or restore cannot evade that cardinality.

The successor has new item identities, actual Q11/Q12 issuance/end, current Q25 responsibility and Q01 proof. It inherits no acceptance, grant, credential, notice plan or statement that the new person supplied old material.

Actual predecessor cancellation stops its Q48 recipient-demand lane while preserving history/counts/stops/possible sends. New demand/notifications follow their actual source contracts and cannot recreate purpose merely to reset limits.

Q35 describes only the real cancellation, subject to current safe contact. Issuance after an earlier independent cancellation creates no second Q35 occurrence; known-wrong former recipients are not notified.

requirements.title: Contain and recover replacement work
requirements.text: As an authorized source staff member, I want to stop wrong-recipient work and recover a replacement independently of draft readiness, so that containment does not wait for successful new collection.
requirements.basis: Q49, complete incorporated source clauses and current explicit later refinements; REQ29-P01–P18. Exact paragraph, clause, proof and journey locators are mapped individually.

acceptance.text: Authorized urgent source restriction or Q34 cancellation works before a replacement draft, new address or readiness exists; revocation alone is not mislabeled cancellation and invalid draft fields cannot block containment.
Known original stops remain stopped; unknown final handoff is reconciled before any new issuance attempt, and original committed outcome remains distinct from current replacement state.
After a proved independent cancellation, only the exact qualified remedy branch can continue issuance of the linked successor; other terminal states cannot use it as generic reopen.

Wrong-target, authority loss, draft conflict, readiness failure, delivery outage and operator departure preserve safe work with an actual current repair route, without copied grants or a second issued successor.

The staff UI distinguishes active predecessor, unissued preparation, independently stopped predecessor, blocked/unknown/issued successor and delivery problem. Recipients see only their actual permitted request or neutral ended/help outcome.

Q60 same-recipient corrective work stays separate, including its automatic-reminder exclusion and its own one-ever-issued remedial result. Neither path repeats unaffected work or treats a lost response as permission to clone.

requirements.title: Find ordinary files by approved names and details
requirements.text: As authorized staff, I want to find documents using permitted names and file details, so that I can return to relevant work without extracting or exposing private document bodies.
requirements.basis: Q38, ratified decision paragraphs 1–3 and 6; source metadata/search owners.

acceptance.text: The finder identifies its scope as names and file details. A phrase present only inside a document does not produce a general hit, ranking contribution, suggestion or snippet through indexing, on-demand scans, cached preview text or client extraction.

Existing independently qualified source search and Find inside an opened authorized representation retain their exact audience, corpus and coverage; the finder cannot aggregate them into a broader corpus.

The documented plain-text matching contract qualifies Unicode, accents, case, punctuation, long names and identifiers. Exact approved searchable names/identifiers are findable under that contract without silently discarding significant characters or importing another domain's query grammar.
Query input is data, not executable SQL, regex or an undeclared advanced language. Display permission alone does not make a field searchable.

General body search remains outside this scope. Native SQL, a free library, spare quota or an existing allowance cannot auto-enable it or establish zero added Vercel/Supabase billing; later expansion requires its own explicit evidence-backed decision.

requirements.title: Authorize every search contribution and current result
requirements.text: As a person using file discovery, I want results and counts to reflect my current permitted work, so that search does not disclose another source's records or offer stale authority.

acceptance.text: Results bind the actual permitted source/use and qualified current or historical version. Latest-uploaded bytes cannot silently replace the source-selected basis.

Preview, original read, download and every later source action reauthorize independently. Permitted metadata may remain visible when preview is unavailable; a hit does not promise safe, readable or accepted evidence.
Current restrictive facts fence serving before asynchronous cleanup. Replay, reindex, stale cache and restore cannot revive withdrawn fields, disposed content or older permission.

Definite policy exclusions remain undisclosed and do not themselves make a valid search fail. Failure to establish required authorization or complete coverage cannot produce a definitive successful zero or exact count.

Bounded server-side filtering, ordering and stable pagination precede output. The application does not fetch the whole tenant corpus for browser filtering or use forbidden fields for rank. Pagination declares its concurrent-change behavior without retaining old authority or requiring a global locked snapshot.

requirements.title: Recover a useful accessible search without widening scope
requirements.text: As a staff reader, I want clear search states and a usable return path, so that sparse metadata or a failed preview does not force downloads, retagging or repeated work.

acceptance.text: A user can refine or continue a capped/broad query and retry unavailable coverage. No hidden-file identity or hidden-match count is disclosed to explain absence.

Recoverable errors preserve lawful query/filter/scroll/focus return state. Search does not require renaming, manual tagging, body-text copying, bulk download, repeated upload or an external office viewer.
Keyboard, touch, AT, reflow, IME/RTL and localized display remain usable; status updates neither steal focus nor announce the whole result list on every keystroke.

Query/context/permission changes fence obsolete responses and private caches. Private queries, filters, recent-history values and result fragments do not enter general logs, analytics, public URLs, shared caches or durable offline stores by default.
Saved views and recent work organize only current authorized discovery; sharing a definition never freezes access to its results.

requirements.title: Keep discovery bounded and repairable
requirements.text: As the discovery operator, I want failures and rebuilds to preserve source truth, so that restoring a search projection cannot roll back legitimate work or leak old data.

acceptance.text: Activation declares finite source/field/query/page/selection/corpus/concurrency and recovery budgets, actual query plans/indexes and measured baseline/incremental resource use with units and responsible owners; no fixed-invoice or unmeasured speed claim substitutes.

Typed tenant/source/use relations and immutable attribution cannot be retargeted through allowed writes, jobs, alternate readers or privileged functions; effective all-door proof follows the shared contract.

Backfill, mixed-version operation and restore preserve the exact metadata scope and later restrictions. Stopping an affected finder/projection does not undo source facts or disable independent qualified source capabilities.
Failed search retries cause no source business effects. Supported source/operator repair is available without routine production SQL or an unsafe cached/public fallback.

requirements.title: Author reusable request definitions without copying a case
requirements.text: As authorized request staff, I want an optional reusable template, so that I can prepare consistent ordinary work without copying another person's evidence or authority.
requirements.basis: Q39 paragraphs 1–2; Document Request Template; REQ29-P01/P02/P04.

acceptance.text: Save from a permitted never-issued draft or direct authoring identifies a nonempty compatible reusable set and actual sharing scope; only source-admitted definition fields are copied.

Subject/recipient/record identities, answers, evidence, review/conversation history, acceptance, assertions, proofs/grants, reviewer assignments, actual clock ends and communication plans are excluded. New-instance facts resolve through current context and valid defaults without needless re-entry.
Staff review actual names/instruction prose for embedded case-specific material. A field allowlist is not an automatic sanitization guarantee; no AI classifier is required or implied.
There is no general form builder, executable recipe, marketplace, automatic issuance, bulk amendment or whole-Workflow prerequisite.

requirements.title: Save and maintain one coherent template revision
requirements.text: As a template maintainer, I want deliberate saves and recoverable retirement, so that other staff never use a half-edited or silently overwritten definition set.

acceptance.text: Retirement stops new application, not existing requests. A qualified successor or deliberate make-available action over still-lawful content repairs a mistake while preserving history.
Making content available establishes a new current availability basis; it does not revive an old uncommitted application against the retired basis. Matching committed effects still reconcile first.
Required copied meaning and minimal provenance are retained under actual source policy without cascading template deletion into requests or retaining unlimited private text.

For accidentally reusable private facts, the capable maintainer/privacy route stops future use, corrects the template and assesses/remediates affected copies under each source's current authority. It does not silently rewrite issued work, reveal every derived use or claim delivered information recalled.
No routine Publish ceremony, second approver or recurring review bureaucracy is added to Save. Source/history visibility is current; curation never grants access to derived requests.

requirements.title: Apply an exact template to an independent draft
requirements.text: As request staff, I want to apply the template I reviewed without losing my draft, so that preparation is predictable and later template edits cannot change my request.

acceptance.text: Edit/retire/restriction-first returns conflict, refresh or unavailable; copy-first creates the complete independent draft. The system neither substitutes latest content nor silently drops incompatible members and claims success.
All intended definitions, fresh draft/item identities, exact member/origin attribution, mandatory history and original outcome commit coherently. Equal names alone do not identify duplicate items.

Later template editing/renaming/retirement or author departure does not rewrite/delete copied content. Current source/privacy restrictions still govern; mutable untracked URLs cannot change instruction meaning or become grants.

A lost-response replay recovers the original permitted application after retirement, role change, draft editing or issuance without recreating members or overwriting newer work. Changed intent conflicts; a genuinely new independent draft is not deduplicated merely by equal content.

requirements.title: Keep template preparation inert and the ordinary request complete
requirements.text: As a request author, I want prepared definitions to lead into normal issuance, so that using a template adds no new recipient step or hidden side effect.

acceptance.text: Template save/application/edit never issues, sends, changes existing requiredness, evidence, acceptance, fulfillment, cancellation or access. Issued changes use their own source commands.

Choose template/Start from scratch, actual readable item preview and normal adaptation distinguish Saved template, Draft prepared and Request issued. Participants/reviewers receive the ordinary journey without another account, template step or inherited approval.

Current safe text rendering, keyboard/non-drag ordering where offered, AT/focus/mobile/IME/RTL and preserved lawful input are qualified; no executable template markup or default private offline archive.

Finite catalog/item/text/query/page/history/concurrency/recovery/retention budgets and actual workloads are qualified. Adjacent catalogs/person-specific old requests are not automatically migrated by name; any authorized conversion preserves real provenance.

Rollout fences incompatible old writers/readers and preserves copied content, operation lineage and restrictions. Stop new unsafe applications without erasing admitted drafts; use supported repair/roll-forward where downgrade would lose history or safety.

requirements.title: Offer the exact optional recipient update notice
requirements.text: As staff publishing an ordinary request update, I want a clear optional email choice, so that the recipient can be informed without confusing communication with the source change.

acceptance.text: The qualified purpose starts Enabled with initial staff choice On only when actual source/actor/recipient/Live plan/channel eligibility permits. Authorized tenant control may disable it or choose its initial On/Off default; staff may decline optional mail.

Defaults seed only genuinely new uninitialized review, preserving choice and provenance. Missing, legacy, conflicting or ambiguous input is never On; malformed combined intent is rejected/reviewed, not silently converted to deliberate Off.

The existing final review shows safe actual destination, source act and notice consequence together, with explicit submitted choice. No compulsory toggle, reason, extra approver or second confirmation is added.

A material precommit recipient/destination/scope/eligibility change requires inline revalidation with lawful input and a source-only path where permitted. It cannot silently retarget or downgrade reviewed source-plus-mail intent.

requirements.title: Coordinate fresh-access and update choices without substitution
requirements.text: As staff making a combined fresh-access and request-update change, I want to see both notice purposes and their count, so that I can deliberately choose neither, either or both.
requirements.basis: Q40 paragraph 4; Q20 original rules preserved.

acceptance.text: Unknown Q20 eligibility does not qualify. Actual joint source basis is checked at admission, and material precommit change receives inline review.
An already initialized Q40 choice never flips, including when fresh access is added later. Later Q20 toggling/failure/block/uncertainty cannot silently change or substitute Q40.
The review truthfully shows zero, one or two requested notices. There is no combined message/event, cross-purpose text deduplication, fallback send or claim that Q20 delivered the Q40 update.

requirements.title: Stop only the old update notice whose usefulness or authority ended
requirements.text: As a recipient, I want update notices to reflect still-relevant source work, so that old publications do not become misleading instructions after the work changed.

acceptance.text: As the Q40-specific exception, Tenant Disabled stops affected historical Q40 admissions at sealing and every later provider-call admission, preserving an intervening Disabled interval even if no worker ran. On cannot revive Off/zero/stopped occurrences; default-only edits remain future-review-only.

Every call requires the notified item to remain an outstanding, unaccepted need on the same unfinished request; Q37 additionally requires the exact notified instruction revision. Relevant acceptance/removal/supersession/restriction/F/cancel ends the old occurrence permanently; later reversal does not revive it.

A later same-item Q37 does not itself end Q36 addition awareness when that need and frozen variant/action remain applicable. Unrelated changes alone do not stop it. Unknown evaluation blocks safely without inventing a proved terminal stop.

Notice work never holds fulfillment, adds requiredness, renews access or forces new upload/account/acknowledgment. Staff-only Q28/reassessment remains real work with the actual next actor; later portal expiry alone is neither blanket factual-notice authority nor prohibition.

A frozen cue cannot be rewritten as successor/cancellation/fresh-access material. Genuine later publication is a distinct qualified occurrence; matching original effects reconcile before new-work checks, under current disclosure. Possible in-flight effects are not recalled.

requirements.title: Keep update content, recovery and readable copies narrowly qualified
requirements.text: As a recipient or authorized support reader, I want only useful safe update context, so that an awareness email does not disclose evidence or expose retry material through history.

acceptance.text: On cannot override suppression/privacy/consent. Protected return uses the source's scanner-safe current doorway, not direct storage or broader history. Plain-text/images-off views preserve safe identity, factual meaning and descriptive qualified action.

Prepared material and provider/account/environment/connection/attempt identity remain immutable. Seal possible-send evidence before I/O; timeout/lease expiry/missing callback cannot justify new key or occurrence.

Only the existing three qualified indeterminate same-envelope retry classes apply, with at most two follow-up HTTP calls after the initial call and the earliest material/member/provider deadline. Recheck Disabled/usefulness/safety on each call; callbacks cannot rewind source truth or prove reading.

The exact optional external-participant material class and finite nonextendable utility/purge profile qualify before Live. Durable history is body-free. Readable Recent is optional and separately reveal-qualified; otherwise use no readable copy without blocking independent lawful source work/email.

A qualified Recent copy uses the shorter of tenant Off/7/30-day choice and exact contract 0/7/30-day ceiling; unknown class is zero. Shortening follows its owner, lengthening affects future copies only, and view/retry never renews existing expiry. The copy is inert, not retry material.

Only expressly qualified transport/protected-action carriers contain their permitted material. That exception grants no general telemetry, history, export, cache or default offline disclosure. Trusted source/recipient attribution cannot be retargeted by an allowed row mutation.

requirements.title: Show publication and notice recovery as separate outcomes
requirements.text: As staff who changed a request, I want the committed update and its optional email status reported separately, so that mail failure does not make me publish again.

acceptance.text: Before publication, staff may lawfully edit/discard/correct choice; afterward actual Q33/Q34/Q36/Q37/privacy remedies apply. No universal Undo, repeated publication, resend or recall is the repair. A genuine corrective publication gets its own qualified choice.

Source and mail outcomes persist with current result authority and accessible shared UI; typing or toggling neither publishes nor sends/navigates. Preserve lawful input/focus and reject late private results after context change.

Exact finite workload/material/recovery qualification and actual-role/source/release/stop/retry races are required, including the compound Q20 case. Prospective rollout fences old writers; no guessed On backfill/historical catch-up or exactly-once physical-delivery claim.

requirements.title: File an exact ordinary evidence use in one optional home
requirements.text: As filing staff, I want one clear location for each evidence entry, so that I can organize work without changing its source meaning or permissions.

acceptance.text: Receipt, inspection, review and lawful use work without a folder/label and through recoverable filing outage. Checking/rejected/historical/fulfilled/canceled/retained status neither grants nor universally prohibits current source-authorized filing; participant expiry does not decide staff rights.

Move/label/view changes no version, candidate, acceptance, fulfillment, publication, permission, share term, retention, provider bytes, chronology, review work or notice. Organization history is separately restricted and attributable.

New independent participant and staff uses begin Unfiled with no copied labels. An actual Q03 correction or expressly qualified Q28 replacement may carry only the predecessor home once at admission, with same Tenant/environment/request/item, ordered predecessor/destination basis and current maintenance authority.

Unknown/incompatible optional filing leaves an independently valid new receipt Unfiled, preserving its original carry-or-Unfiled outcome. It never excuses unknown source admission/custody/evidence authority. Retry cannot copy a later home; non-byte updates to the same use keep existing home/labels.

No folder ACL, inherited permission, participant tree, public folder or cross-source relocation is added. Hidden location is not falsely Unfiled; names/paths/counts/order/errors and byte actions require their own current disclosure.

requirements.title: Move and remove folders without touching evidence
requirements.text: As authorized filing staff, I want safe folder maintenance and finite moves, so that organizing evidence cannot delete it or hide a failed operation.

acceptance.text: Remove folder is empty-only. Current authoritative state must prove no direct entries or child folders, including undisplayed members; incomplete/denied coverage is not empty.
Offer the ordinary finite Move flow for entries/children, then separate deliberate removal. Never recursively delete evidence, silently rehome hidden contents or call provider folder deletion.

A current source/organization operator uses permitted exact membership facts and the same Move/Unfile commands to repair inaccessible memberships. Reconciliation may clear only proved-stale organization references; broad body access, hidden counts and routine SQL are not the remedy.

One finite bulk Move is all-or-none for exact selected identities/expected state, not a refreshed all-matching query. Competing moves, hierarchy/removal and correction initialization share a lawful ordering boundary.

Committed original recovery cannot move entries back after newer work. Changed intent conflicts; expiry/restore retains minimum result/dedup evidence or safely rejects unverifiable stale operations. Any offered Undo is a fresh current-authorized forward move.

requirements.title: Use labels and live views without disguising source decisions
requirements.text: As staff browsing organized evidence, I want labels and saved criteria to keep their meaning, so that they never imitate acceptance or silently widen a view.
requirements.basis: Q42 paragraph 7; Q43 scoped shared-view amendment; REQ29-P04/P08.

acceptance.text: Saved definitions are validated live queries/display choices, not result snapshots, memberships or permissions. Current private/system definitions remain usable; shared publication follows only REQ29-C18–C22.
Rename preserves criterion identity. Removed, inaccessible or invalid criteria never disappear silently to broaden results; show safely unavailable and offer deliberate qualified repair.
Viewing a folder or definition does not reveal hidden entries, paths, other uses or body contents. Metadata discovery may remain useful independently of preview readiness.

requirements.title: Make ordinary filing small, accessible and recoverable
requirements.text: As a staff member organizing files, I want a simple current-scope view and Move picker, so that filing is optional help rather than another workflow.

acceptance.text: The searchable Move picker commits deliberately, preserves lawful selection/query/return state and reports persistent success/conflict/failure/unknown beyond a toast. Routine filing needs no label, reason, second approver or notice.

Keyboard/non-drag pointer, focus restoration, restrained AT status, mobile/zoom/touch, international names/IME/RTL and weak-network recovery work without exposing the staff tree to participants or external readers.
Private names/paths/labels/predicates/associations are excluded from ordinary telemetry and default durable offline storage; context changes fence late results and unapproved mutation replay.

Qualify finite list/picker/hierarchy/label/view/bulk/concurrency workloads through existing source/query/UI boundaries; no general hierarchy engine, shortcut layer, automatic classification, sync provider or speculative closure-table mandate.

Additive migration uses real retained-data/source-use mapping, not provider keys/names/uploaders/digests or mass source rewrites. Mixed writers and restored records preserve identity/history and current restrictions; stopping filing does not undo source receipts.

requirements.title: Share a reviewed view with named eligible staff
requirements.text: As an eligible view author, I want to share a useful ordinary-file view directly, so that colleagues can reuse its definition without receiving extra file access.
requirements.basis: Q43 paragraphs 1–3; scoped P9/Q42 amendment; REQ29-P02/P06.

acceptance.text: The initial audience is a finite explicit set of current eligible staff Active Tenant Assignments in the same Tenant/environment/ordinary-source envelope. No bare profile/email/Party, demo team, dynamic group, Everyone, external recipient or automatic future-staff audience substitutes.
