Exact duplicate assignments normalize once; stale or partly invalid audience rejects without partial publication. Empty initial selection neither publishes nor silently saves unsaved input; preserve the private draft unless a separate private Save was deliberate.

Named audience use does not grant maintenance, resharing, export or additional record access. Adding eligible named assignments remains normal Manage sharing; a new audience form requires explicit owner adoption.
Removing the last stored reader uses Stop sharing with a lawful maintainer, or Remove/retire without one. Temporary zero currently eligible readers does not automatically privatize retained bindings.

requirements.title: Execute a shared definition under each viewer's authority
requirements.text: As a shared-view reader, I want its criteria and results to be both permitted and truthful, so that a useful shared query does not disclose another person's records or silently change scope.

acceptance.text: Undisclosable/unexecutable definition meaning yields safe unavailable, not stripped predicates, substituted defaults, concealed criteria executed anyway or automatic redirection to a broader list. Mandatory source restrictions still apply without exposing protected policy details.

P9's typed versioned query contract binds predicate/sort/group/source and schema/default resolution over Q38-approved metadata. Unrelated default/schema/configuration changes cannot broaden or retarget it.

Qualified viewer-relative values, dates/zones and source current/historical selection use the actual viewer, never the creator or newest upload. Unsupported/retired references need safe repair or deliberate validated save; no SQL/code/body-search grammar.

Ad-hoc context links require current source/query disclosure; saved-definition links also require current definition permission. A URL grants no authority and cannot expose private predicates/tokens. Return to request files is explicit and labels its broader scope.

requirements.title: Maintain shared views without publishing personal experiments
requirements.text: As a view maintainer, I want explicit shared saves and supported continuity, so that browsing or my departure cannot unexpectedly change colleagues' work.

acceptance.text: Browsing/sorting/filter experiments are personal working state with a visible unsaved difference. Only deliberate Save shared view changes the reusable definition; stale old private-save routes cannot mutate newly shared state.

Authorized Save a personal copy creates a new private identity from permitted reviewed meaning without audience or maintenance grants. It is independent, subject to its own current source restrictions, not synchronized or automatically recalled by original unsharing.
Publication cannot force personal defaults, tabs or pins. Hide for me and shared-definition mutation remain distinct actual capabilities.

Transfer validates an exact current eligible assignment, preserves creator/actual actor and unchanged audience/source unless separately reviewed. Departure/loss of author power ends their writes, not independently valid shared work; applicable named-grantor restrictions still win.

Scoped admin can transfer/retire an orphan through supported commands, without blanket inspection/takeover of never-shared or later-private views. Definition/audience/history/outcome commit coherently; stale edits preserve lawful working input instead of auto-merge/last-wins.

requirements.title: Withdraw shared availability and recover privately
requirements.text: As an authorized view maintainer or operator, I want to remove sharing safely, so that ending access does not delete files or strand an orphaned private definition.

acceptance.text: Remove view withdraws definition/audience from normal use without deleting files, source records or independent copies. Retain only justified restricted history and minimum replay evidence.

Any lawful retained recovery is private under current authority with no restored old audience; sharing again is a new reviewed act. No old link, retry, backup/default/name reuse revives withdrawn publication.

Temporary technical/policy unavailability differs from explicit removal; only still-valid unchanged bindings can resume under current rules. No implicit privatization of temporarily ineligible bindings.

Initial Share failure preserves private state; shared-update failure preserves prior committed meaning subject to current denials. Exact committed replay precedes new eligibility and cannot reopen after Stop; changed intent conflicts, unverifiable stale operations reject safely.

requirements.title: Present and operate shared views without a new collaboration platform
requirements.text: As staff using shared views, I want clear controls and honest result states, so that shared organization adds little overhead and no notification or permission machinery.

acceptance.text: Keyboard/non-drag/touch/AT/focus/reflow/zoom/IME/RTL/international names and slow-network return remain usable. No email, notification feed, approval queue or presence system follows.
Context/assignment/definition/audience/restriction changes fence late responses/caches; no viewing another person's results or private predicate/audience telemetry. No silent offline share replay.

Exact same-scope IDs, unique audience references, valid private/shared/withdrawn states and protected creator attribution apply across every door. Profile deletion cannot cascade shared meaning/history; names only disambiguate permitted context, not prove identity or global uniqueness.

Qualify finite definition/audience/catalog/query/write/recovery budgets and actual set-based plans, preserving inherited P12 limits. Avoid full directory/result loading, per-row policy loops, eager global counts and new vendor/expiry engines.

Migrate current private views without mass publication, fence old personal writers/cascades, preserve retained facts and qualify stop/roll-forward/restore against current restrictions before activation.

requirements.title: Request a bounded originals ZIP with honest completeness
requirements.text: As staff with original-export authority, I want one ZIP for an exact selected set, so that I can download it conveniently without hidden omissions or broader access.

acceptance.text: Freeze finite explicit exact use/original-version bindings at authoritative admission. Exact duplicate selections normalize once; equal names/bytes or different uses do not merge provenance. Folder/query/multi-file item/all future matches is not an implicit selection.

A denied or unknown whole-command/source/P12 gate blocks preparation; shrinking the set cannot evade it. Intended selection, member outcomes, admitted members, result generation and egress attempts remain separate.

Only positively qualified partial-output authority permits excluded/unresolved individual members. Complete means every normalized intended binding is represented; Partial requires at least one included original and an intelligible permitted account of incompleteness.

Exact reviewed partial output requires deliberate Download available files. Zero eligible yields no success ZIP; unknown is neither complete nor zero. If necessary partial-state disclosure would expose hidden names/counts/associations/hashes, withhold rather than mislead.
Never substitute latest/corrected bytes or a changed query on retry. Download neither accepts evidence, fulfills work, changes retention nor proves destination custody.

requirements.title: Seal exact originals with a readable integrity manifest
requirements.text: As a ZIP recipient, I want reliable original members and a readable contents list, so that I can identify what was included without mistaking the archive for an official or complete business record.

acceptance.text: Bind exact use/version, verified byte length/digest, safe delivery-name mapping, completeness/outcomes, producer/profile and finite end. Protect preparation references against disposal/locator reuse without extending rights or source retention.

Verify copied bytes and usable complete archive before Ready; uploaded object, ZIP signature or CRC alone is insufficient. Whole-ZIP length/digest belongs to the protected external result, not a self-referential manifest hash. Candidates never overwrite the sealed winner.

Use qualified interoperable bounded Store/Deflate ZIP, ZIP64 only when required/compatible, preferably flat names with a reserved manifest name and deterministic collisions. No multipart, self-extracting/password workflow or custom archive browser is selected.

Qualify Unicode/normalization/case/long-name/device/separator/traversal/bidi/header hazards; never overwrite a member or rename source identity. No symlink/special-file metadata, executable flags, arbitrary extras, credentials or unapproved comments. Original archives stay opaque; no unpack/execute/convert/OCR/merge.

One accessible UTF-8 contents file states intended-set complete/partial, preparation time/zone, safe member names, permitted opaque use/version references, lengths/digests and only disclosable exclusions. Escape untrusted structure; omit internal paths/credentials/provider URLs. UI uses the same sealed facts, not a separately authored PDF/HTML/CSV report.
Manifest and archive timestamps are not source-event chronology, malware clearance, signature validity, evidence acceptance, verified device save or official-record completeness.

requirements.title: Serve the immutable ZIP only as a wholly authorized representation
requirements.text: As an initiating staff member, I want current safe retrieval of my exact result, so that a later access change cannot leak one protected member through the whole archive.

acceptance.text: A forbidden/unknown member or manifest fact blocks the old ZIP, not merely a filtered range. Changed permitted set/manifest needs a new deliberate reviewed result; never in-place reseal or automatic residual package.
Temporary unavailability may clear before the unchanged result's original end where source rules permit; canceled/expired/terminally withdrawn availability never automatically revives.

Deliver through current private application attachment semantics with safe international filenames/no-store as required, no reusable provider bearer or public fallback. Full GET, HEAD, conditional/validator/range/error, length and hash disclosure all share actual admission.

Govern streams set-wise under actual P12 audit/metering/current-context/revocation/expiry rules, without per-member remote policy loops. Each egress/redownload/range attempt needs its own current admission; replay of preparation is not unlimited transfer.

Qualified range resume binds one immutable generation/validator/length; never concatenate rebuilt/new archives. Unsupported range behavior is truthful/standards-compatible. Observed transport start/completion does not prove human reading, local save or destination custody, and emitted bytes cannot be recalled.

requirements.title: Cancel, expire and clean ZIP preparation without disposing originals
requirements.text: As a staff member or operator, I want ended preparation to stay ended and clean up safely, so that retries or late workers cannot reopen availability or delete source evidence.

acceptance.text: Reads/retries/interruption never extend the original end. Late workers/provider acknowledgments cannot make ended/deletion-claimed material Ready. In-flight stop follows actual feasible bounds without recall promises.
Prepare again after cancellation/expiry/changed scope is a new reviewed current command with a newly qualified finite end, not reactivation.

Cleanup orders against builders/readers/holds through reciprocal bounded fences and removes only intended transient copies under their actual class. It cannot dispose originals, erase required outcomes or release holds.

A source hold does not automatically retain every optional ZIP; actual copy-class scope controls. Unresolved cleanup authority restricts the copy rather than deleting it. Required holds/failed cleanup may retain restricted copies after delivery ends, with actual records/budget resolution.

Exact original preparation/result reconciles before fresh eligibility under current disclosure. Changed intent conflicts; before seal bounded retries finish original work, after seal redownload uses unchanged bytes. No storage I/O remains inside a database transaction or receipt expiry permits duplicate old effect.

requirements.title: Preserve ZIP provenance and safe operator recovery
requirements.text: As an authorized operator, I want exact protected preparation and delivery evidence, so that I can repair unknown outcomes without reading another person's archive or guessing what happened.

acceptance.text: Expressible native uniqueness, allowed states/types, bounded nonnegative counts/bytes and required digests/deadlines enforce one normalized binding, one result head and safe unique member names. Current cross-row eligibility remains at the source boundary.

Caller fields cannot alter completeness, digest, lifecycle, source version or identity; every alternate door preserves the shared P12/grant/RLS contract. Global name/digest uniqueness creates no cross-tenant oracle.

Protected business result/access evidence records actual intent, generation, integrity, lifecycle and observed stream facts. General telemetry omits manifests, names, selected payloads, bodies, associations, keys and credentials.

Supported cancel/reconcile/retry-cleanup exposes permitted operational facts only. Repair power does not grant original or another requester's result access. Status/count/error/cache paths and late responses retain current privacy.

requirements.title: Keep bulk download usable and finitely qualified
requirements.text: As staff downloading documents, I want a simple fast path and usable slow/error paths, so that one archive does not become a new archive-management product.

acceptance.text: Reduced-set acknowledgment is explicit; browser activation limitations fall back to the usable Download button, not false failure/repeated preparation. Preserve lawful selection; offer smaller selection and independent individual download where allowed.

No mandatory essay/repeated confirmation, archive center, email purpose, sync client, forced extractor or second automatic per-file batch mode is introduced. Keyboard/non-drag/AT/focus/320-CSS-pixel controls/zoom/names/IME/RTL/zone and interrupted-network tasks qualify.

Finite member/name/manifest/input/output/CPU/memory/buffer/time/concurrency/retry/staging/audit/egress budgets include actual candidates/orphans/held copies and central-directory overhead. Capacity exhaustion stops/bounds new admission with repair, not wrongful deletion or silent exemption.

Use a maintained qualified ZIP writer and existing seams, not a whole-library browser-memory archive or unbounded/per-row-policy loop. Over-limit work is not silently truncated or split into an invented multipart system. ZIP is not promised smaller, faster, free or bill-neutral.

Actual extraction devices/workloads, private serving, races/restore and old-reader/writer fences qualify before activation. Census/migration preserves IDs/digests and independent individual retrieval; no inferred export grants, specialist reclassification or historical public URL fallback.

requirements.title: Comment on exact ordinary evidence without requiring a preview
requirements.text: As a staff reviewer, I want useful exact-version comments in the evidence context, so that I can explain feedback without creating a separate task, inbox or document copy.
requirements.basis: Q45 paragraphs 1–3; Document Review Comment; REQ29-P01/P02/P04/P12.

acceptance.text: Each saved comment has bounded nonblank useful plain text and at most one optional qualified location. Concise feedback can suffice; no title/reason essay or semantic-quality classifier. General comments need no location or successful preview.

Supported typed page/slide/sheet/cell/line references and optional point/rectangle are distinct from unverified explanatory text. New visual authoring is a narrow D32 extension only for qualified static PDF/images, not every rendered Office page.

Preserve original bytes/signatures and separate embedded original annotations. No empty pin, screenshot/attachment/crop copy, arbitrary selector/HTML/SVG, ink/redaction/OCR/AI/body index/annotated export or automatic URL fetch is added.

Safe text rendering treats @names/URLs as text, not invitations, permissions or notification triggers. Participant-facing communication remains a separate Q23/Q30 act; external share readers do not automatically receive staff comments.

requirements.title: Preserve precise location meaning across view changes
requirements.text: As a reviewer using a location, I want it to point to the intended exact page or region, so that zoom, a new rendition or a newer file cannot move my feedback to different evidence.

acceptance.text: New/moved visual locations use one closed bounded finite point/rectangle in declared coordinates with qualified precision. Validate shape/range/page membership and nondegenerate geometry before and after rounding; reject NaN/infinity/malformed/collapsed/out-of-bounds values without relocation.

Qualified mapping accounts for zoom, rotation, crop/view box, pixel ratio, orientation and resize. Screen pixels, caller geometry, file extension, equal page count/dimensions/text/digest alone are not mapping proof.

New file versions never inherit comments/locations/approval. Regenerated representations navigate only with proved exact compatible correspondence; otherwise retain independently lawful text/context and show Location unavailable.

Text-only correction may retain an unchanged stored anchor without fresh preview under current disclosure. Moving/adding geometry requires current qualification. Remove location deliberately changes only this revision to general same-version feedback; expiry cannot silently drop anchors or retain previews forever.

requirements.title: Post and correct a comment as one coherent deliberate action
requirements.text: As a comment author, I want text and location to save together and recover honestly, so that a lost response or concurrent edit cannot create an orphan marker or overwrite another revision.

acceptance.text: Draft keystrokes/cursor/pointer/zoom/pan/hover and unsaved marker adjustments cause no database writes. Only deliberate Post/Save changes/Withdraw/Restore mutates.

Exact committed original recovery precedes new eligibility under current result permission. Changed intent conflicts; equal text does not collapse genuinely new follow-ups. After current authority/basis checks, identical canonical content/location is honest unchanged, not an Edited revision; stale ABA still conflicts.

Current-authorized own editing records actual editor/time and appropriate Edited presentation, preserving source-required prior meaning. No silent merge, author impersonation or target/version reparenting.

Wrong-version post can be withdrawn and separately posted to the correct qualified target. A scoped operator may restrict/withdraw/restore where authorized or add separately attributed correction, not rewrite another author's prose as theirs.

Unknown/denied authority is not empty/cached success. Preserve lawful working input on conflict, fence late protected results and retain minimum replay evidence or reject unverifiable stale commands. No arbitrary edit timer or extra approver is introduced.

requirements.title: Withdraw and restore only the lawful current comment
requirements.text: As a comment author or scoped operator, I want accidental withdrawal to be recoverable, so that ordinary mistakes do not require history erasure or privileged database edits.

acceptance.text: An unchanged retained location may return as unavailable rather than being discarded or forcing preview. Restore cannot select arbitrary old history, change author/target, bypass restriction/redaction, reconstruct disposed text, restart retention or revive access.
Author departure preserves required attribution and actual scoped administrative continuity. No new Trash platform, universal recovery window or irreversible-delete shortcut is added.

Current text, source-required history, security evidence, diagnostics and disposable reader state have independent policies. D32 expiry neither deletes a comment nor grants historic bytes; comment retention does not automatically hold a preview.

Governed restriction/disposal applies to current/historical projections, caches, exports/backups and restore suppression. Technical telemetry omits text, quotes, private descriptions/geometry/names/URLs; operators get scoped diagnostics, not blanket content.

requirements.title: Revalidate affected review context without making comments an approval workflow
requirements.text: As an evidence reviewer, I want relevant changed comments reflected before committing my decision, so that I do not unknowingly decide against stale review context.

acceptance.text: An uncommitted review revalidates when its actual structural context changes; it cannot silently ignore the new relevant revision.
A later comment never undoes committed acceptance or adds a new Q22 fulfillment predicate. A reply/Resolve flag, comment-reading ceremony or automatic repeat review is not required.

Commenting does not Accept, Request changes, waive need, revise instructions or fulfill the request. Participant content is a new deliberate source-qualified act, never an internal-comment visibility toggle.

requirements.title: Use equivalent location controls on desktop and mobile
requirements.text: As a keyboard, touch or assistive-technology user, I want the same precise comment-location ability, so that visual review does not require dragging or a perfectly working preview.

acceptance.text: Point/region create/adjust/remove/navigation has keyboard, AT and equivalent single-pointer non-drag control, such as two-corner placement. A less precise whole-page note is not equivalent; coordinate-number entry is not mandatory ordinary work.
List and reader selection synchronize only through explicit action, with meaningful text/location labels, overlapping-marker handling and honest loaded-page coverage.

320-CSS-pixel controls, zoom/touch/hit areas, visible focus/return, non-color meaning, restrained status and reduced motion work. Localization/IME/RTL does not change source coordinates or accidentally Post.

Scrolling/tool changes/preview close are inert. Preserve permitted draft/location through recoverable failure; unknown save reconciles before clearing/repeating. Refresh cannot steal focus, move the reader, overwrite drafts or select a newer version.

Lawful comments remain useful when optional location/reader fails, with no automatic original download, external office viewer or screenshot-upload fallback and no default restricted offline persistence.

requirements.title: Qualify bounded private comments and markers through the existing reader
requirements.text: As the source operator, I want private comment storage and reader limits to be qualified together, so that the feature remains recoverable without a new collaboration infrastructure.

acceptance.text: Stable keyset pages use a unique tie-breaker and scope/query-bound continuation; edits do not reorder creation history or lose equal-time rows. Batch needed markers/authors/context rather than per-pin queries/policy/ledger calls; partial/unavailable coverage is not all/none.

Actual P12 fine-grained decisions and coarse Tenant RLS apply through every read/write/reader/job door. Do not reuse public post-comment policies, raw DELETE payloads or default Realtime subscriptions. Any qualified invalidation is a minimal current hint followed by protected refetch, not a body broadcast or new CRDT/presence prerequisite.

Finite text/location/request/list/history/marker/query/concurrency/client/retry/refresh/storage/egress budgets preserve D32's exact format, coverage and numeric requirements. No doubled limits, invented comment TTL, blanket reader reduction or unproved cost/capacity claim.

Both baseline comments and the chosen PDF/image marker cohort must qualify on actual intended devices and boundary/rounding/maximum/sensitive fixtures. Text-only fallback is honest containment, not completion of A+B.

Census/migration never verifies old Party/post comments or arbitrary UI coordinates by backfill. Legacy text saves cannot drop markers; current restore honors independent reader expiry/restrictions. Disable unsafe marker serving while preserving lawful text/history; use supported source correction/location diagnosis instead of SQL/public fallback.

requirements.title: Change a requested-by target only for eligible recipient work
requirements.text: As authorized request staff, I want to change the coordination target when recipient work remains, so that planning can adapt without changing the request's evidence or access rules.

acceptance.text: Permitted earlier/later/past targets are supported under actual source rules, without backdating the change. Date editing need not open evidence or require recipient login.

Explicit Set/Clear exists only for proved source-optional targets and the relevant actor power. Required targets cannot Clear; known absence, unknown interpretation and malformed data remain distinct.

A known current source identity/revision/authority/interpretation may admit a new prospective value replacing an explicitly unresolved old target while preserving unknown history. Unknown command authority, ordering or meaning blocks; never guess defaults or optionality.
Target change cannot edit instructions, requirements, reviewer, acceptance/removal/cancel/F. Tasks/calendars/notices and cached labels are projections, not additional writable target owners.

requirements.title: Preserve civil-date meaning and historical receipt timing
requirements.text: As a participant or reviewer, I want the current requested date and receipt timing to be understandable, so that a later planning edit does not rewrite whether earlier work was timely.

acceptance.text: Browser/organization display changes and time-zone-rule updates cannot rewrite saved meaning. Preserve admission interpretation evidence and qualify compatible server/database/client semantics and finite supported dates without a new zone service.

Requested by is distinct from intake cutoff, original/fresh unfinished/completed access, proof/session validity, revocation, closure and retention. A permitted target beyond access end is an honest mismatch, not automatic rejection or a new grant.

Every receipt retains trusted source admission time, exact lineage and applicable target terms or explicit unresolved timing. Transfer start, browser time, callback, scan/review or response time is not receipt time; today's target cannot relabel old late/timely facts.

Added requirements, revised instructions and corrections keep their real applicability, with no unrelated retroactive lateness/new interval. Actual historical-fact correction is separately governed and attributable, not disguised prospective editing.

requirements.title: Save and repair requested dates without replaying old state
requirements.text: As staff adjusting a target, I want conflict-safe save and durable recovery, so that another receipt or closure cannot be undone by my old tab or retry.

acceptance.text: Recover committed original before new eligibility/no-op checks, under current result disclosure, without reapplying over later target/receipt/terminal state. Current UI distinguishes recovered historical outcome from today's target.

New commands require current authority and expected basis even when the displayed date matches. Complete canonical equality is unchanged without new business revision/effect; required audit remains. Intervening change-and-back is stale, not a no-op loophole.

Relevant recipient/work, receipt/correction, acceptance/removal, material instructions, F/cancel and authority races have one source order. Last recipient work disappearing first blocks the edit; edit-first stays a real act. Unrelated prepared work/session/review is not blanket-invalidated.
Q09-compatible target-only changes may resolve at first submission admission without a new upload/intent/reconfirmation; committed replay preserves original receipt terms.

Mistakes use a new current qualified edit, possibly to the former value, preserving intervening history. Ended/no-recipient-work cases requiring genuine correction have an actual qualified source route and capable actor before activation; no powerless admin link, SQL, generic reopen or cancellation/reissue workaround.

requirements.title: Show date changes clearly without inventing notices
requirements.text: As request staff or a permitted participant, I want clear dates, errors and current status, so that planning changes are usable on mobile and never imply awareness or renewed access.

acceptance.text: A keyboard/text alternative to calendar, useful format/month/zone guidance, accessible errors/focus, reflow/RTL/IME and slow-network preservation work. Earlier/past/mismatched values get useful context without an extra ritual.
Pending/saved/unchanged/failed/unknown remain distinct. Reconcile unknown before clearing/repeating, and never overwrite an open draft with refresh or a newer projection with an older result.

Participant change context contains only source-approved timing/applicability, not internal actors/rationale/other work/audit. Current target/history/errors/receipts and late caches retain independent field authority and minimal schedules.

Q46 creates no notice default, reminder cadence, escalation, acknowledgment or blanket Off rule. Existing qualified effects retain pins/current utility and durable recovery; refresh/mail failure cannot undo the target or justify duplicate sends.

Actual source profile and retained-data census precede activation. No legacy backfill from today's task date or guessed zone; mixed clients/restore preserve meaning/adverse history and safe independent intake/review. Qualify finite workload and real date/AT/mobile/race/role tests rather than claims from synthetic models.

requirements.title: Withdraw exact pending participant evidence with precise controls
requirements.text: As a participant, I want to withdraw my mistakenly supplied pending contribution without replacement, so that staff stop considering it while the original receipt remains truthful.

acceptance.text: Recipient self-service withdrawal starts Enabled only in the qualified profile; tenant control may require staff help by setting this action Off. A qualified source default may resolve without a redundant tenant row; unresolved policy is not Enabled.

Current effective policy/generation applies at admission after waits. Off-first blocks new recipient withdrawal; committed acts remain. Off does not block independent correction/read/original-result recovery or re-offer; On does not execute an old uncommitted intent across intervening change.

Accepted/frozen/F/canceled/No-longer-required or otherwise ineligible targets cannot withdraw ordinarily. Staff viewing/preparing is not an acceptance lock; Checking/quarantine/no preview does not itself bar a safely identified lawful withdrawal or establish incident exemption.

All-received evidence waiting for staff may still qualify; Q46's outstanding-recipient-work predicate is not borrowed. Unknown receipt/current target/authority is resolved or blocked, not inferred from an empty list.

requirements.title: Assist withdrawal without impersonation or changing other work
requirements.text: As authorized assistance staff, I want to withdraw the same eligible participant contribution truthfully, so that help remains possible without borrowing the participant's credentials or fabricating their act.

acceptance.text: Participant Off does not grant/remove independent staff power. Staff may act after participant access ends only under their own current source authority; no manufactured grant, request or affirmation.

Durable withdrawal removes only current consideration and advances affected evidence/review basis; retain receipt, immutable version, participant attribution, original timing/instructions, decisions and history. Late processing cannot restore candidacy.

Requirement, sufficient siblings and independent uses keep actual meaning. Withdrawal is not rejection/waiver/removal/cancel/F/deadline change/refusal; withdrawing a correction never revives its predecessor.

Exact semantic withdrawal/re-offer commits membership/lineage/history/result/required follow-through coherently. Matching committed recovery precedes new-state/no-op logic; stale ABA/changed intent conflicts and a recovered older act cannot overwrite current display.

Relevant acceptance/correction/requirement/closure/policy/recipient/custody races are ordered both ways. A pending correction after withdrawal cannot silently become a new re-offer; preserve lawful input and require reviewed fresh admission. Unrelated accepted work/review/proof/readiness is not reset.

requirements.title: Offer the same retained contribution again as new supply
requirements.text: As a participant who withdrew by mistake, I want to offer the same permitted retained file again, so that recovery does not require downloading and uploading it unnecessarily.
requirements.basis: Q47 paragraphs 9–13; Q56 whole-unit extensions; REQ29-P05–P08/P12/P16.

acceptance.text: Preserve original receipt/withdrawal and link/attribute the new candidate use/time. No fabricated upload, backdating, copied approval or old timely receipt concealing current resupply timing.

Current instructions/statements/freshness/safety/cardinality and target terms apply. Only profile-qualified post-admission work may remain Checking. Existing technical evidence can be reused where current rules permit; no known-malicious material becomes eligible by re-offer.

Required new reference/protection is established against disposal claims with current exact custody/integrity. Missing/disposed/deletion-claimed/prohibited bytes are not restored/fetched by fallback. No new copy/scan/clock reset is required solely for otherwise eligible retained bytes.

No later correction/current sibling is silently displaced and no one-file limit is invented. One re-offer effect per actual withdrawal lineage survives concurrent keys/retries; a later withdrawal has its own current identity and old cycles cannot resurrect it.

Incompatible statements/instructions/restrictions/bytes require the real current new-supply or source-remediation path, not silent omission/powerless Help. Current same-lineage assembly changes remain separately reviewed whole-unit admission, not unchanged Q47 revival.

requirements.title: Preserve staff resupply and actual review effects
requirements.text: As staff helping recover withdrawn evidence, I want assistance to retain truthful provenance and review work, so that the system does not pretend the participant re-submitted or send duplicate notices.

acceptance.text: Current Q24 work/My Work projections reflect the new actual basis independently of optional communication.

Q27's existing opt-in cohort includes a genuine recipient re-offer that first makes a new current evidence/review basis actionable. Use its new available-again facts, not replay of original receipt or a fictitious upload; preserve all original policy/cohort/material/utility/Off/retry/dedup rules.
Technical readiness restoration, duplicate recovery and no-op create no new notice occurrence. Q28 staff additions retain their own binding.

Withdrawal fences only affected work/effects under each existing purpose's utility; it does not automatically stop Q40 awareness of a still-required item or select a new notice, bell, reminder, acknowledgment or blanket Off default.

requirements.title: Show withdrawal history and durable recovery without an archive grant
requirements.text: As a participant or reviewer, I want clear withdrawn/current states and a persistent recovery action, so that I understand remaining work without being promised deletion or access to every old file.

acceptance.text: Before final Withdraw, name the exact contribution/consequence and provide Cancel. Explain remaining need and retained received record; no erasure/recall promise, forced replacement/preview/full account, routine essay, second approver or confirmation ritual.

Qualified Offer again is persistently discoverable, not only a disappearing toast. Checking/Withdrawn/no current contribution/still-required/blocked/unavailable remain distinct; reviewers retain reading position rather than silent file switching.

Safe metadata distinguishes same-name units. If insufficient, actual capable source help replaces blind confirmation or extra disclosure. Current permission applies to all status/history/result/byte/header/range/stream doors.

Keyboard/speech/AT/touch/zoom/narrow reflow/long names/RTL/IME, focus/errors/restrained status and weak-network recovery qualify. Unknown reconciles before retry; a committed success is not failure because refresh failed. No offline queue or late-context overwrite.

Withdrawal does not delete copies/indexes, release holds, cancel independently necessary safety processing or prove nobody read the file. Minimal private business history is distinct from safe telemetry; no indefinite retention is created.

requirements.title: Qualify withdrawal and repeated recovery cycles at the source boundary
requirements.text: As the ordinary source operator, I want exact lineage and current-state enforcement, so that new clients, old retries or restored data cannot duplicate resupply or revive withdrawn evidence.

acceptance.text: All effective native-role/DML/function/worker/restore doors use the actual source/P12 boundary or are closed. The tenant guard alone does not prove source wiring or a multi-RPC transaction.

Bound indexed current/operation/history and set-wise actor/projection reads under actual P12 exceptions, without per-click full history, keystroke writes, mandatory polling/Realtime or invented zero-cost claims.

Census old source data/writers, preserving unknown provenance; absent rows/cancel/hidden UI/deletion are not historical withdrawal. Mixed clients preserve or reject unknown lineage, and restore applies adverse facts before serving/selecting.

Native both-order source/custody/policy races, repeated cycles/original replay, finite budgets, capable privacy help and actual user/mobile/AT recovery qualify before activation. Safe disable/roll-forward preserves independent work and immutable outcomes.

requirements.title: Remind only actual recipient work through the qualified email purpose
requirements.text: As staff responsible for a request, I want optional reminders for actual remaining recipient actions, so that we do not chase evidence already awaiting our own review.
requirements.basis: Q48 paragraphs 1–3; Document Request Reminder Plan; REQ29-P01/P02/P09.

acceptance.text: Actual recipient work, exact recipient/purpose and current usefulness control admission. Optional items do not become demand or hold fulfillment; lawful native work remains usable when optional mail/setup is unavailable.

Tenant automatic reminders initially Off. Qualified deliberate enablement seeds new eligible issued requests unless authorized staff chooses no plan; drafts send nothing and existing requests are not automatically enrolled.

Suggested captured defaults are 7 calendar days, 3 lifetime automatic occurrences and local 09:00 in an explicitly reviewed qualified IANA zone. Tenant values permit integer interval 1–30 days, total 1–10 and local minute; absolute ceiling is 10 automatic occurrences per issued request across revisions, never unlimited.

Defaults are copied plan settings, not live hard ceilings on old plans. Broader current source/contact/operational gates still narrow. No holiday engine, per-item/per-request numeric cadence editor or automatic escalation.

Tenant management requires actual source-policy and applicable automation:manage/declarative/synthetic-preview/activity-log gates. Preview/test creates no real event/history/intent/provider call. The source service acts under current authority, not impersonated creator session; creator departure alone is not policy revocation.

requirements.title: Manage separate tenant, staff and recipient automatic-reminder controls
requirements.text: As staff or the intended recipient, I want reminder controls to state their exact scope, so that stopping automatic reminders does not accidentally cancel the request or silence unrelated contact.

acceptance.text: Tenant Off fences affected automatic admissions and every later call/retry, preserving intervening generations even without a worker. Re-enable seeds new requests but does not resume old stopped plans; explicit authorized Resume is required.

Request Pause preserves settings/history/count. Resume is fresh current authority and full interval, never old occurrence revival or count reset, and cannot override tenant Off, recipient Stop or broader contact restrictions.

Manual reminders remain independently available under automatic Off/pause/cap exhaustion, subject to current purpose/contact, active lane and shared spacing. A future scheduled date cannot reserve the lane all week or require an extra essay/approver.

Current source-proved recipient may Stop automatic reminders and deliberately allow them again. This is not withdrawal, waiver, cancel, reading revocation, broad unsubscribe or suppression of independently lawful staff contact. Staff/tenant/profile/new work cannot clear that recipient stop.

Recipient allow-again clears only their own stop and never enrolls an unconfigured request or clears other stops. If an already configured plan becomes eligible, begin a fresh full interval, not an overdue immediate slot. GET/scanners cannot mutate; missing proof uses real permitted assistance, not a fabricated recipient act or contact-policy bypass.

requirements.title: Schedule finite calendar opportunities independently of requested-by
requirements.text: As staff inspecting a reminder plan, I want a clear next opportunity and time zone, so that date changes, daylight-saving transitions and missed jobs do not produce surprise bursts.

acceptance.text: Nominal opportunity is anchor local date plus interval at captured local minute, no earlier than 24 elapsed hours after both anchor and latest possible Q48 provider-call admission. Advance an early nominal time to the next normal daily slot satisfying both floors.

Resolve folds to the later instant and gaps to the first valid instant at/after the local time, recording it without duplicate skipped-date slots. Do not infer recipient geography/quiet hours or promise exact 24-hour days.

Automatic calls are admitted only during `[resolved opportunity, opportunity + 60 elapsed minutes)`. Normal delay inside the window is allowed; endpoint is too late. Preparation/queue/retry cannot extend it.

Expired or multiple missed slots coalesce to one next future normal daily opportunity, never immediate overdue delivery or one message per missed slot. Show actual next opportunity/zone rather than an invented catch-up schedule.

requirements.title: Coordinate counts and manual overlap at possible-send admission
requirements.text: As a recipient or records operator, I want attempts counted honestly and duplicate reminders prevented, so that retries or manual help cannot reset the automatic limit.

acceptance.text: Rejected/failed/unknown possible sends remain used; timeout/callback absence cannot refund. Release reservation only after original is durably uncallable and no possible-call fence ever crossed. Same-occurrence retries count once; this is attempted-automatic usage, not delivered mail.

New distinct Q48 manual/automatic occurrences share a 24-elapsed-hour floor from latest possible call. Manual does not consume automatic total. Every possible call, including permitted follow-up, advances latest-call and the automatic waiting anchor with captured cadence, without clearing stops or creating another occurrence.
Same-envelope follow-ups remain the original occurrence under actual P6 allowance; the distinct-occurrence floor itself neither authorizes nor prohibits them.

While original is callable/pending, concurrent attempts return its permitted state or safe conflict, not another reservation. Once its original finite window closes, retain unknown outcome/used count but free the lane for a genuinely later qualifying act; never rekey the old uncertainty.

No count reset, budget recycling, request recreation or split identity evades the bound. These are Q48 controls, not a promise of one total email per day across independent purposes; Q60 corrective-request exclusions remain explicit.

requirements.title: Keep reminder usefulness and action routes current
requirements.text: As a recipient, I want a reminder that leads to work I can actually do, so that an old publication or expired grant does not become a misleading upload instruction.

acceptance.text: Persist real no-work transitions and proved stops even without scheduler observation. Partial receipt does not automatically end a still-useful cue or reset all work. Reminders never change source acceptance/removal/F/withdrawal facts.
The first cohort requires an actual currently available submit/correct/resupply route. Recipient need not be online or already proved when mail is considered; qualified proof may occur on landing.

Expired access/unknown capability/no valid action cannot mint access, force signup, show upload-looking CTA or substitute improvised information/help content. Block/suppress appropriately and expose actual staff/source access repair; future help-only variants require separate qualification.

Recheck current work, actor/service, tenant/plan/recipient stop generation, contact/privacy and action/material at admission and every call after waits. Automatic-only controls do not stop independent manual purposes. Proved stops cannot disappear after On/new work/restore; unknown blocks without inventing a terminal fact.
Preserve possible in-flight send truth without recall. Q20/Q26/Q31/Q35/Q40 and lawful staff handling keep their own current purposes; Q48 incapability is no blanket communication stop.

requirements.title: Release and recover the exact bounded reminder material
requirements.text: As an operator diagnosing reminder delivery, I want one original source and communication result, so that uncertainty does not generate another recipient, body or send.

acceptance.text: One exact Live P17/P6 contract compiles/releases the complete bounded plan atomically, including proved zero only where permitted. Unknown/partial is not zero; feature code cannot loop committed child sends, pick generic templates or call provider directly.

Immutable recipient/material/account/environment/connection/provider pins and permanent occurrence identity govern recovery. Signed/correlated duplicate/out-of-order evidence cannot reopen/refund/reroute or prove human completion. Work lease/provider windows are not business deduplication.
Only P6's already-qualified indeterminate same-envelope retry classes and at most two follow-up HTTP calls after initial apply, within every earlier deadline; no new entitlement.

Prepared material maximum is 24 elapsed hours from first immutable preparation, clipped by earlier source/action/privacy/provider limits. Manual source occurrence independently ends no later than 24 hours from original admission; later preparation cannot extend it. Automatic original 60-minute window dominates all later calls.

Initial readable Recent ceiling is zero. Body-free history and protected minimal correlation/stop evidence follow actual policies; no financial/staff duration borrowing, fabricated Party, logged body or support-copy prerequisite. Any future reveal/material expansion is separately qualified.

requirements.title: Keep plans and repair source-owned rather than another scheduler platform
requirements.text: As the responsible tenant/source operator, I want blocked plans and uncertain attempts to be repairable, so that optional reminders do not require SQL or produce a fresh failure every day.

acceptance.text: Actual source/P12 roles and every native/worker/import/restore door qualify; a client setting, service token or workflow tenant guard is not authority. One source mutation protocol, not a collection of separately guarded RPCs, proves coherence.

Keep one next candidate per plan, bounded indexed current/history/set-wise reads and fair tenant work. No polling every file, missed-slot enumeration, full-history-per-tick scan, mandatory Realtime or new scheduler/vendor.

Setup/material/action/contact/delivery faults reach actual source/P17/P6 owners. Temporary enrolled plans may remain visibly quiet/blocked; real stops remain stopped. Repair original while callable or close truthfully and permit only future qualified acts, preserving counts/deadlines.

No infinite retry, daily zero-failure occurrence, silent lost diagnosis or generic inbox. Cap exhaustion only stops new automatic admissions; request/native work and independently lawful manual reminder after its floor remain usable.

Prevention gates cover authority/privacy/utility/identity/cap/spacing/irreversible stops. Monitor confirmed violations or actual qualified threshold breaches with accountable containment/repair; no unmeasured cost/latency claims or monitor-only safety compromise.

requirements.title: Present reminders as one understandable request area
requirements.text: As staff or the recipient, I want reminder settings and results to explain what will happen, so that I can control courtesy email without mistaking it for source progress.

acceptance.text: Eligible Start/Pause/Resume/Use current settings/Send reminder have clear target/consequence and one deliberate final act, not a new rich composer, essay or duplicate confirmation. Default edits identify future-plan scope; applying settings shows new timing and retained count.

Field/menu/preview changes do not send. Recipient Stop explains that work may remain and authorized staff contact may occur; it is not unsubscribe/waiver/deletion and requires neither unnecessary full account nor file preview.

Minimal identity, descriptive protected action and plain-text/images-off/localized rendering work with international names, zone labels, RTL/IME/keyboard/speech/AT/reflow/focus/status. Slow networks preserve lawful input and original-result recovery, never queued offline sends or late-context disclosure.

Prospective census/rollout never infers enrollment/consent/counts/work transitions/stops from emails/task times/missing rows. Qualify actual source/contact/race/DST/skipped-date/late-wake/cap/lane/material-window/provider/restore behavior, native users and production-shaped workloads; safe disable preserves independent manual/native work.

requirements.title: Give an exact evidence use one optional staff display name
requirements.text: As authorized staff, I want a useful shared staff display name, so that I can recognize an evidence entry without renaming its original or changing what the participant sees.

acceptance.text: Participant/public/donor/missionary/Q41 purposes exclude the staff field even for a human who also holds a staff role. Enforce before matching/rank/count/order/suggestion/serialization/AT/browser title/cache/error/print/export/delivery, not CSS hiding.
Staff exports/history include it only through their exact current purpose. Existing source-approved participant identification remains; no new editable recipient-name field or audience toggle.

Naming does not change exact bytes/version/digest, receipt actor/time, instructions/lineage/acceptance/currentness/work/access/retention, embedded metadata, storage or sealed output. Staff name, permitted received provenance and qualified delivery name are distinct; never recover discarded names from keys/headers/other uses.

A safer name is not original redaction. Q44 member/manifest and sealed packages remain unchanged; no automatic delivery substitution. Duplicate names are valid and disambiguated by permitted source context, not uniqueness or a forged type/status suffix.

Source rules may permit admitted Checking/rejected/accepted/historical/withdrawn/terminal retained uses, but status grants nothing and actual freeze/privacy/disposal restrictions win. Edit needs current inspect-basis and change power, not uploader/rank/folder/reviewer status.

requirements.title: Set, clear and correct the name without blind overwrite
requirements.text: As a naming editor, I want optional Set/Edit/Clear and safe conflict recovery, so that clearing a field is understandable and a hidden value is not accidentally overwritten.

acceptance.text: Empty/whitespace-only canonical input deliberately means Clear under the documented normalization; Cancel is inert. Current authority and expected naming basis precede complete-value no-op, with no new business revision/event/notice while required security evidence remains.
Same-use status changes preserve name. Every new Q03/Q28/replacement/Q47/Q49 evidence use starts unnamed; equal bytes/name/item or carried home cannot inherit it.

Use one bounded single-line plain-text contract with declared UTF-8/text units and source-qualified limits. Preserve meaningful Unicode/case/RTL/IME, handle prohibited controls/spoofing intelligibly and isolate direction; no silent truncate/transliterate/translate/markup execution or arbitrary filesystem limit.

Coherently commit value/absence, naming basis, restricted history/result and required projection follow-through. Relevant expected revision defeats stale A→B→A while unrelated source edits need not conflict; current source restriction still fences.

Recover original admitted effect before new work under current disclosure; changed intent conflicts, old retry cannot overwrite newer name. Correction/any Undo is a fresh current edit, not history rollback. Equal true no-ops leave revision valid for later genuine edits; required minimal replay evidence survives readable-history expiry or stale work rejects.

requirements.title: Project staff names consistently without copying them into history or search authority
requirements.text: As a staff reader or privacy operator, I want current safe naming in lists and review, so that a renamed row remains recognizable without leaking prior private text.

acceptance.text: Restrictive changes fence serving before cleanup. Preserve lawful focus/selection/return by exact use when sort/filter membership changes; no stale private text retained to keep a row visible or completeness claimed from failed coverage.

Native same-scope optional-name/current-basis/history relationships, bounded values and immutable attribution apply through every door. Generic assets JSON/public serializers or CMS filenames are not qualified private storage; no name/digest uniqueness or evidence cascade.

Old/new history values have their own current rights/schedules. Naming never rewrites old receipt/message meaning; logs/analytics/crash reports omit authored/received names and associations. Source minimization/holds/disposal and adverse-first restore apply to values/history/indexes/exports.

Census/rollout initializes no authored value without a proved existing source fact; permitted fallback does not duplicate provenance into a new authority. Fence mixed generic serializers, preserve admitted facts and independent work, and repair forward rather than grant broad admin fallback.

requirements.title: Edit staff naming in one accessible small flow
requirements.text: As staff editing a display name, I want clear optional-field copy and persistent recovery, so that a normal naming mistake does not require a new screen, preview or approval process.

acceptance.text: No mandatory reason, repeated confirmation, naming convention, dedicated naming screen, audience switch or new naming notice. Independently qualified effects keep their contracts and cannot carry an unauthorized staff name.

Saving/saved/failed/conflict/unknown differ. Preserve lawful proposals and current permitted context on conflict for a new deliberate save; network cancellation is not proof no save. Essential status and recovery persist beyond a toast.

Focus returns to the invoking control or stable meaningful fallback after reordering/removal. Full identification/actions do not require hover; keyboard/pointer/speech/AT/320-CSS-pixel reflow/zoom/international names/RTL/IME and weak-network tasks qualify. Blur/typing/IME confirmation does not save, while focused button activation remains usable.

Use existing small source/UI seams without AI naming/translation/parser/Realtime/per-user aliases or byte copies. Qualify finite input/history/query/retry/storage budgets, staff-to-participant identification and native/privacy/race/restore tests; no free-operation or measured-benefit claim without evidence.

requirements.title: Choose one qualified colleague for a saved comment
requirements.text: As a qualified staff colleague, I want to request attention to a saved comment, so that I can direct useful review context without assigning work or granting access.
requirements.basis: Q51 paragraphs 1–3; Document Review Attention Request; REQ29-P01/P02/P04.

acceptance.text: Requester needs current comment-create permission plus exact current comment/context read, but need not be author/reviewer. Target needs independently qualified same-Tenant staff read of that comment/context, not comment-create or original-file access. Preview readiness is not a prerequisite.

Native stable identity and exact qualified assignment/role/access, including supported no-Party staff, govern. Names/emails/profile/team/forged Party grant nothing; no invitation, assignment or participant/Q41 disclosure follows.

Bounded picker reveals only discoverable identity/disambiguation. Each human resolves to one qualified concrete delivery context; permitted context selection may resolve ambiguity, never role union/fallback/multiple projections. No self-target, arbitrary address/group/hidden target or automatic first selection.

Empty results, lookup failure and denial have privacy-safe distinct recovery without revealing memberships/preferences. Requester departure alone does not cancel a committed act; actual source/grantor dependencies remain.

requirements.title: Atomically add one attention result for the semantic slot
requirements.text: As staff using Notify, I want one durable local result and safe retry, so that duplicate clicks or a lost response cannot create repeated alerts or a falsely successful queue entry.

acceptance.text: Read/archive/expiry/preference/regrant/deployment/restore cannot reset the slot. A genuine later active revision, including lawful Restore, may be explicitly notified; edits/follow-ups never auto-notify and no-op creates no revision. Same-content renewed attention uses meaningful new follow-up or qualified coordination, not fake editing/cooldown.

Admission validates trusted context, current exact revision, reviewed target/access/control basis after waits. Off→On or replaced authority makes old unadmitted intent stale despite current On; require fresh deliberate basis without silent rekey.

One enclosing local transaction commits unique attention/history/result plus actual transaction-scoped P6 complete one-member/one-in-product-step compilation/release and local available event/P17 projection. Parent release precedes materialization; no private child bypass or independently committed partial plan.

Success requires exactly one eligible local result, not zero/rejected/unresolved compilation. Failure rolls back the entire attention act while preserving the separately saved comment. No durable accepted-but-unavailable worker queue, provider/email gate or new delivery timer is introduced.

Matching committed command recovers under current disclosure before new eligibility; changed immutable intent conflicts. Another current command for the same slot returns minimal Already requested without rewriting requester or exposing their private receipt. Stale revision conflicts; unknown/browser cancellation is not rollback. Never rehash old slots during migration.

requirements.title: Present informational attention with fixed original bounds
requirements.text: As a colleague receiving attention, I want a useful informational cue and accurate aging, so that it never masquerades as an assignment, read receipt or permanent access grant.

acceptance.text: Unread ends at earliest read, archive, actual correction/supersession, qualified optional-control stop or available_at+30 days. Authorized recent ends at original available_at+90 days, enforced on reads even if purge is late. Activity/settings/Restore cannot extend either.

Safe cue identifies attention and independently permitted requester/source context with View comment. Comment author and requester are distinct; no copied body/file/geometry/staff-name/private detail enters a generic broader payload.

Current field/source authority covers lists/counts/search/hover/AT/cache/export/diagnostics/destination. Staff/participant contexts never union rights; presentation cannot mutate comment/evidence/responsibility/access.

Availability, engagement and source facts remain independent. A click/available/read/archive response proves no human awareness, reply, acceptance/F/review completion. No deadline/reminder/approval/Resolve/read-receipt duty is added.

requirements.title: Apply precise controls and source-current attention endings
requirements.text: As a recipient or tenant administrator, I want the optional attention preference to stop only its intended presentation, so that reenabling it cannot replay old alerts or erase access restrictions.
requirements.basis: Q51 paragraphs 8–9; scoped P17 informational-ending amendment; REQ29-P04/P08/P09.

acceptance.text: Known Off before admission creates no slot/cue. Off after availability ends unread without fake Read/Archive, preserving only authorized recent within original 90-day bound. On never backfills/re-alerts/resets slots; intervening Off history persists even between reads. Private preference reasons are not disclosed to requester.

Any actual later visible Q45 text/location revision, withdrawal or source-purpose end ends old unread/action applicability; no semantic importance classifier. Canonical no-op changes no revision. Restore/new revision cannot revive old occurrence.
Loss of the bound access revision removes active and recent immediately; later authority does not transfer/revive it. Temporary evaluation failure blocks serving but does not prove permanent loss.

F/cancel/requester departure/preview expiry alone is not a blanket stop; actual continuing comment purpose governs. Navigation stays on same immutable use/version/comment, explains changed-since-notification current text or lawful unavailable/withdrawn state, and grants no historic text/new bytes/fabricated location.

requirements.title: Make Notify simple and mistakes proportionately recoverable
requirements.text: As staff directing attention, I want clear selection and result language, so that I can recover uncertainty or a wrong eligible target without reposting a valid comment.

acceptance.text: Show Notifying in flight, Notification added only after proved atomic availability, and Already requested for this version of the comment without seen/read claims. Unknown offers Check status or identical safe retry; current rejection has a permitted next step, never silent redirect or false success.

Essential status/recovery persists near the action beyond a toast. Disabled/no match/lookup failure/stale comment/changed target/technical failure stay intelligible without hidden preference or membership disclosure.

No sender Recall or post-admission Undo platform. Wrong but eligible colleague creates no business debt/access; notify the correct different eligible colleague separately without repost, while original recipient uses normal read/archive.
Actual privacy abuse uses scoped source correction/serving-stop with evidence, not forced valid-comment withdrawal, engagement erasure or a fresh occurrence disguising failed projection repair.

Shared Base UI keyboard/speech/AT/touch/non-drag/focus/long-name/localized-time/RTL/IME/320-CSS-pixel tasks work; no hover-only/color-only/autoplay/forced-navigation/download behavior. Preserve lawful input, fence context changes and avoid private offline write queues. Attention outage does not disable commenting/review.

requirements.title: Qualify the small native attention producer without a new platform
requirements.text: As the source and communication operator, I want the local attention contract to be verifiable and bounded, so that a demo bell or generic mention helper cannot be mistaken for secure delivery.

acceptance.text: Source history, body-free P6 facts, bounded P17 preview/engagement and telemetry remain distinct; sender sees no recipient read/archive receipt. Retain only lawful minimal replay mappings/tombstones or reject unverifiable old work, not permanent readable private text or a new person-matching engine.

One new act has one target, one plan member and at most one available result, independent of file size; this does not bound aggregate traffic. Qualify finite picker/query/page/history/input/transaction/lock/retry/retention/abuse budgets and sparse/dense workloads, including repeated revisions and independent targets.

Use indexed set-wise filtering and stable keyset ties, no N+1 permission/network loops, global counts/full-center reload or document-body corpus. No new mention graph/notification center/Realtime/provider/parser/rich editor/digest scheduler is required.

Census/fence old writers and use one projection authority. Never backfill @text/Support notes/finance tasks/old queues as new attention or fabricate unread history. Restores/rollbacks retain original slots/later stops; scoped stop preserves saved comments and lawful history.

Native real-role atomic rollback/current-control order/replay/revision/access-race/numeric-presentation/private-navigation and actual staff/AT tests are required. Demo bell, model or source inspection is not passed qualification; material failures block activation and residual monitoring has actual signals/owners/responses.

requirements.title: Select finite ordinary items for one deliberate acceptance action
requirements.text: As an authorized reviewer, I want to accept selected reviewed items within one request, so that I can group a few decisions without changing what each acceptance means.

acceptance.text: Begin with no selection. Submit a nonempty finite set of unique item IDs and reviewed bases in one Tenant/environment/request/purpose; empty/duplicate/conflicting/malformed/over-limit sets reject without business effects. Cosmetic order does not change intent.

Preserve explicit same-request selection across filter/sort/pages with visible total and reachable View selected. Select all, if offered, means eligible displayed rows at that instant; Deselect shown affects that finite scope, Clear affects the whole local set.

Never include unseen pages/future uploads/newly eligible rows or all matches implicitly. Newly restricted/changed members cannot silently disappear or be replaced to produce a smaller submission; keep only disclosable context and require deliberate repair.
Existing source/tenant roles apply; no admin-only setting, personal reviewer claim, new settings matrix or compulsory second reviewer.

requirements.title: Preserve actual per-item inspection, concerns and current authority
requirements.text: As a reviewer, I want every selected decision to retain its exact review basis, so that selection cannot stand in for inspection or silently clear a different concern.

acceptance.text: No per-file approval, compulsory preview/download click, essay or routine extra modal is required. Unsupported preview needs an actually sufficient authorized accessible inspection alternative; controls alone do not make inaccessible content reviewable. Required unknown/failed safety proof blocks.

One actual staff actor holds acceptance power for every new decision and context, including qualified no-Party staff. Do not union several people's rights or infer from responsibility/team/read/folder/task/grant. Actual separation rules remain; Q25 issuance readiness is not repeated each review.

Bind source/requirement/instruction/complete evidence/relevant clarification/comment/concern/authority dependencies, including Q45 text/location/withdraw/Restore. Exact structural relevance, not an importance classifier or global request revision, determines conflict.

Expected basis detects away-and-back changes despite equal bytes/status. Correction/withdrawal-first fences predecessor; acceptance-first preserves its actual consequences. Unrelated naming/filing/comments/items do not universally conflict, but aggregate dependencies remain.

requirements.title: Commit all new selected decisions together and recover the original
requirements.text: As staff submitting selected acceptances, I want a coherent outcome even when another reviewer acts, so that partial new approval or duplicate attribution cannot be hidden by retry.

acceptance.text: All-existing exact current recognition returns no-new-work Already accepted under current source/result authority even after F, without acceptance/F/notice/reopen. Cancellation/adverse/lost applicability permits only lawful closed/history/unavailable output, not historical acceptance promoted to present satisfaction.

If terminal state wins while any new decision remains, none are admitted. Independent previous acceptances stay true. Bytes-only/item-digest permanence cannot prevent a later qualified same-evidence reassessment; no new Undo/invalidation authority.

One real enclosing database transaction commits all new acceptances, required state/history/result and durable follow-through, or none. No per-item best-effort loop, hidden chunks, independent SDK commits, compensation unaccept or async approval job; actual stable ordering/revalidation/retry is bounded, not whole-Tenant locked.

Matching original committed effect recovers under current disclosure before fresh eligibility; changed selected meaning conflicts. Overlapping reviewers/new keys cannot duplicate Q21 effects. Unknown original reconciles before smaller selection, successor basis or new key; browser abort/navigation is not rollback.

Infrastructure retry keeps exact intent and re-proves current dependencies, never rebases a business conflict. Late/expired/restored work cannot become fresh effect; known success with failed refresh stays known. Expensive inspection/processing/providers remain outside locks.

requirements.title: Show item outcomes and source fulfillment honestly
requirements.text: As a reviewer or permitted participant, I want clear per-item and whole-request results, so that a grouped action never exaggerates what was accepted or completed.

acceptance.text: Do not infer F from filtered count/empty list, add Complete, backdate F or erase acceptance on projection failure. Explain possible source end/access consequence inline without stale guarantees; post-participant-expiry staff review does not renew access.
Existing Q27/Q40/Q48/Q51 and other purposes retain exact utility/stops/dedup. No new email/reminder/attention/task-per-item or blanket suppression follows.

Labeled selection, current evidence context, View selected, Clear and Accept selected (N) are sufficient; no required page/modal. Distinguish local selected/submitting/newly accepted/existing exact/no-new-effect failure/unknown. Say no new acceptances by this action, not none accepted when independent decisions exist.

Unknown result offers original checking/recovery, not a new Submit. Preserve lawful notes/reading/focus/selection; confirmed success may clear accepted selection while persistent results remain, never clear unknown work or guess the next item. Independent work need not freeze.

Newly hidden members/counts/reasons cannot leak through failure/readback. Participants see only their source-approved status, not staff selection/concerns. Keyboard checkbox Space/IME Enter do not submit; focused action does. Controls/summary reflow at 320 CSS pixels, sticky actions do not hide focus, and meaningful AT status avoids flooding.

requirements.title: Qualify selected review and its real remediation
requirements.text: As the source operator, I want review grouping to preserve native integrity and recoverable mistakes, so that bulk convenience cannot bypass existing source decisions or leave staff without a lawful remedy.

acceptance.text: Every effective role/schema/table/column/sequence/EXECUTE/DML/RETURNING/view/function/trigger/worker/Storage/restore door is qualified or closed under the one P12 authority; code/call-site checks alone are insufficient.

Positive finite numeric selection/command/result/query/transaction/lock/retry/follow-through-age/history budgets and stable unique keyset paging are bound before activation. No unset cap, silent split/truncate, full tenant-history scan or N-per-file byte fetch; over-limit offers deliberate smaller/individual action.

Exact independently accepted attribution survives grouping/departure. Restricted history, security audit, safe traces and provider evidence remain distinct. Local selection can Clear; committed mistakes use Q60/actual source privacy remediation with capable independently authorized actors, never fake upload/SQL/universal Undo.

Additive schema/readback precedes UI; old unsafe paths fence. Never backfill human review from scan/task/legacy accepted flags or old partial loops. Stop new grouped admission preserves original recovery/decisions/follow-through and safe individual route; roll-forward/restore cannot re-emit effects.

requirements.title: Upload new staff evidence with truthful source provenance
requirements.text: As authorized staff holding a newly received local file, I want to add it directly to the eligible item, so that assistance does not force a recipient reupload or falsely attribute the upload to them.

acceptance.text: Trusted native staff/context, including qualified no-Party paths, supplies exact item/requirement/subject/purpose/version and actual occurrence. Record true staff contribution/durable receipt, never participant-attributed Submission Confirmation, affirmation or approval.

Receipt time comes from trusted admission after waits, not browser start/email/file metadata or a future unknowable commit timestamp. Verified private staging before admission is not request receipt; staff departure alone does not erase valid history.

Offer Upload file beside Add existing in context, with permitted target/instructions/file identity and one Upload and add authorizing exact preparation/transfer/finalization. No routine second completion click/modal/essay/account; local removal is inert.

Preserve lawful input only under its own purpose. Insufficient permitted target identification needs capable safe selection, not blind add/broader disclosure. Changed target/bytes/relevant terms require deliberate repair, never retargeting.

requirements.title: Verify private staff intake and close every late-write path
requirements.text: As the evidence source owner, I want received staff bytes sealed before admission, so that a live grant or delayed upload cannot overwrite accepted identity or evade cleanup safeguards.

acceptance.text: Prove actual ingress/resource bounds and independent completion, rather than assuming a generic signed token enforces custom size/type/digest claims. Verify object identity/completeness/size/content/integrity plus current source eligibility; browser MIME/ETag/callback/URL is insufficient.

Seal exact immutable bytes against all grants/endpoints/retries/writers and settled in-flight work. Never reuse retired keys or treat a successful upload as consuming every still-usable capability. Late data stays tracked private preparation, not new receipt or overwrite.

Abort/source revoke/token expiry are distinct from closed write authority. Cleanup needs current source/custody disposition, retention and complete use/hold/processor coverage, fenced against finalization/references, with all writes closed and settled before safe disposal.

No delete-on-catch, token-expiry-only purge or empty-visible-use inference. Expired cleanup lease cannot reopen promotion while deletion may finish; preserve exact delete-generation fence until original outcome reconciles. Provider bytes are not disposed by metadata SQL.
No public bucket/URL, metadata-only insert or specialized avatar/official-artifact route substitutes for ordinary intake. A single qualified adapter may suffice; no forced second copy/store.

requirements.title: Admit staff supply coherently and recover exact original work
requirements.text: As staff adding evidence, I want an exact durable result despite interrupted transfer or concurrent review, so that retry does not duplicate contributions or erase a successful admission.

acceptance.text: Failed source admission reports actual staged/denied state with owned safe cleanup, never another target/reopened request/dropped predecessor. A private object arriving is not commit.

Matching original reconciles before repeat transfer/add or fresh lifecycle checks, under current disclosure. Terminal state cannot turn known original success into a failed new attempt; callbacks/keys/jobs do not duplicate intake effects, while deliberate distinct source acts are not collapsed by equal bytes.

Transfer-grant expiry, source-intent expiry and current eligibility are separate. Exact valid incomplete transfer may resume without needless retransfer; no exactly-once physical-storage promise. Unknown is neither success nor rollback/deletion authority.

Recheck relevant instruction/evidence/comment/clarification/authority/current source after waits/retries without rebase. Q03/Q23/Q28/Q33/Q34/Q36/Q37/Q45/Q47/Q49/Q21/Q52/Q22 changes use actual structural dependencies, preserving independent evidence.

Picker/transfer/Checking is no hidden fulfillment hold. Closed/frozen/removed target rejects new admission while earlier receipts remain true. Source admission/cancel/removal order, not last response, determines outcome; ABA is not equal current basis.

requirements.title: Distinguish staff processing, removal and review
requirements.text: As a supplying staff member or reviewer, I want clear technical and source states, so that unsafe material cannot be accepted and a mistaken addition has a lawful remedy.

acceptance.text: Quarantined/unsafe/unknown required-check bytes do not become readable/acceptable through rank. Preserve originals/derivatives and actual format coverage; no OCR/conversion/every-format expansion.

After admission, qualified workers/reviewers may continue independently of uploader session/read rights, subject to current restrictions. Later adverse findings preserve receipt/review history while actual source/safety repair applies, not silent deletion/unaccept/predecessor revival/reopen.

Addition preserves actual cardinality and never silently overwrites other contributions/uses. Qualified Remove from this item applies to the exact unaccepted staff upload, preserving receipt/removal history/shared bytes. Pre-admission Stop upload that loses to admission returns the known result and actual source remedy.
