Safe removal plus new Upload/Add existing is complete recovery; any offered replacement must use Q28 atomic withdrawal/admission and exact lineage with no predecessor revival after later failure. Accepted/terminal/sensitive cases require capable source/privacy/records remedy before activation.

Q21/Q23/Q52 inspection/acceptance and actual separation rules remain. New bytes neither transfer approval nor automatically clear/inherit all concerns. Participant guidance points to a real permitted action, never blind affirmation or amending protected staff evidence. Q22 owns F and Q25 original readiness.

requirements.title: Preserve staff evidence disclosure, filing and existing review notices
requirements.text: As a participant or source reviewer, I want staff-added evidence to retain its exact disclosure and work meaning, so that assistance does not expand my archive or trigger unrelated messages.

acceptance.text: New independent uses start Unfiled, without labels or staff name. Actual qualified Q28 replacement may carry only exact predecessor home under current same-scope destination/maintenance authority; optional failure becomes Unfiled after valid admission, never missing-authority bypass.

Exact staff-upload admission that makes review newly actionable joins Q28's existing Q24/Q27 staff-origin cohort, with original policy/recipient generation, Off default, complete release, current utility and permanent dedup.

Storage/scan callbacks cause source reevaluation only, not mail/work per file. Valid source receipt/work survives unavailable optional mail through owned original-boundary recovery; Remove alone creates no new mail.

Q26 requires actual Request changes; Q32/Q35/Q40/Q48/Q51 retain their purposes. No upload notice, bell, attention, reminder/access reset, extraction corpus, public visibility or blanket suppression follows.

requirements.title: Deliver accessible staff upload with finite safe operation
requirements.text: As staff on a slow connection, I want persistent truthful progress and recovery, so that assistance works without an extra console or unsafe fallback.

acceptance.text: Multiple files within one item retain each true intended outcome and only unresolved recovery; no atomic remote-transfer promise or cross-item batch intake. Explain limits before transfer and safe specific errors, not public-email/external-viewer privacy fallback.

Keyboard/non-drag/touch/AT/focus/reading preservation/reflow/zoom/Unicode/RTL filenames and restrained progress work. No mandatory preview/full-page console/offline queue/private persistence; context changes fence late output. Actual inspectable content remains separately qualified.

Native same-scope version/intake/result/history constraints and every effective DML/Storage/job/restore path qualify. No body/base64/unbounded history in business rows, permission shadow or principal/source cascade destroying independent evidence.

Publish and prove source-specific positive finite budgets for bytes/counts/transfers/processing/grants/in-flight settlement/retries/queries/cleanup/retention/cost, including boundary-plus-one. No Infinity, avatar/vendor cap borrowing or zero-bill claim; direct qualified private transfer is allowed.

Census actual old files/readers/writers; unknown origin/receipt/timeliness cannot be inferred. Deploy compatible source/schema before UI; safe stop retains committed truth/recovery/cleanup. Restore actual bytes plus source/reference/negative history before serving; SQL backup alone is insufficient.

requirements.title: Suggest only independently eligible exact held candidates
requirements.text: As staff selecting a local file, I want optional possible-existing assistance, so that I may reuse a suitable held version without exposing another source or trusting my browser's hash as proof.

acceptance.text: Current trusted source/item/subject/purpose and matching/discovery authority filters exact held use/version candidates before presence/rank/count/page/thumbnail/timing cue/serialization. Upload/read/assignment/possession/query fingerprint is no reuse or discovery grant.

Full-original collision-resistant fingerprint algorithm/version/coverage must be compatible with trusted immutable held verification lineage. Filename/MIME/size/unqualified ETag/thumbnail/rendition/sampled resume hash is not a substitute.

Browser fingerprint is untrusted bounded query input, not certified incoming equality, custody, authorship/freshness/rights or catalog fact. A candidate may be disclosed before incoming transfer when independently authorized; no artificial upload just to search.

Equal bytes never merge provenance/subject/use/consent/retention/approval/currentness. Preview/history/final reuse independently reauthorize, and existing source review/cardinality/personal participation remain unchanged.

requirements.title: Offer quiet timely assistance without delaying upload
requirements.text: As staff preparing evidence, I want a useful hint only when it can help, so that optional matching never becomes a waiting step or a misleading duplicate warning.

acceptance.text: One safely distinguishable candidate may expose direct Use existing file beside sufficient permitted identity/target; Review is optional. Multiple/ambiguous candidates use the qualified picker without arbitrary first/default selection or permission/provenance merge.

Review is inert and preview independently optional. One deliberate Use existing performs actual Q28 addition, not fresh original receipt or inherited acceptance; lawful return to local upload remains. If context cannot distinguish the candidate safely, no blind add.
Exact already-current membership returns Q28's honest existing/no-op and original attribution, not a new contribution or automatic upload cancellation.

No hint/incomplete/error is not global absence or weakened Q53 safety. Primary actions, reading order, context/focus/scroll survive return; no forced preview/hover/motion/whole-screen console. Keyboard/non-drag/AT/touch/reflow/IME/RTL/weak-network tasks qualify.

requirements.title: Choose one source route and reconcile it before switching
requirements.text: As staff using a candidate or uploading instead, I want one clear intended addition, so that a late hint or lost response cannot add the same intent twice.

acceptance.text: Changed material conflicts; no automatic reuse→upload or upload→reuse fallback. Only definitively unstarted/failed/canceled work may be deliberately repaired as source allows; uncertain admission is not absent. Later genuine eligible contributions remain possible despite equal bytes.

Lookup itself creates no receipt/effect slot/evidence revision/reference/hold/acceptance/reservation/F hold; required protected-read audit remains. Retry is a fresh bounded current read, never replay of old disclosure authority.

Bind responses to actor/context/target/relevant basis/selected-file and query generation, not digest only. Replacement/removal/dismissal/disable/expiry/source-start/context change fences pending output; no locked global search snapshot is promised.

Lookup requires no incoming storage session. If qualified staging exists, reuse retires it through Q53 cancellation/recovery, with actual grants/in-flight writes/unknown effects/retention/holds/reference checks before cleanup. No delete-on-match/switch/catch; helper cancel never cancels committed source work.

Only actual new Q28/Q53 admission creates its qualified Q24/Q27 effects; hints/dismissal neither notify nor reset clocks. New use copies no filing/labels/staff names/comments; exact already-qualified replacement exception alone remains.

requirements.title: Control the helper without changing baseline evidence powers
requirements.text: As tenant staff, I want limited helper controls and private query handling, so that disabling or dismissing suggestions does not remove my normal upload/reuse path.

acceptance.text: Off stops new helper work and fences hints, not independent Q28/Q53 selection/read/admission or a started source operation. On allows fresh current lookup only for a still-applicable nondismissed selection, not old result/dismissal revival.
Unknown policy produces no hint, not proved Off or no file. Enabling creates no fingerprint-retention or general search entitlement; changes are attributable.

Fingerprint/query/filename/candidate data is protected even on zero results; no URLs, shared caches, general logs/analytics/error capture/session replay or unapproved durable browser storage. Digest is not anonymization.

Distinguish unstarted/disabled/unqualified/no eligible suggestion/candidate/incomplete/error/original unknown internally with safe user presentation. Source acts keep their normal history; hint queries need no permanent business log. Only minimum governed diagnostics/configuration audit persists.

requirements.title: Qualify small responsive matching and safe migration
requirements.text: As the source operator, I want matching to be bounded and optional, so that large files or incomplete legacy fingerprints cannot slow or weaken ordinary intake.

acceptance.text: Actual same-scope immutable use/version/fingerprint algorithm/coverage constraints and every native alternate read/write/Storage door prevent trusted-fact forgery/retargeting; no raw bodies/base64/unbounded history in business data.

Finite device memory/CPU/responsiveness/file/corpus/query/rate/candidate/page/concurrency/retry/cache/backfill budgets are measured and enforced. Unsupported/slow/oversized hash work skips helper without reducing independently qualified upload limits; obsolete work/buffers/URLs settle finitely, not instant-abort fiction.

Browser reload may need reselection, not persistent private bytes. Known source success survives refresh failure; unknown recovers original. No instant detection, physical storage saving, free-bill or all-input guarantee without evidence.

Deploy trusted-fact/current-authority/route fences before UI. Census legacy facts, preserve independent equal-byte documents, expose partial digest coverage honestly and backfill only when justified; no all-library scan prerequisite or blessing arbitrary assets metadata.

Disable helper safely while baseline routes/original recovery/cleanup remain. Mixed-version/restore applies later restrictions and delete fences before rebuilt candidates; actual role/storage/route-race/device/accessibility/workload evidence qualifies activation, not a prototype/API description alone.

requirements.title: Read resources with honest advisory review status
requirements.text: As an authorized resource reader, I want to understand review status while continuing to use eligible guidance, so that a planning date neither hides useful content nor falsely certifies it.
requirements.basis: Q55-C01–C04/C12, with Q58 staff-reader adoption; REQ29-P01/P04/P07/P08.

acceptance.text: Show Review due after the full target day, otherwise Review planned for [date] or known No review scheduled. Future/absent targets never mean Fresh, Verified, Safe or guaranteed current; Open/Download requires no due acknowledgment or forced preview.

Last reviewed comes only from the latest still-applicable noninvalidated actual review of the exact content/audience/purpose basis. Complete proved absence and unknown/incomplete history have distinct neutral states; neither means nobody ever reviewed it. REQ29-C107 refines current shared-publication applicability.

External-resource review describes the approved reference and declared scope at that time, not continuing verification of remote bytes. No new crawler or download tracking is introduced. Independent safe guide advice remains; unsafe dependent advice follows C44, without blanket guide shutdown or a new reader task.

Permission precedes status, counts, dates, names, links and accessible labels. Unknown review metadata alone does not withdraw an independently authorized resource; unknown access fails closed. Current day/refocus/reconnect refresh is bounded, not polling each card or writing a due event.

requirements.title: Plan or change a resource review date
requirements.text: As a curator, I want an explicit optional next-review plan, so that scheduling is flexible without fabricating a completed review.

acceptance.text: Due means trusted source-local current date is later than target; equality is not overdue. Locale and later tenant-zone changes do not reinterpret stored meaning. Explicit attributed zone changes preserve prior evidence; ambiguous legacy dates remain unknown.

Set/Change/Clear uses deliberate Save and explains Changing this date does not record a review. New plans use today/future; factual correction/import preserves proved dates. Clear means No review scheduled, not Never expires.

Rescheduling a missed target changes current due status while preserving prior target/zone/actor/time and actual Last reviewed. No sticky cycle, second planning date, recurrence or automatic interval is created.

Current-authorized identical target is a no-op, including an unchanged now-past target; no business revision/history/event or timer reset. Original replay precedes new-plan validation; relevant stale A→B→A basis conflicts. Date picker, typing, blur and IME do not save implicitly.

requirements.title: Record an actual resource review
requirements.text: As a qualified curator, I want to record review of unchanged or updated guidance, so that review evidence does not require a fake edit or re-upload.

acceptance.text: One deliberate act atomically records review and explicit next target (today/future or permitted none). Show and confirm a retained valid future target; explain completion of an old past target and require an explicit next state, without hidden rollover.

Publish/correct/replace may compose Record review only with explicit actual-review intent and exact basis. No routine second moderator, essay or re-upload is required. Record review does not republish a withdrawn resource.

Relevant content/audience/purpose changes require refreshed review; unrelated technical/display changes do not automatically invalidate it. No broad transaction spans remote inspection. A later deliberate review may create another fact for the unchanged basis; value equality is not a review no-op.

Lost replies recover the original under current disclosure, without stamping another review or overwriting a newer target. Failed replacement preserves old content only while independently eligible, with its own review state.

requirements.title: Correct mistaken review or planning facts
requirements.text: As a source-authorized curator or operator, I want to correct a demonstrably mistaken record, so that current guidance is truthful without rewriting history.

acceptance.text: Preserve and link original actor/time/fact. Invalidating an erroneous review removes only its current applicability, recomputes remaining applicable Last reviewed, and atomically confirms the current target; it never blindly restores an earlier target or publication/access state.
A proved target correction may yield a past due date; it is not a hidden future-plan validation bypass. Newer facts, source restrictions and lawful erasure rules remain binding.
A departed curator has actual source stewardship recovery without impersonation or universal staff power. Direct database repair or powerless Contact admin is not the permanent user path.
Corrections neither alter ordinary acceptance/F, reminder clocks, financial/consent/coaching facts nor other uses/holds/retention. Withdrawal does not recall downloads or control an external website.

requirements.title: Use a small accessible resource management surface
requirements.text: As a curator or reader on any supported device, I want clear focused resource actions, so that review maintenance does not become another inbox or CMS.

acceptance.text: Distinguish no resources, no matches, unknown metadata, load failure and unavailable link. Preserve safe filters/list position/input across return and conflicts while reauthorizing; Saving/Checking result does not announce success prematurely.

Text and programmatic status, associated persistent errors, keyboard date input plus accessible picker, meaningful announcements and logical unobscured focus are required. Qualify 320 CSS-pixel reflow, 200% text, 400% zoom, long names, RTL/IME, touch and weak networks; chrome cannot repair unreadable source content.
No ordinary second confirmation, required essay, mandatory file fetch, new AI verification, reminder job, index/provider or per-resource polling. Actual independently qualified C44 effects remain.

requirements.title: Preserve review integrity across every read and write door
requirements.text: As the source operator, I want review facts and projections to share one current authority boundary, so that alternate paths cannot fabricate trust.

acceptance.text: Qualified staff without a Party remain usable; role labels, editable ownership, old JWT membership or a service bypass do not grant curation. History/status/bytes have separately qualified disclosure, with current scope before serialization and cache/prefetch serving.

Enforce actual native keys/constraints/grants/RLS old/new-row behavior, function/view privileges and alternate writers; use P12's shared fine-grained decision with coarse Tenant RLS and exact R6. No permanent one-review-per-version uniqueness suppresses genuine later review.

Retained readable history and opaque original-result/reject evidence have distinct lawful retention. Erased result detail cannot turn an old operation into a new one. Restore/rebuild reapplies later restrictions and invalidations before serving.

requirements.title: Activate resource review only with bounded complete proof
requirements.text: As the release operator, I want qualified review behavior and repair, so that legacy metadata and runtime limits cannot create false freshness.

acceptance.text: Backfill only established facts; missing review metadata does not itself hide a proved published/authorized legacy resource. Unknown publication/access/classification remains unadmitted. No automatic deadline, cadence or fabricated badge is activated for existing tenants.

Compatible readers and fenced old writers precede bounded enablement; disabling new commands preserves safe history and withdrawal/access controls. Rollback cannot drop committed evidence or revive invalidated reviews.

Paginated source-scoped queries use deterministic unique continuation and measured indexes; no now()-dependent immutable index or byte downloads for metadata. Finite input/history/page/time budgets and production-shaped plans are enforced.

Preserve existing C49 controls, including resource target-read server p95 greater than one second for fifteen minutes at approved tested workload; this is an alert threshold, not a measured baseline or scheduler SLA. Actual role/clock/race/correction/restore/AT/performance evidence is required before activation.

requirements.title: Optionally compose photos in one ordinary item
requirements.text: As a recipient or authorized staff supplier, I want an optional in-context photo composer, so that I can submit an ordered PDF without losing the direct file route.

acceptance.text: Choose photos and supported Take photo show exact permitted target, ordered pages, Not submitted yet and notice of original-photo retention under source policy. One deliberate Create PDF and submit/add may authorize preparation through admission; no routine second confirmation or mandatory page/output preview.

Selection/capture/blur/reorder/rotate/callback cannot submit. Device-prepared PDF intake claims no custody of unseen photos. Camera denial/unsupported format preserves independently permitted direct intake and actual authorized accommodation, without forced account/cloud/device/scanner.

Show actual limits and per-page repair. Source-required unchanged images do not become acceptable merely by conversion; unsupported animation/multiframe variants are rejected, never silently reduced to one frame. MIME/extension/browser preview are insufficient format proof.

requirements.title: Arrange complete page occurrences without changing originals
requirements.text: As a composer user, I want reliable accessible page controls, so that the submitted order and rotation match my intent.

acceptance.text: Permit one or more valid occurrences within qualified limits; zero or unresolved selected pages block the intended composition. Add/Remove/Replace/Retake, non-drag Move up/down and clockwise quarter-turn controls use stable occurrence IDs and explicit order.

Identical input bytes may appear in distinct deliberate occurrences. Reject duplicate occurrence IDs/ambiguous positions; never deduplicate by bytes/name or order by transfer completion. Failed/canceled retake retains the prior local page until replacement succeeds.

Normalize intrinsic orientation once then explicit rotation; four quarter turns normalize. Preserve full coverage/aspect ratio with no silent clipping, paper-size crop or color enhancement. No skipped failed pages, empty PDF or reduced substitute set.

Keep stable focus after move/remove/retake, visible unobscured focus, associated errors and meaningful non-stealing announcements. Keyboard/speech/touch/non-drag, RTL/IME, long names, reflow/zoom and weak-network paths qualify; last-page removal returns a usable empty state.

requirements.title: Bind one assembly to exact originals, recipe and output
requirements.text: As a reviewer, I want the complete assembly lineage, so that generated output is never mistaken for an original or disposable preview.

acceptance.text: Trusted processing uses verified immutable private inputs after all write capabilities close/fence; bind source/operation, exact verified IDs/digests/sizes, ordered recipe/profile/builder/options and output ID/digest/size/page count. Client manifest/PDF/digest claims are not correspondence proof.

Each occurrence yields one output page in order. Qualified inert static output has no active scripts/remote references. Actual correspondence, legibility, color, decoder/orientation/frame and finite process-tree limits are proved; no compulsory redundant second decode is imposed if trusted qualification suffices.

One immutable generation winner is recovered; technical retries cannot overwrite it. Cross-version byte-identical regeneration is not required or assumed. Recipe alone does not back up admitted bytes; D32 preview expiry does not dispose of the evidence PDF.

Required originals/output/lineage have actual source retention and separately qualified disposal; not every abandoned retake is kept. Decoding is isolated, least-privilege and without unqualified egress/ambient credentials; caller URLs/paths/executables cannot select processor input. No transaction spans remote processing.

Native constraints enforce scoped ownership, immutable references, unique occurrence slots, positive finite counts/bytes and legal rotations/profile; repeated inputs remain allowed. Every alternate database/service/Storage writer and read door preserves these invariants.

requirements.title: Admit the whole verified assembly once
requirements.text: As a submitter, I want a truthful whole-unit receipt, so that uploaded pages or unfinished generation do not falsely replace my earlier evidence.

acceptance.text: At one current-authorized source commit after waits, atomically bind every required input/output custody reference against deletion, exact assembly/recipe, actor/receipt time/instructions/statements, candidacy/correction relation, history/result and mandatory follow-through intent.

Only that commit applies Q03 predecessor fencing and review-basis change. Failed/canceled preparation leaves prior contribution's independent eligibility intact. Dispensable preview failure after receipt does not undo receipt; required output safety cannot be skipped by saying Received.

Preparation access never extends access/deadlines or reserves acceptance/F. Freeze exact semantic intent and expected basis; same-intent original recovery precedes current eligibility, changed intent conflicts and relevant ABA is detected. Unknown outcome cannot automatically switch to separate photos/new operation/recipe.

Actual recipient/no-Party or staff context and source authority are checked before durable allocation/expensive work and at all admissions/reads. Camera permission, Party, profile or key knowledge grants nothing. Current input restrictions apply to derived content; output permission need not grant original downloads.

requirements.title: Cancel preparation and recover custody truthfully
requirements.text: As a user or operator, I want cancellation and retry to reflect the actual winner, so that stale workers cannot resurrect an abandoned submission.

acceptance.text: Distinguish local Remove/Cancel, stop requested, source admission, withdrawal and physical disposal. Cancel that wins before admission fences later admission; committed admission returns its real result and source remedy, never false deletion.

Register grants/attempts/copies/outputs/intended references before I/O. Reconcile unknown grant creation; exact qualified resume does not choose a browser fingerprint match. Immutable generation keys/no upsert, settled writers and current deletion/reference fences prevent stale completion resurrection.

Token/lease expiry or client abort proves neither write nor delete settlement. Cleanup needs current disposition authority, complete reference/hold/retention/processor coverage and verified provider removal. Unknown coverage blocks deletion; local dismissal cannot delete shared/admitted bytes.

Stop unused camera streams/release local previews safely; no promise of device/backup erasure. Unsent local work may be lost on reload/backgrounding; only genuinely durable preparation recovers under current rights, without invented offline sync.

Finite format/page/input/pixel/live-memory/output/CPU/time/concurrency/queue/retry/custody/cleanup budgets cover full work, measured before activation. Generate on deliberate intent/bounded preview, not each edit. No promised compression, free processing or copied vendor/avatar limits.

requirements.title: Read and review the exact assembly safely
requirements.text: As a qualified recipient or reviewer, I want one understandable assembly with separately permitted originals, so that review and readback preserve source provenance.

acceptance.text: Show one candidate, Assembled PDF, truthful page count/original relationship and actual origin/status. Current recipient readback covers that recipient's admitted output and expressly permitted inputs, not staff/other people's evidence or general historical bytes.

Staff acceptance binds complete assembly identity/recipe/output/input lineage. No per-page Accept ritual or forced ZIP; generation is not review. Q30 and all five Q45 mutations affect only structurally relevant prepared review under existing rules.

Every thumbnail/name/count/lineage/HEAD/range/conditional/long-transfer/cache path uses current permission. A prohibited required constituent denies the indivisible PDF, never silently filters it. Original-only sensitive metadata may remain hidden; downloaded copies cannot be recalled.

Q44 still exports selected eligible originals; Download assembled PDF is separately authorized. Q45 anchors target exact output/original and never migrate. Q41 output sharing does not share inputs/recipe. Q28 reuse copies no assembly consent/acceptance; Q42/Q50 attach to actual use; Q54 cannot collapse composition.

General discovery remains metadata-only; no OCR/body ranking added through previews. Source-required accessible content or actual accommodation remains necessary; image-only output is not claimed to have accessible text or reliable reading order.

requirements.title: Correct or resupply an assembly without recapturing lawful pages
requirements.text: As an authorized supplier, I want to reuse lawful unchanged pages in a new contribution, so that correction does not require needless re-upload or mutate earlier evidence.

acceptance.text: Current recipient correction creates a new complete assembly/output with current statements/time, reusing exact lawful inputs only from the own current same-request/item/purpose assembly. Preserve byte receipt provenance without inventing new upload/copy or redundant safety work.

Whole-unit Q47 Withdraw and unchanged Re-offer remain distinct. Create revised submission may use an eligible own withdrawn assembly's exact permitted inputs under fresh same-lineage resupply authority; it creates a new act without reviving old withdrawal or exposing other history.

Qualified staff same-lineage correction/revised supply may reuse lawful inputs without author-only restriction, under Q28/Q53 staff origin. Pending Remove is whole-unit; optional Replace is coherent exact old removal/new admission, never accepted-byte overwrite or recipient impersonation.

Missing/prohibited inputs receive actual fresh-supply/source repair, never substitution. Accepted/terminal/privacy mistakes have capable source remedies before activation, no universal Undo/predecessor revival. Disabled processing profile blocks corrections needing it while preserving independently qualified direct repair.

requirements.title: Preserve assembly effects, privacy and upgrade safety
requirements.text: As the operator, I want one source occurrence and compatible recovery, so that composition adds no duplicate work or unsafe legacy inference.

acceptance.text: Q24/Q27 effects arise once from genuinely actionable whole-unit admission in their actual recipient/correction/staff/re-offer cohorts. Preparation adds no receipt email/task/reminder/attention/completion event; all other source effect boundaries remain.

Original EXIF/location and recipe/context remain protected; thumbnails/output avoid unnecessary sensitive metadata while originals retain truthful bytes. No private content in generic logs/analytics/session replay/shared caches or unqualified durable browser storage; qualified protected carriers retain exact scope/lifetime.

Compatible source/lineage/profile support and fenced old writers precede bounded enablement. Unknown legacy lineage is not inferred from names/time; restore reconciles restrictions/withdrawal/retention and exact bytes before serving. Kill switch stops new profile work, preserving lawful existing reading/recovery/withdrawal/cleanup.

Real identity/DB/Storage, parser/provider upgrades, whole-unit races, fidelity/backup, mobile/camera/AT and workload evidence qualify activation; logical models and public avatar upload tests do not. Supported operator repair replaces recurring SQL cleanup.

requirements.title: Report a resource problem in context
requirements.text: As an authorized resource reader, I want to report a problem with known resource context, so that responsible curators can address it without a support conversation.

acceptance.text: One bounded plain-text What is wrong with this resource? field identifies handling audience and nonanonymous identity, with useful purpose/privacy help. Do not ask known contact data again. Blank/invalid/over-limit input has associated errors, not truncation; one useful sentence can suffice.

Send report is deliberate; selection/typing/blur/IME/opening cannot submit. No compulsory preview, attachment, screenshot, taxonomy, rating, rich editor, mention delivery, AI judgment, second confirmation or staff picker.

New admission binds current exact publication/version/language/purpose and real actor/time. Changed target basis preserves lawful draft and requires refreshed intent, never silently attaches to successor. External references capture the approved reference/observation, not remote-byte verification or a fetched snapshot.

requirements.title: Receive reports with a capable handling route
requirements.text: As a reporter, I want a durable truthful receipt and responsible handling, so that a successful send does not disappear into an unowned queue.

acceptance.text: After known receipt, reader Open may display Awaiting review, distinct from Sending and Q55 review status. The route need not name an online individual but must support current handling/stewardship takeover; no false receipt for unqualified ownership.

Existing resource management projects permitted pending work; no duplicate mutable task, outbox/inbox/assignment engine or mandatory In progress. Reading neither claims nor handles work; curator departure grants no blanket staff body access.

Same semantic operation recovers original before new eligibility/no-op/rate admission; changed intent conflicts. Equal-text distinct deliberate reports remain valid. Revision/ABA fences protect edit/handling/withdraw/reopen races; no tenant-wide locks or network locks.

Source/API and native constraints preserve exact scoped target/reporter/receipt, valid state/outcome/handler basis and history. Static field-policy classification with subtract-only projection and stable code-owned capability meaning governs every alternate read/write door; no raw-table exposure through broad Support policies.

requirements.title: Return to one's own permitted report history
requirements.text: As a reporter, I want to return to my receipt and handling status, so that I can understand the outcome without an inbox or resource-history grant.

acceptance.text: Your reports inside Resources and contextual return provide bounded current-authorized own receipts/status. Independently admitted report-purpose rights may survive resource replacement/withdrawal; identity equality or retention alone cannot authorize them.

Text/title/outcome/history are separately permitted. Use neutral Resource unavailable when appropriate; no internal notes, other readers' reports, hidden title/reason or historical byte access. Actual submission/edit/handled/restored times are distinct; Handled does not mean Fixed or read-confirmed.

Known receipt survives secondary refresh failure. Empty, filtered-empty, unavailable, denied and failed/unknown loads differ safely; preserve lawful list/focus/filter context and fence late responses after identity/context changes.

requirements.title: Edit, withdraw and restore one's open report
requirements.text: As a reporter, I want to repair my report without erasing its history, so that mistakes have a usable permanent recovery path.

acceptance.text: Current reporter edit authority permits exact-current Open text correction, preserving target/author/receipt and attributed history. Genuine canonical no-op creates no business revision; stale Open→Handled→Open or content ABA conflicts. Staff cannot impersonate/rewrite the allegation.

Wrong target requires deliberate withdrawal then a new eligible report; post-Handled new information is a new report, no automatic protected-text copy or chat. Maintenance of existing reports can remain lawful after resource withdrawal under separate report-purpose rights.

Deliberate own Open→Withdrawn removes pending handling with concise consequence copy, no essay or toast-only remedy. It is not body deletion, copy recall or suppression of independent incident/privacy duties; Handled is not ordinary reader-withdrawable.

Restore requires current restoration authority, lawful latest body the reporter can review/authorize, permitted audience and capable route. It creates a new attributed Open revision preserving receipt/target/withdrawal; no historical rollback, resource revival or redacted/disposed-text restoration. Blocked restoration has actual source/privacy repair or eligible fresh-report route.

requirements.title: Handle a report with an audience-safe outcome
requirements.text: As a current curator, I want to record a clear disposition, so that the reporter knows what was done without confusing handling with publication or verified correctness.

acceptance.text: Mark handled applies only to exact-current Open content/state with current report authority, not last-publisher authorship. Require one concise Outcome for the reporter, labeled for that audience, without routine essay/taxonomy/extra approver.
Atomically retain actual handler/time, assessed revision, outcome, state/history/result. A concurrent real reader edit stales the handling form. Reading alone has no effect.

Resource correction/publication/withdrawal/review/date changes remain separate commands. If work fails, handling text cannot truthfully claim it succeeded; multi-command UX does not promise atomicity. No automatic report email/conversation or text-classifier verification.

requirements.title: Repair handling and sensitive reports
requirements.text: As a qualified curator or privacy operator, I want precise repair actions, so that a typo, premature handling or sensitive allegation can be corrected without a workflow maze.

acceptance.text: Correct outcome on current Handled appends attributed correction and preserves original handling/receipt. Trusted action/context supplies routine cause; an extra concise reason is required only by actual source policy, not for every typo.

Reopen Handled requires concise reason, current authority, retained lawful body/audience and capable route. It creates new Open revision; prior outcome is historical. Withdrawn is not curator-reopenable/handleable around reporter withdrawal.

Immediate scoped restriction and actual privacy/records correction/redaction cover Open/Handled/Withdrawn content, retained versions/outcomes/projections/caches/exports/backups as policy requires. Append-only history cannot preserve exposed sensitive text indefinitely; Restore/Reopen cannot recreate erased content.
Independent incident work remains possible; retention/holds grant no reading. No powerless support instruction, recurring SQL fix or generic admin bypass substitutes for capable scoped repair.

requirements.title: Keep reporting accessible, private and separate
requirements.text: As a reader using a supported device or assistive technology, I want a short recoverable reporting flow, so that accessibility or network failure cannot cause duplicate reports or unwanted disclosures.

acceptance.text: Reuse base-maia/shared UI with labeled fields, permanent receipt, meaningful status/errors and unobscured logical focus. Qualify keyboard/speech/touch/AT, Enter/Space deliberate controls versus IME, reflow/zoom/RTL/long text and weak networks. No unqualified offline draft or reconnect auto-submit.

Report/body/identity/outcome/history visibility does not inherit resource readership. URLs/@names remain data; no fetch/mention grant. Generic logs/URLs/analytics/session replay/cache/local stores exclude protected values.

No Q55 review stamp, guide completion, ordinary comment, resource auto-withdrawal, email/SMS/subscription/unread obligation or task per report. Independently qualified effects and urgent duties retain owners; deliberate Help/new-report handoff copies only permitted context.

requirements.title: Qualify report operation, migration and recovery
requirements.text: As the operator, I want bounded handling and safe restore, so that a useful report cannot be orphaned or made public by rollout.

acceptance.text: Finite plain-text payload/Unicode/rate/page/history/concurrency/retry/query/latency/retention budgets and deterministic unique paging are measured/enforced. Lists do not load all bodies/history; no attachments/vector index/per-keystroke writes/per-resource polling or required Realtime.

Current capability/handling route/read models/grants precede exposed reporting. No backfill from comments/reactions/Support without proved semantics. Missing reporting setup does not withdraw lawful resources.

Stop unsafe paths while preserving independently lawful receipts/handling/privacy repair/cleanup. Mixed writers and restore retain redactions, states, current restrictions and original-operation fences; no rollback to raw-body exposure.

Preserve applicable Phase28 C49 source target-read monitoring, including server p95 greater than one second for fifteen minutes at approved tested workload; this is not a universal report SLA or measured result. Actual role/alternate-door/race/fault/retention/restore/browser/AT/user/workload proof qualifies activation; no measured demand/cost/latency is presumed.

requirements.title: Read suitable organization resources as staff or missionary
requirements.text: As a qualified reader, I want Resources in my current workspace context, so that I can use applicable guidance without curator or unrelated Support privileges.

acceptance.text: Staff Resources uses existing Mission Control; missionary reading remains. Neither management access, Support-read, missionary profile nor fabricated Party/account is required for actual qualified staff reading.

Family labels are closed product choices, not roles, directory, custom segments or all-hats authority. Each read applies current source/P12/classification/rights restrictions; dual-context users receive only current context and one occurrence per result.

Show permitted description/language/format/known size, Open/Download, review information and actual successor guidance. Distinguish empty/filter-empty/failure/unknown-context/unavailable links, preserving safe navigation without full-file prefetch, read receipt/completion/subscription/task.

requirements.title: Publish one coherent edition to an explicit audience set
requirements.text: As a curator, I want to select suitable reader families deliberately, so that common guidance needs only one coherent publication.

acceptance.text: Draft may have no audience; Publish requires at least one admissible declared family. Use a concise Staff/Missionaries group with explicit source-intent selection, never silent Both or rollout widening. Zero eligible members of a declared family does not mean empty declared set or require enumerating/counting members.

Current/proposed audiences and additions/removals are reviewable before deliberate Publish/Save audience changes. Selection/draft save is inert; no routine second modal, essay, moderator or directory. Actual safety/rights/static projection-policy approval remains distinct.

Ordinary mutation requires authority/visibility over complete affected scope, including retained/added/removed families. A partial client set cannot erase hidden scope. Current maintainer/scoped administrator takeover is capable, not original-author-only.

Source commit rechecks exact content/purpose/rights/audience/revision, atomically persists history/result and required continuation, and orders actual custody references against disposal. A retained row/FK alone does not prove a copy safely referenceable.

requirements.title: Change audiences, replace or withdraw with truthful recovery
requirements.text: As a curator, I want clear shared consequences and independent urgent withdrawal, so that audience mistakes can be repaired without saving unrelated draft work.

acceptance.text: Clearing the last declared family leaves publication unchanged and offers explicit whole-publication Withdraw. Withdraw validates its own current basis independently of unrelated invalid/unsaved fields, preserving draft safely. Cancel does not publish.

Shared replacement changes current edition for all still-authorized audiences. Failed/unknown replacement exposes no unreviewed alternate; old publication remains only while independently eligible. New family admission is prospective, with no historical-byte/readership grant.

Remove family fences its discovery/retrieval; whole Withdraw fences every audience through actual current serving contracts, without recalling delivered copies or deleting independent uses. Urgent qualified source protection need not wait for full-scope editor/successor readiness; narrowing alone grants no power.

Fresh audience correction/re-add/reoffer preserves history and current restrictions, never replay/restore/checkbox grant revival. Reuse lawful retained content without forced upload while preserving newer saved/unsaved work; unknown originals are reconciled before new action.

Same current canonical audience/content metadata is a no-op, not revision/history/review reset; relevant ABA conflicts. All ordinary and privileged doors enforce the complete scoped set and source lifecycle, including nonempty published audience.

requirements.title: Prepare a separate publication when needs diverge
requirements.text: As a curator, I want independent editions when audience needs differ, so that language, rights or review timing need not be forced into one publication.

acceptance.text: Existing preparation and qualified exact-file/reference reuse create an independent identity, audience and metadata when wording/language/rights/review/release meaning diverges. Read/download permission alone is not reuse; qualified reuse need not download/reupload bytes.

Copy only permitted proposed fields/content, not approval/reviews/reports/grants/delivery/history/private context. The new publication has its own explicit valid review plan/known-none, not unnoticed copied overdue date.

Incomplete/canceled preparation leaves old publication unchanged. Publish new then deliberately narrow/withdraw old with separate outcome recovery; no atomic/gapless claim, timeout auto-narrow, synchronization or audience redirect/history move. Urgent old restriction remains independent.
Same bytes/title does not grant new publication access through old links/guides/successor hints. Original operation replay cannot overwrite newer draft/publication work.

requirements.title: Apply review information and report purposes to staff readers
requirements.text: As a staff resource reader or curator, I want the same qualified maintenance journeys, so that shared availability does not imply shared private reports or obsolete review coverage.

acceptance.text: Explicitly adopt compatible Q55 and Q57 staff-reader actions under actual purpose rights. Resource read/rank/family membership does not grant reporting, other reports, handling or historical bytes. Staff/missionary reports retain distinct actors/context and never move to a new edition.

Reevaluate review applicability against content/audience/purpose changes, preserving history. Complete no-applicable-proof says No applicable review recorded; unknown is distinct, never a claim nobody reviewed it. Old review cannot cover newly added scope merely because bytes match.

Existing valid plan, including now-due target, may remain if source basis is valid. Audience Save/Publish creates no review/time reset/Review due event or forced declaration. Real Record review requires deliberate exact-basis intent; new plans use today/future/permitted none and existing original recovery remains.

Q57 own report-purpose return/maintenance can survive library restriction where independently lawful; audience removal does not automatically erase/handle reports or restore old resource access. No public feedback, new notification or workflow is added.

requirements.title: Preserve shared-publication authority and privacy everywhere
requirements.text: As the source operator, I want shared readership to use one current authority boundary, so that neither audience editing nor alternate data routes expose hidden content.

acceptance.text: Verified source-appropriate context and actual assignment where applicable, static field classification/subtract-only projection and one P12 PDP govern every action. Audience choice cannot lower internal/care/security floors or authorize another hat; no per-value/local policy engine.

Non-null scoped identities/content, family set validity, immutable attribution/history, relevant revision and semantic-operation uniqueness hold through real keys/constraints/commands and all effective grants/RLS/functions/views/triggers/service/import/restore doors. Raw tables cannot bypass fine-grained scope.

Current permission precedes drafts/results/history/counts/search/cursors/successors/bytes. Hidden editions/membership do not leak via disabled cards or cache; no Support/body-index widening, private telemetry or unqualified device persistence.

Physical disposition requires actual authority/retention and complete references/holds/unsettled writers/processors; unknown/delete-claimed copies cannot admit new reference. Independent use does not evade byte-wide safety; restored data gets latest restrictions before serving.

requirements.title: Qualify shared publication without a second knowledge platform
requirements.text: As the operator, I want compatible bounded rollout and capable stewardship, so that staff reading adds no hidden migration or broken recovery.

acceptance.text: Existing base-maia shells provide explicit controls, safe drafts/results/focus, keyboard/AT/touch/reflow/zoom/RTL/IME/weak-network completion; no autosubmit/offline queue/forced preview/new editor/settings matrix.

Finite indexed set-wise source queries with stable unique pagination return each publication once without member enumeration/file fetch. Preserve exact R6/C49; actual payload/rate/query/lock/retry/history/workload budgets are measured, not invented O(1)/zero-bill promises.

Census identities/classification/writers first; missionary-only stays so until deliberate change, unknown legacy never becomes Staff/Both. Compatible old writers cannot drop audiences; stopped shared/staff admission preserves independently safe reads/committed recovery/report handling/privacy cleanup.

Actual serving/role/constraint/concurrency/unknown/restore/retention/browser/AT/intended-user/workload proof and capable operators precede activation. No whole permission-builder/provider or Support ownership replacement is a prerequisite.

requirements.title: Save a private resource reference for later
requirements.text: As a qualified staff or missionary reader, I want a personal saved reference, so that I can return across visits without copying a resource or creating a reading obligation.

acceptance.text: Current staff/missionary contexts can reflect the same private preference, but each call uses exactly its current qualified context, not a union. No Party/account creation or email/account-merge transfer is inferred.

Save may use an eligible summary without preview/download. Store a source reference, not content/title/path/digest/URL. Return resolves that publication's currently admitted head only; separate edition/successor remains another identity and cannot silently inherit the save.

Ordinary named Save for later changes to Remove from saved after confirmation, with consistent ordinary button semantics and distinct Open/Download. No dialog/reason/folder/tag/approval/new settings, subscription, task/read receipt, offline copy or custody hold.

Saved for later sorts newest actual unsaved→saved transition first with stable opaque tie-breaker. Same-state Save/content update preserves saved date/order. Empty state offers Browse resources; Save does not navigate/steal focus, and Remove restores sensible list/empty focus.

requirements.title: Maintain saved references without leaking unavailable resources
requirements.text: As a reader, I want to remove my own unavailable reference safely, so that resource access loss neither exposes old details nor traps my preference.

acceptance.text: Independent current own-entry purpose may reveal only opaque handle, own saved timestamp/state and maintenance actions. No denied publication ID/title/filename/thumbnail/URL/audience/reason. Counts, if offered, count permitted personal relationships, not hidden publications.

Known current resource denial/withdrawal yields Unavailable resource with own Remove. Incomplete evaluation yields Could not check this saved resource and Retry; Remove remains if its independent authority is known. Neither case deletes the preference or treats uniform not-found as disposal.

Unknown/denied own-purpose or list failure yields no rows/counts/placeholders and actual safe recovery. Forged opaque handles cannot authorize another owner's entry. Remove requires no forbidden resource disclosure.

Withdrawal/logout/context change alone preserves preference; same publication may reappear only with retained Save and newly qualified current access. Remove remains removed through republish/access restoration/retry/backup. Accidental Remove uses fresh current Save, not historical restore.

requirements.title: Order explicit Save and Remove intentions
requirements.text: As a reader with overlapping or uncertain requests, I want my latest admitted choice preserved, so that a delayed response cannot reverse it.

acceptance.text: Commands express desired Save/Remove and exact control basis, not blind toggle. One authoritative boundary orders the owner/scope/publication relationship; stale conflicting fresh commands refresh and require deliberate current intent.

A new authorized same-state command fences earlier opposite intent when needed: absent→Remove→late Save cannot recreate, saved→Save→late Remove cannot clear. This control ordering does not change saved time/recency or fabricate a content event; matching original replay does not advance it.

No-record Remove fence requires genuine server-bound own control/pending intent or exact currently eligible personal target and complete scoped absence proof. Unknown/denied lookup cannot allocate arbitrary hidden-target control rows.

Coherently commit effect/control/result/required audit. Original recovery under current receipt disclosure precedes new eligibility/rate/no-op; changed immutable intent conflicts. Lost reply remains unknown, not duplicate Save/offline queue; late session/revision results cannot overwrite current UI.

Current new Save loses eligibility when source revokes; independent own Remove need not read the resource. Unrelated metadata alone is not conflict. ABA/cleanup retain minimal lawful control/result-or-reject evidence so forgotten old intent never becomes fresh.

requirements.title: Protect personal preferences through native boundaries and cleanup
requirements.text: As the source operator, I want preferences to remain private without retaining resource bytes, so that personal convenience does not create another access or retention system.

acceptance.text: Trusted scoped owner/target, unique active relationship, valid control/times and immutable binding hold through actual database constraints/commands and all grants/RLS/functions/views/trigger/service/collection/restore doors. Raw coarse-Tenant tables cannot expose other people's preferences.

Native current context and shared cookie-command origin/CSRF integrity apply. GET/render/prefetch/hover/search/open never Save/Remove; JWT/auth.uid/email/role alone is not current purpose. Pooled context resets and no second per-user SQL policy engine is added.

Preferences are not ordinary curator/coach/manager analytics. Store minimum reference/control/audit, no copied protected titles/body/URLs or unqualified persistent lists. Separately scoped privacy/security/records access remains attributed.

Save retains no bytes/hold. Actual finite classification-owned preference/control/audit/backup schedules and disposition-ordered reference cleanup qualify before activation; no automatic deletion on denial, arbitrary reminder expiry or physically-deleted-parent prerequisite. Restore fences old ownership/removed intent/disposed data.

requirements.title: Complete accessible Saved journeys under weak networks
requirements.text: As a reader using assistive technology or a narrow connection, I want responsive but truthful saved-state feedback, so that local UI never masquerades as a durable result.

acceptance.text: Pending feedback distinguishes checking/known success/failure, offers Retry and preserves useful page/choice. No durable Saved/Removed from local state alone, hidden offline mutation, forced modal/toast focus or body fetch for preference work.

Actual shared components qualify names/non-color state/errors/announcements, keyboard/touch/AT, visible focus, reflow/text/zoom, RTL/Unicode and localized dates; no new input or zone editor. Safe query/list position returns with current reauthorization.

Bounded indexed personal reads and batched decoration use stable unique continuation/set-wise current projection. No whole-library filtering, per-card body/auth fanout, unbounded profile JSON, permanent polling or P23 favorite cap. Partial/error never appears complete-empty.

requirements.title: Qualify saved-reference rollout and accountable recovery
requirements.text: As the operator, I want finite safe preference operation, so that legacy guesses and rollback cannot recreate removed choices.

acceptance.text: Declare/measurably enforce workload/query/page/record/control-retention/rate/recovery/memory limits, preserving exact R6/C49. No invented save cap or cost claim; safe over-limit outcomes and original recovery remain.

Qualified own-purpose/identity/projection and durable Save/list/Remove/return precede enablement. Start without inferred saves from visits/local state/subscriptions/curator guesses. Fence old blind-toggle/reparent/replay writers; stopped new saves preserve safe removal/recovery and Resources.

Native all-door tests, opposite/no-op/ABA/lost-response races, cleanup/disposal/restore/mixed-version tests and actual mobile/AT/intended-reader/workload evidence qualify activation. Routine removal/repair needs no developer/database intervention.

Separate minimum authoritative preference/control evidence from technical/security/publication history. Named source/security/database/privacy operators monitor safe signals, not content/preference lists; monitoring never substitutes for privacy/correctness proof.

requirements.title: Correct a substantively mistaken acceptance
requirements.text: As a currently authorized reviewer, I want to correct one mistaken applicable acceptance while a request remains eligible, so that staff can review retained evidence again without falsifying its receipt.

acceptance.text: Prove current applicable acceptance, unfinished eligible source and relevant complete facts at admission. Failed query/filtered badge/pending preview is not proof; sufficient metadata can permit action without forced preview/download, but required unknown facts block it.

Coherently append actual actor/time/basis correction, end only that acceptance's applicability, preserve original acceptance/receipt/members and unrelated items, establish correction-based Needs staff review, history/result and Q22 progression/follow-through.

No new submission, automatic Request changes, waiver/deletion/recipient obligation or F occurs. Required item without applicable acceptance cannot satisfy demand; source-certified optional/nonblocking work does not hold F open solely for review.

requirements.title: Resume actual staff review and truthful recipient guidance
requirements.text: As staff or recipient, I want clear current work after correction, so that staff mistakes do not demand needless upload or revive obsolete instructions.

acceptance.text: Reconcile actual P9/source review work and current Q24 responsibility/capable fallback for the new basis, without fake receipt, generic task revival or duplicate obligations. Technical prerequisites may block actionable work with a real owner repair path.

Reevaluate Q23 guidance/resolutions against correction: no automatic old recipient instructions or resolution surviving solely on invalidated acceptance; independent valid resolutions/history remain. New fresh review may accept retained sufficient evidence without new bytes.

Contextual Correct acceptance shows exact decision/basis/permitted original actor/time/consequence before one deliberate command. Trusted reviewed context or brief necessary note supplies intelligible cause; no duplicate essay, reverse-toggle, routine second approver/modal or forced dwell.

Show Acceptance corrected. This item needs staff review only when true, with Continue review. Eligible recipient wording may say staff are reviewing again/no action needed; later genuine Request changes supplies its own guidance. No internal rationale/directory leak, blame or false overdue/new-upload CTA.

Staff authority after recipient expiry does not renew access. Completed views retain original end/scope plus permitted truthful reliance; canceled stays canceled with qualified help, not new history/error access. Business insufficiency alone does not revoke lawful bytes; independent safety does.

requirements.title: Repair mistakes in correction without resurrecting old facts
requirements.text: As a qualified reviewer or operator, I want a precise repair for a mistaken correction, so that error recovery cannot erase history or restore an obsolete approval.

acceptance.text: Mistaken unfinished correction is repaired by fresh Q21 assessment/acceptance of current retained evidence, preserving old acceptance/correction. Equal bytes do not prohibit a genuine later decision; replay/delete/rollback cannot reactivate the old one.

An erroneous terminal error/reliance finding has explicit attributed finding-correction against exact current facts. Remove only its own blocker when actually supported, preserving independent safety/requirements/downstream restrictions, F/access/history and closed intake.

Unknown validity keeps unresolved/restricted reliance with actual corrective work. Harmless factual/privacy note repair requires no new collection or substantive invalidation. Permitted finding correction is independent of unrelated invalid drafts.

Correcting away a need re-proves draft issuance need and fences further collection/communication dependent solely on it while capable child owner reconciles; no silent draft deletion, child cancel/waiver or new cancellation power. Independently justified child work remains.

requirements.title: Record terminal acceptance error and affected reliance
requirements.text: As a source-authorized operator, I want to stop wrong reliance after closure, so that immutable fulfillment is preserved without leaving an error operationally valid.

acceptance.text: Record acceptance error/current-reliance disposition links exact acceptance/error, preserving F/terminal occurrence and access clocks. Do not manufacture Needs review inside closed work or reverse an enclosing application/payment/posted fact.

Frozen unfinished cases use adverse-only finding only when owning policy expressly permits; preserve freeze, never infer override/terminal status. Otherwise actual qualified containment must be capable before cohort activation.

Bounded registered affected reliance/consumer responsibility has durable handoff and truthful pending/resolved outcomes; current applicability prevents inappropriate new reliance. Other owners decide their corrections, with no global rollback/byte recall or universal downstream disclosure.

Known-error recording and urgent safety/privacy restriction do not wait for replacement draft/external callback. Unresolved downstream effects remain visible to permitted owners; comment/Help alone does not complete remedy.

requirements.title: Prepare and issue only needed fresh corrective work
requirements.text: As authorized staff, I want guided same-recipient corrective work after closure, so that remaining needs can be collected without reopening the old request or copying its authority.

acceptance.text: One resumable draft and at most one ever-issued result belong to exact admitted error-remedy intent, linked to original acceptance/error. Use Q25 current draft/issuance/recipient/access rules; this is distinct from Q49 different-person replacement.

Prepare only legitimate remaining needs from lawful editable definitions. No copied acceptance/statements/grants/private history or needless bytes. Retained evidence reuse requires actual current Q28/Q54 new source-use authority, preserving original provenance.

Preparation/error recording cannot issue automatically. Deliberate current review/issuance resolves real recipient context, not email/Party assumption. Concurrent/retried intent recovers existing draft/result, not another transport-key request.

Later genuinely different need requires new justification; unresolved remedy cannot be rekeyed. Corrected-away finding re-proves need before issuance; already-issued results retain history and actual Q33/Q34 reconciliation, with dependent-collection fence and no automatic cancellation.

requirements.title: Serialize correction with acceptance and fulfillment
requirements.text: As a reviewer recovering a race or lost response, I want one authoritative outcome, so that neither stale acceptance nor stale correction overwrites newer source truth.

acceptance.text: Source aggregate/fences order correction, reacceptance, requirements/evidence/guidance, authority, cancel and F. Include relevant Q30 and all five Q45 structural changes; no classifier or unrelated global invalidation.

Correction-first blocks stale Accept/F; terminal-first blocks unfinished correction. Losing command preserves safe intent and requires deliberate qualified terminal action, never silently converts to error/new request. Actual time is sampled after waits.

Commit applicability/history/original result/required continuation coherently. Exact semantic replay under current disclosure precedes fresh eligibility/no-op; different cause is not falsely attributed to the later caller. Genuine later finding on a new basis remains possible.

Q21/Q52 original replay remains historical success only; it cannot reinstate applicability/work/mail. Unknown commits reconcile, known success survives refresh failure, expired unverifiable intents reject. Native scoped keys/grants/RLS/triggers/functions/alternate doors preserve heads/history/one-issued remedy and forbid retarget/reparent/F overwrite.

requirements.title: Preserve exact communication and reminder boundaries
requirements.text: As staff or recipient, I want correction to create only justified work, so that reopening staff review cannot restart stopped messages or evade reminder limits.

acceptance.text: Correction/error/finding correction produces no new email/bell/subscription/Q27 correction cohort. Actual P9 review work remains. Later real Q23 Request changes may qualify Q26; genuinely new Q03 actionable evidence may qualify Q27, under exact contracts.
Q40 remains actual Q36 addition/Q37 material instruction only. Ended occurrences never revive from changed applicability; Q20/Q35 remain their own purposes. No fake receipt or broad re-review event.

Same-request correction preserves all Q48 settings/counts/stops/possible-send facts. Staff-review return is not recipient-work or timer reset; genuinely later recipient work follows existing anchors/spacing/caps without clearing Stop.

The new same-person Q60 corrective-request cohort has automatic reminders unavailable/Off: no default inheritance, Start/Resume, clone/unlink/rekey escape. Show Automatic reminders are not available for this corrective request. Independently qualified staff reminders and issuance notices remain, with existing contact/privacy/spacing/utility rules.

requirements.title: Protect current history and accessible corrective journeys
requirements.text: As a permitted user, I want clear correction status and safe next actions, so that privacy or access constraints do not produce misleading repair promises.

acceptance.text: Internal rationale, participant guidance, acceptance history/current work and byte access remain separately protected before labels/counts/errors/tasks/messages/exports/caches. Former visibility or audit identity grants no current access; lawful note/byte restriction does not falsify acceptance/F.

Preserve known success versus pending/unknown/conflict, safe input/reading/focus and current next action. Inert selection/blur/IME cannot Correct; focused deliberate Enter/Space/click remains usable. Qualify keyboard/speech/touch/AT, reflow/text/zoom, RTL/Unicode/date meaning and weak networks without forced downloads/offline acceptance.

Actual source finite retention covers decisions/drafts/results/audit/copies/backups, with stale-intent rejection, complete use/hold/processor disposition and late-write fences. Restore later corrections/restrictions/ended messages/access ends before serving; no blanket new hold or universal Undo.

Actual content inspection/alternative route still qualifies under Q21; accessible chrome alone is insufficient. Blocked cohorts need real source/privacy operator recovery, not recurring SQL/provider console or unqualified Help disclosure.

requirements.title: Qualify acceptance correction and its consumers
requirements.text: As the release operator, I want complete bounded correction proof, so that a polished repair action cannot leave stale reliance or hidden source effects.

acceptance.text: Bounded indexed applicability/dependency/operation reads and uniquely ordered history paging with per-page permission replace full-history scans/per-file fanout/tenant-wide locks. Measure cardinality/processing, transaction/concurrency, replay, reads/cache, retention/restore and device profiles; preserve R6 without misapplying resource C49 as ordinary SLA.

Register exact source producers/consumers/repair/private projection before exposure; no acceptance/correction/F backfill from tasks/mail/missing rows. Fence mixed old writers/callbacks and preserve source truth through projection failure.

Actual all-door roles, both race orders, unknown/changed-intent/ABA, terminal/finding correction/repeated false-error repair, child handoff/reminder exclusion, disposition/restore, workload and intended-user/browser/AT tests qualify activation. Scoped stops preserve committed truth and independently safe recovery without reviving old acceptance.

Document Request Item Acceptance Correction remains distinct from Submission Correction/Request changes and any generic Undo platform. Named source/security/privacy/database/product operators own measurable signals and capable responses; proof, not monitoring alone, gates activation.

requirements.title: Preserve document, byte, rendition, copy and use identity
requirements.text: As staff working across records, I want a file's exact identity and uses to survive organization and storage changes, so that I can trust what was received, reviewed and used.

acceptance.text: Rename, move, copy registration and provider migration preserve source identity, version lineage and references. A same-named upload creates no implicit replacement.

Equal bytes can support distinct admitted uses with different actors, receipts, rights and obligations. Digest equality cannot merge those facts or establish authenticity, consent, signature validity or acceptance.

Linking or unlinking requires the actual source command and same-scope references. Removing one use neither deletes shared bytes nor discharges another source's duty. Visibility of one use does not reveal other protected associations.

Required scope and lineage are structurally non-null and immutable where their meaning requires; composite keys/references prevent cross-Tenant or wrong-version binding. Legitimate code-owned global definitions may be referenced without pretending they are tenant-owned records; their assignments remain correctly scoped.

Actual current source facts determine candidate, accepted, superseded, withdrawn, evidence-only and unavailable meanings. Custody or a restore cannot make a version current, accepted or legally effective.

requirements.title: Admit only a qualified source and purpose profile
requirements.text: As a consuming domain owner, I want files handled under my exact purpose contract, so that shared infrastructure does not broaden authority or silently change records meaning.

acceptance.text: A visible folder, generic staff/admin role, valid JWT, provider credential, matching email, source link or prepared capability row cannot by itself admit intake, read, share, export, publication or disposal. No Party is fabricated to satisfy the interface.

Each profile identifies source owner/version, permitted actors/actions, actual formats/limits, original-fidelity or discard rule, processors/egress, current delivery rule, copies and records obligations, qualified failure/repair and activation evidence. Unknown differs from absent, Off, denied and temporarily unavailable.

New upload preparation, allocation and processing have their own Q02 admission; later request issuance cannot retroactively authorize already stored bytes. A profile cannot be selected merely because a broad settings row permits an edit.

One P12 PDP/source enforcement boundary supplies fine-grained decisions and shared field projection; prescribed coarse Tenant RLS remains defense in depth. Every serving/writing path either preserves this boundary or stays closed.

Compatible source profiles can share a qualified adapter. Source-specific stronger restrictions win within their real scope; a generic signed-access description cannot relax an express no-bearer gateway contract. Actual policy conflicts go to the responsible owner rather than an invented longest/shortest retention rule.

requirements.title: Bind every transfer to narrow durable intake
requirements.text: As an authorized submitter, I want reliable progress and recovery for my intended file, so that retrying a connection does not create extra evidence or expose a bucket.
requirements.basis: Founder §9; Q01–Q05/Q53-C01–C18/Q56-C01–C18/Q61-C07/C14; source-specific public and specialist intake contracts.

acceptance.text: The user sees per-file selected, transferring, interrupted, checking, known failed, cancelled and result-unknown states without simulated success. One normal authorized Upload and add intent may include qualified transfer/finalization; no routine second confirmation is required.

Grant issue/reissue and lost responses reconcile against the same intake and actual authority. Repeated calls cannot mint unbounded grants. Resume binds the exact actor, source, intake and object generation; names or browser fingerprints are not that identity.

Retired keys are not reused. No upsert or late transfer may overwrite verified/admitted bytes or recreate an untracked copy after cleanup. Token expiry, client abort and worker-lease expiry do not prove all admitted writes stopped.

Multiple supported local selections retain separate intended file outcomes unless a source explicitly admits an indivisible assembly. Their batching does not import Q52 acceptance atomicity or imply remote all-or-none effects.

Actual finite transfer/session/resume/grant and cleanup bounds are qualified per profile. Exhaustion supplies a useful smaller-selection, retry or source-assistance route without public fallback, indefinite authority or silently dropping selected files.

requirements.title: Verify immutable receipt before source admission
requirements.text: As a reviewer, I want a submission to name the exact durable bytes actually received, so that a callback or partial upload cannot become evidence.

acceptance.text: Browser success, upload callback, object listing, file signature or scan result alone cannot finalize the source contribution. Missing/unknown object state remains unresolved; source success is not inferred from a later UI refresh.

Repeated callbacks and different transport keys for the same intake converge on one admitted source effect. A genuinely new deliberate upload of identical bytes can be a distinct lawful contribution; no bytes-only permanent business deduplication is introduced.

Admission and reference protection serialize against deletion claims, holds and relevant source closure/correction. Deletion-claimed or unknown-integrity material cannot promote; a stale cleaner cannot delete admitted material.

Recipient correction fences its predecessor only at actual qualified new receipt; staging, allocation or partial pages do not. Failed replacement leaves the independently usable predecessor intact. No new upload inherits earlier acceptance.

Only the profile's expressly permitted post-admission processing may remain Checking after receipt. Copy says Checking file — not yet added before source admission and Added — checks in progress only after it. Later secondary-read failure cannot relabel a known committed addition Failed.

Staff upload records actual staff origin and a truthful durable source receipt, never a participant attestation. Retained input reuse preserves the original byte-receipt provenance without inventing a fresh upload or redundant required scan.

requirements.title: Bound hostile content and preserve truthful safety states
requirements.text: As a user or operator, I want unsafe and unsupported files contained with a capable recovery route, so that a processing outage does not become silent exposure.
requirements.basis: Founder §9; Q53/Q56/Q61-P06; P22/P23 hygiene and P26 D32.

acceptance.text: Hostile/mislabelled files are tested beyond extension/browser MIME, including archive bombs, traversal, absolute paths, symlinks/devices, external references, scripts/macros and embedded executables. Processing never executes these as active content.

Parsers run with minimum privileges, no ambient credentials and no unapproved network fetch or private-file submission to public malware services. Candidate engines, dependencies, licenses, isolation and processing location require current qualification.

Bound violations stop affected processing before excessive work where possible and again at trusted decode. No truncation is mislabeled complete, and no overloaded/private failure falls back to public storage or an external viewer.

An independently lawful original download may remain available despite unsupported preview, but actual source hygiene/read rules can also deny it. Preview failure neither auto-downloads nor silently grants access.

Operators have source-authorized quarantine, reconcile, corrected-cause retry and disposition routes with finite budgets. Observing a clean scan cannot certify authenticity, signature validity, financial acceptance or public rights.

requirements.title: Record exact transformations and whole assemblies
requirements.text: As a reviewer, I want generated representations tied to their exact inputs and recipe, so that transformations never masquerade as received originals.

acceptance.text: Q56 assembly uses a qualified trusted builder over verified immutable selected still-image inputs and the exact page/order/rotation recipe. Complete required input/output qualification and atomic reference protection precede whole-unit source admission. Partial page staging never creates a receipt, acceptance or predecessor fence.

Submitted Originals remain unchanged selected input images; the generated evidence is labeled Assembled PDF, not original or dispensable preview. It is static/inert with no active embedded content, remote fetch or ambient credentials; image-only output does not claim OCR, accessible text, authenticity or legal validity.

Late generation, retry, client upload, cancel or key reuse cannot mutate an admitted output. Same-intake duplicate transport recovers the same result; an eligible later revised assembly is a new whole contribution with preserved input provenance and actual current source authority.

Output access requires the actual current authority for the whole protected representation, including constituent restrictions. A prohibited required constituent blocks the indivisible PDF; output reading does not grant input reading, and inputs do not declassify the output.

Paired reading remains Q29 exact-version reading, not automatic text/visual/legal comparison. Q45 location/comment anchors stay on their exact output or explicitly chosen original and never migrate automatically during conversion/replacement.
