Extraction/OCR/AI use requires its own source/egress/coverage/retention qualification. Embedded instructions are data, not authority. Reader Find and a qualified narrow extraction cannot silently create broad search, suggestions or an AI corpus.

requirements.title: Reuse the complete D32 read-only preview contract
requirements.text: As an authorized reader, I want useful in-product inspection with honest coverage, so that I can review supported documents without an office editor or hidden external upload.
requirements.basis: Founder §9; Q29/Q45/Q56/Q61-C06/P06; P26 D32-R01–R28/P01–P40/O01–O06 and its published source contract.

acceptance.text: DOCX/PPTX declare represented content and omitted revisions/comments/notes/hidden/media/linked content. XLSX uses original coordinates/types/precision/date meaning and saved results without recalculation or external refresh; missing formula cache is unavailable, never zero. CSV preserves formula-looking literal fields with Comma/Semicolon/Tab and View as text; TXT uses strict UTF-8 with optional BOM or UTF-16 with BOM.

Find covers the entire declared represented scope, including not-yet-displayed pages/sheets; partial coverage cannot return a false complete no-match. The reader retains source/task, draft, audience, focus and scroll without copying the file into CRM or an editor.

Preserve the exact D32 preview-only limits: 20 MiB streamed original, 200 MiB expanded package, 10,000 entries, XML depth 128 with no DTD/entities, 200 output pages/visible slides, 40,000,000 pixels per image and 256 MiB aggregate decoded-image working data, 50 total workbook sheets and 100,000 populated cells including hidden input, 1,000,000 text/CSV Unicode scalars and 100,000 CSV populated cells, and 50 MiB output. These are binary MiB limits, not ordinary upload defaults.

Each attempt is bounded by 60 elapsed seconds, 30 aggregate process-tree CPU seconds, 2 GiB process-tree memory and 512 MiB scratch; at most two attempts per generation, the second only for classified transient failure. Deliberate audited recovery after cause correction is distinct from reopening to evade the limit.

Tentative/scratch custody ends within 15 elapsed minutes from attempt start; Ready custody ends within 24 elapsed hours from first Ready, or an earlier governing end. Reading never renews either. Conditional promotion transfers custody; deletion-claimed output cannot promote, and stale tentative cleanup cannot delete Ready output.

The stable source/version/profile/options/restriction key differs from technical generation identity. Concurrent eligible opens coalesce; a new eligible generation after expiry gets its own actual generation without renewing old receipts or original retention. Keys are never reused.

Preserve D32's healthy-load fixture: 100 simultaneous opens across 20 tenants, 80 repeated across five files and 20 distinct cold files no larger than 2 MiB and ten pages or 1,000 cells. Qualified capacity must meet server p95 admission ≤1 second, cold Ready ≤60 seconds and warm first API content ≤2 seconds; include 400 kbps/300 ms/320 CSS-pixel mobile plus maximum/overload qualification. These are required tests, not observed capacity.

Preview generation/read/retry/download creates no P17 preparation, reusable email asset, P6 send, official P18 artifact, CRM file copy, acceptance or new retention purpose. A later deliberate reuse must independently qualify through its actual source.

requirements.title: Authorize private delivery at the actual serving boundary
requirements.text: As a source-authorized reader, I want the exact permitted bytes through a dependable private route, so that possession of an old URL or broad role does not bypass current access.
requirements.basis: Founder §11; Q04/Q06–Q19/Q41/Q44/Q56/Q61-C08/C09; P12, P18 canonical access, P21 D24/D25 and P26 D32.

acceptance.text: Current source restrictions, member/grant/assignment state, classification, original-origin limits and applicable purpose are enforced even for privileged workers, read gateways and service clients. Retention and source-history rights are not continued participant byte access.

Grant expiry or signing-key change is not claimed as immediate source revocation. Each adapter proves the actual source cutoff across origins, caches, tokens and long streams. No public URL, direct bucket, raw provider transform or external-office fallback is available on denial.

Correctly qualified target-use readers may read that use without gaining the original request transcript. Conversely, original request access alone does not grant a new partner, resource, financial or public use.

Temporary authority evaluation failure is distinguishable from terminal withdrawal. Result recovery reveals only currently permitted original facts; it neither repeats writes nor reactivates an ended share/request/result.

Private metadata, thumbnail, rendition, text, manifest and output endpoints follow the same current source boundary. Client-side hiding, static field omission alone or an authorized first page cannot excuse later unauthorized disclosure.

requirements.title: Preserve current stream, cache and access-evidence meaning
requirements.text: As a source owner, I want every delivery path and access record to tell the truth, so that a range request or cached header cannot escape a restriction.
requirements.basis: Founder §11; Q44/Q56/Q61-C09/P04/P15; P12 R6/tiered read/export and source-specific serving contracts.

acceptance.text: A range/resume binds one immutable exact generation and correct length/validator. It cannot concatenate a regenerated result or filter forbidden pieces of an indivisible output. Unsupported ranges report standards-compatible behavior without claiming resume.

Current authorization is set-wise and indexed with stable unique paging where applicable. Preserve R6's logical≤1 governance-row SELECT and≤1 ledger UPDATE for each governed read plus its written physical carve-out; this is not a total SQL limit. Restricted hard-deny budgets use the required unstriped single-row conditional decrement before first streamed row, deny zero, and retain uniform-denial and during-stream expiry rules.

Each distinct egress attempt has actual budget/audit admission. Replaying a preparation receipt does not make redownload or range recovery unmetered. Current private cache/header policy includes error and negative responses and request-bound server clients.

Protected evidence records authorization attempts/decision, exact selected source/version/purpose and observed stream outcome. URL issue is not download; server transfer is not human reading, device saving or verified destination custody; print-dialog opening is not physical custody.

Context change, sign-out and source restriction fence late responses and unsafe client caches. Names, bodies, tokens, raw manifests, source associations and provider locators stay out of general telemetry, analytics, session replay and public error payloads.

Revocation prevents future delivery as actually qualified and never promises recall of already delivered bytes, screenshots or email attachments. Watermarks or disabled controls are not copy-prevention guarantees.

requirements.title: Prepare exact finite export products without collapsing their owners
requirements.text: As authorized staff, I want a complete, verifiable result for my explicit selected export, so that omissions and transfer limits are visible without changing the source records.
requirements.basis: Founder §§8,15; Q44-C01–C16/P01–P44; Q56-C14; P21 D26 and P25/P3 donor-history export.

acceptance.text: Keep original intended selection, evaluated outcomes, admitted subset, sealed generation and distinct transfers separate. Complete means all normalized intended bindings are represented. A safe partial result has at least one included original, truthful permitted omitted outcomes and deliberate Download available files for that exact result; empty or unknown is not a success ZIP.

Protect exact source copies/references during preparation against disposal. Verify streamed original source-qualified SHA-256 digests/lengths and the complete usable archive before Ready. CRC, ETag, signature or provider upload success alone is insufficient. Record whole-ZIP hash/length outside the archive and never overwrite a sealed generation.

Use a qualified interoperable Store/Deflate ZIP profile and ZIP64 only where admitted compatibility requires. Flat safe collision-disambiguated names, a reserved readable UTF-8 contents manifest, Unicode/length/case/device/path/control/bidirectional/header checks and exact source mapping prevent overwrites or traversal. No symlink/device metadata, active executable flags, arbitrary extra fields, multipart/password/SFX workflow, recursive unpacking or macro execution is selected; source-qualified original bytes remain unchanged.

The single contents manifest, such as CONTENTS.txt, shares the authoritative outcome: safe names, explicit preparation-time zone, permitted exact references, original lengths/source-qualified digests and disclosable omission/completeness facts. It is not an official records package, malware certificate, signature or acceptance. No additional PDF/HTML/CSV/JSON export schema is required.

Every ZIP/header/manifest disclosure qualifies the entire indivisible representation. Losing required original or embedded-manifest authority blocks the old result; a changed permitted subset requires a new reviewed operation/result, not in-place filtering. The initiating staff/context is retained; no shared archive audience is created.

One deliberate Download can prepare/deliver the unchanged complete reviewed set while current active intent remains qualified. Slow/returning cases use a deliberate Ready download, not an unexpected late launch. Reads/retries do not renew the finite source-qualified result end; equality is expired. Cancel/expiry ends the old result; Prepare again is a new current act.

Staging, candidates, orphans and held copies count against capacity after availability ends. Cleanup respects actual copy-class holds/retention and current disposition; a restricted held copy is not readable or silently deleted to satisfy a TTL. It does not dispose of source originals.

Q56 Assembled PDF has its own qualified Download action and is not silently inserted/substituted in an original ZIP. P21 D26 records packages and P25/P3 CSV keep their separate content, completeness, clocks and access contracts. A browser download or external upload acknowledgment never proves destination custody or authorizes source disposal.

requirements.title: Prove complete references without disclosing hidden uses
requirements.text: As a source or records operator, I want dependable use coverage, so that an empty visible list cannot cause the destruction of someone else's required evidence.
requirements.basis: Founder §§8,14; Q28/Q41/Q53/Q56/Q58/Q61-C02/C10; ADR0171 Used in and current source registrations.

acceptance.text: Each actual source adapter supplies a typed stable reference, relevant source generation, required protection/copy classes, current change/reconciliation contract and completeness evidence. Missing, stale, failed or unsupported coverage blocks unused/destructive conclusions; it is not zero.

Source/use creation, reference replacement/removal, publication, sharing, intake finalization and output promotion serialize against the relevant copy's disposition claim. Deletion-claimed or possibly deleting material cannot acquire a new protective use until the owning protocol proves a safe outcome.

Used in shows only associations the current viewer may discover. Hidden use, hold, case, count or actor details do not leak through denial text, aggregate counts, search or timing. An actually authorized records operator receives a sufficient protected explanation or capable restricted-owner route.

Reference rebuild verifies exact source versions/generations and complete registered coverage without interpreting arbitrary client JSON as authority. Until reconciliation completes, no complete-unused claim is emitted. Repair preserves lawful independent reads and does not install a global all-product stop.

The consumer ledger below is maintained when a family is added, changed, retired or migrated. Unregistered new readers/writers/processors cannot quietly bypass custody; a phase title alone does not require a new file lane.

requirements.title: Apply independent records protections to the correct scope
requirements.text: As an authorized records actor, I want each actual obligation to protect exactly its records and copies, so that a generic retention label cannot release a hold or keep unrelated data forever.
requirements.basis: Founder §14; Q61-C10/Q62–Q67; P18/P21/P23 source records contracts.

acceptance.text: Each independent source obligation and hold remains separately attributable and current. Releasing/correcting one removes only its own applicable protection; it cannot clear another source's use, duty, classification or pending physical-effect fence.

Hold placement protects necessary evidence but grants no ordinary reading, broader disclosure or public revival. Actual source authority supports capable correction/release; a generic admin role, storage access or policy-edit capability is insufficient.

Default changes, supported external event recording/correction/retraction and existing-record policy application preserve the original admitted basis and truthful accepted facts. Required current restrictive impact fences affected irreversible work before asynchronous reconciliation; a historical binding is neither silently rewritten nor frozen against later lawful source requirements.

Conflicting minimum preservation and required disposition, uncertain applicability or unavailable complete coverage has a named capable records/privacy/legal owner and truthful affected state. No automatic longest/shortest compromise, silent deletion or unlimited-copy exemption resolves the conflict.

Derived previews, optional packages, temporary candidates, originals, admitted assembly outputs, audit/control evidence and backup copies follow their actual class rules. Holding an original does not automatically retain every disposable optional copy; expiring a preview cannot dispose of an admitted evidence output.

requirements.title: Separate source disposition from physical-copy removal
requirements.text: As authorized staff, I want removal and disposal outcomes stated precisely, so that hiding an item is never mistaken for deleting all bytes.

acceptance.text: Candidate discovery or an elapsed period does not authorize destruction. The actual source/policy decides automatic versus required manual release, precise record/copy scope and lawful eligibility; Q63 automatic ordinary mode does not alter P23 retain-until-review/no-automatic-media-purge or other specialist modes.

A finite disposition intent binds exact immutable copy/generation identities and expected relevant source basis, approved action, initiating/executing authority and recoverable result. It cannot expand from a provider prefix, live query or newly discovered file without current qualified admission.

Before destructive admission, prove actual current disposition authority, retention eligibility and complete registered uses/holds/processors/writers/copy coverage. Closed source, missing row, expired grant or empty visible list is insufficient independently and together cannot replace those proofs.

Copy outcomes separately report not started, retained by actual duty, known removed, failed or unresolved possible effect. No Deleted label means all required copies disappeared unless complete copy-specific verification supports it. Access to these details is independently current.

Removal uses the qualified provider mechanism and verification; deleting Storage SQL metadata, receiving a successful envelope or creating a delete marker is not universal physical-disposition proof. Provider versioning/replication/backups require their actual semantics and obligation coverage.

Mistaken disposition already physically completed has only actual lawful qualified recovery, otherwise truthful loss/incident and source remediation. No fictional Undo, old-access revival or authority to restore disposed data follows from the existence of a backup.

requirements.title: Fence final dispatch, late writers and cleanup recovery
requirements.text: As a custody operator, I want cleanup and provider uncertainty to converge safely, so that retries cannot delete newly admitted evidence or resurrect ended work.

acceptance.text: A protection committed before final dispatch admission prevents the conflicting new act. After an attempt may have escaped, stop known-unstarted and remaining work wherever actually possible, protect remaining copies and reconcile the old attempt; do not promise that a later hold or Stop recalled it.

Timeout, process crash, lost response, lease expiry or transient provider error cannot prove nonexecution or erase a possible-delete fence. Every genuinely fresh destructive call requalifies current authority; retry cannot extend an original finite permit or use a new key to bypass a stopped cause.

Late actual physical observations are recorded truthfully even if current policy/hold forbids additional deletion. Observation is not new destructive permission. Conflicting or unknown outcomes remain owned and actionable, not success by assumption.

Promotion/reference protection and cleanup claim have one authoritative ordering. An expired cleanup lease does not reopen admission while a physical delete may still complete. No retired object key is reused while a grant, multipart/resumable session or admitted writer could resurrect it.

Cancellation/expiry fences late output and new delivery without erasing known receipt, original result or independent duties. Blind object cleanup is forbidden after unknown source finalization; reconcile the original operation and copies first.

Q63 Stop remaining persists across scans, transport keys, workers and manual routes for its actual stopped target/basis until qualified cause resolution. New lawful authorization may cover safely unstarted remaining work, preserving possible earlier attempts; it is not a legal hold, clock reset or indefinite duty exemption.

requirements.title: Recover bytes and adverse controls together
requirements.text: As an operator, I want an exercised recovery path for actual files and their restrictions, so that a database backup cannot create a false assurance of recovery.

acceptance.text: An inventory identifies required originals, source-designated retained masters, admitted outputs, renditions and transient/backup classes with actual recoverability and lawful schedules. Unsupported or missing-byte coverage blocks the affected activation and has a capable owner.

Restore first reconciles later withdrawal, expiry, revocation, holds, disposition, ended operations and source currentness before any restored item becomes readable, selectable, public or executable. Old jobs/tokens/keys and stale defaults cannot revive effects.

Verified byte lengths/digests and source/reference parity prove recovered identity. Missing or mismatched bytes remain unavailable; a rebuilt substitute cannot be labeled the same signed/issued/received original or admitted assembly output.

Restore preserves source evidence-only/void/correction and public active-versus-recovery distinctions. It cannot reinstate financial facts, agreement validity, old participant access, recipient shares or public generation eligibility.

Exercise isolated missing-object, partial-copy, metadata/object skew, lost-key, corrupt-manifest and adverse-control scenarios with actual adapter evidence and bounded operator recovery. A hold or disposition conflict is resolved by its owner, not by serving first and reconciling later.

requirements.title: Qualify adapters and exit without changing product identity
requirements.text: As the organization responsible for its records, I want predictable portability and recovery, so that storage changes do not force re-uploading or alter access and evidence.
requirements.basis: Founder §15; Q61-C11; ADR0171; P31 optional transfer contracts.

acceptance.text: For every offered adapter/profile, record its exact supported configuration/version, effective grant/expiry/revocation behavior, object/version identity, incomplete/unknown-write and deletion semantics, location/egress, limits and evidence. ETags are not assumed equivalent to the chosen content digest.

Provider exit follows copy, verify actual destination content and references, register secondary custody, switch one preferred read authority, observe continuity and then independently authorize disposition of eligible old copies. Logical source/version/rendition/release identities and original clocks remain.

A failed or ambiguous copy/transfer preserves the original operation and known safe source copies. Destination acknowledgment or browser download is not verified custody; source deletion is not a completion shortcut.

Optional Drive/Box/SharePoint/S3/SFTP destinations use actual P31 identity, scope, integrity, current authority, residency and recovery qualification. Native browser workflows remain complete without installing a connector.

Adapter replacement or upgrade requalifies affected contracts, including signed carriers, cache behavior, all physical copies and restore. Rollback cannot restore a reader or worker that ignores newly admitted restrictions or identities.

requirements.title: Migrate reached families through one authority cutover
requirements.text: As a user with existing files, I want adoption to preserve relied-upon content and access, so that a new File Manager does not discard my records or keep unsafe old URLs alive.
requirements.basis: Founder §§4,16,19; Q61 R-LEGACY/P13; source cutover contracts including P18 ADR0033 and P23 D27.

acceptance.text: Include legacy editor/document-uploads, Cloudinary/assets, profile/avatar/cover, email-image, Payload Media, generated/PDF, Support, import and specialist paths actually reached. Discover indirect callers and overrides; a literal-name search returning zero does not prove absence.

Inventory old mutable/direct/public writers and readers, thumbnails, transformations, download routes, scripts and cleanup. Disable or adapt conflicting doors coherently at cutover; a compatibility reader must preserve current source policy, not provide a private-to-public fallback.

Compare actual byte integrity and complete source/copy/reference counts, account for exceptions and test old/new representations. No destructive reset, guessed backfill, new fake provenance or Twenty resurrection follows from a fresh-build assumption.

Existing narrow qualified custody remains usable without waiting for the whole explorer or future phases. A missing profile blocks its affected lane with safe unavailable/repair, not all unrelated data work.

Roll-forward or scoped stop preserves committed new facts and current restrictions where old code cannot read them safely. Rollback never means reviving old public URLs, dropped late-write fences or superseded access.

requirements.title: Preserve P22 specialized ministry-media custody
requirements.text: As a public ministry editor, I want safe reusable imagery with exact placement proof, so that private raw media never becomes public merely because upload completed.

acceptance.text: Qualified decoding/sanitization removes prohibited EXIF/location and source-name metadata and independently verifies output. Failure leaves no public object; worker/ministry restrictions remain current additional source floors.

Alt/caption/credit/crop/locale/action and accessibility meaning belong to the exact placement. A shared description is only a suggestion; missing equivalent-content requirements block the actual release through its owner.

A private candidate or storage flag cannot publish a page. Released pages pin exact approved generations until the source activates a successor. Normal placement removal is draft work; actual adverse safety/rights containment blocks current origin before asynchronous cache cleanup, with residual copies reported honestly.

D14 can use only the current D9-certified social derivative and contextual release-pinned text. Custody does not decide discoverability, permalink posture, sharing completion or third-party cache truth.

P22 D25 editorial prose/semantic versions/recovery buffer remain private editorial content, not a new file family or a license for generic scratch cleanup. Asset custody does not edit or dispose of editorial records.

requirements.title: Serve P23 exact public generations and source-owned Trash
requirements.text: As a Media editor or public reader, I want the exact released asset to remain reliable and appropriately withdrawn, so that storage changes do not publish drafts or revive restricted media.

acceptance.text: Public fetch resolves an exact released manifest/generation, never mutable catalog latest, private original or raw provider transformation. Active, bounded delivery-retained and recovery-retained copies remain distinct; recovery retention alone grants no anonymous delivery.

Rights/safety withdrawal and governing expiry deny current origin delivery at the required boundary before asynchronous cache convergence. Cache freshness is bounded before the earliest governing expiry; no completed purge claims external forgetting or recall.

P24 Site/locale/lifecycle and P23 Working Revision/placement/finite-transfer semantics remain source-owned. Provider status cannot substitute for generation activation, source repair or immutable release identity.

Media Trash/restoration retains its D27 semantics; Page/Article whole-record 90-day Trash remains ADR0165-owned. No universal Empty Trash, automatic ordinary clock or cascade to shared Media bytes follows. Restore validates current source rights/proof and never republishes.

Preserve the adopted 25,000-item search and 50-item bulk-upload qualification workloads, constrained mobile/accessibility matrix, processor/cost profiles and complete migration cohort. Catalog operations are typed/indexed/set-wise and do not list provider objects or fetch originals per row.

D27's current retain-until-review/no automatic Media purge stays source-specific. Actual source-version retention changes, complete holds/uses and verified disposal still govern every copy; Q63 ordinary automatic execution does not widen Media authority.

Existing Payload collections can supply qualified authoring machinery only. Native reupload/delete, Local API override, document-version IDs, generic required alt and announced product features do not become D27 custody or publication contracts.

requirements.title: Keep resources, references and conversations independently protected
requirements.text: As a reader returning through a resource, partner record or conversation, I want the correct current representation without gaining unrelated history, so that reuse remains useful and private.
requirements.basis: Founder §§7,10–13; P26/P28; Q55/Q57–Q59/Q65 and the corresponding source volumes.

acceptance.text: P28/Q58 explicitly selected staff/missionary audience membership is not unioned across contexts. Current source publication rights determine resource metadata and bytes; a temporarily empty eligible audience is not automatic withdrawal or unrestricted access.

Q55 review-due state is advisory while independent safety/rights restrictions still bind. Q57 report/own-return and Q59 private Save/Remove rights do not grant historical resource bytes, source text or a wider audience.

Q65 optional partner reference preserves the exact sufficient source-qualified accepted basis, including an indivisible assembly when selected. Current target readers need not browse the originating transcript but remain subject to actual source reuse restrictions and reliance corrections. End/Replace affects the exact use, not agreement validity or shared physical bytes.

P26 attachment occurrence/restriction and D32 output remain within current conversation purpose. CRM display is the same authorized source, not a copied attachment store; preview creates no Support reply, reusable Email Studio asset, official PDF, contact or task.

Source correction, restriction, departure, withdrawal, End and restore propagate their exact relevant current constraints to delivery and required consumers without erasing original outcomes or silently reviving old grants. Independent qualified use and capable protected repair remain distinct.

requirements.title: Bind every existing consumer to its exact owner and repair
requirements.text: As an implementer or source owner, I want every existing document consumer named explicitly, so that a complete File Manager does not omit a financial, public, Support or legacy obligation.
requirements.basis: Founder §§3–4,7,12–16,19; Q61-C02/C06 and all E01–E23 source-register rows; subsequent Q62–Q67 amendments.

acceptance.text: E01 demonstrates current private request→receipt→review→source acceptance/F→authorized read/share with truthful recovery, while source commands remain useful without a configurable Workflow installation.

E02 preserves exact canonical artifact and old evidence-only/void lineage through storage change; generic upload, retitle, rerender or donor old-version picker cannot replace source issuance/currentness.
E03 independently verifies the original population/run and generated version. Missing bytes cannot be filled from later facts and labeled the same historical statement.
E04 preserves Receipt Evidence Asset identity and exact claim coverage through adoption; bytes, scan and quarantine cannot approve a claim or create posted money.
E05 tests prepare-only versus confirmed-submit helper modes and revocation/current-read boundaries; no reusable signed URL or claimant impersonation is accepted.
E06 distinguishes case coordination complete, evidence access failure and actual financial/downstream resolution. Storage outcomes produce none of those source decisions automatically.
E07 refuses unqualified evidence-bearing plans while allowing the independently authorized attachment-free manual path. No receipt/claim/approval/payment is inferred from a quote upload.

E08 keeps raw route/GPS and continuity proof out of ordinary search/export/Support/accounting projections absent exact source permission, and preserves manual source alternatives without inventing zero opening state.
E09 binds exact card-file/source/parser/manifest provenance and current sensitive-data hygiene; moving/deleting the copy cannot rewrite transaction evidence or reconciliation.
E10 rejects activation from generic Import complete and preserves exact versus inert history, source precedence/conservation and correction authority.
E11 checks immutable artifact schema/digest/coverage and source/provider outcomes independently. Stored, downloaded and externally accepted are not Paid.

E12 preserves the complete D26 source-selected six-family content, package representations and manifest/completeness rules. Ordinary Q44 names/schema or a Tenant External Copy Assertion cannot replace them or release source retention.
E13 runs the exact P22 raw/name-discard and no-public-original tests; a generic retained-original default cannot preserve forbidden provenance.
E14 runs exact D1 generation/fetch/retained-route/rights/expiry/withdrawal and P24 Site/locale checks, independent of mutable catalog latest or provider success.
E15 restores Page/Article content under current validation and retained-reference coverage without restoring Media eligibility or deleting another live use.
E16 proves D32 full represented-scope Find, limits, promotion/cleanup and current source retrieval; preview never becomes official artifact, outbound preparation or a CRM copy.

E17 delivers the deterministic useful P27 screen/source links even when an advertised artifact is unavailable; its conditional artifact lane cannot defer the screen or create an unqualified generator.
E18 serializes publication admission/reference protection against disposition and checks audience/restriction changes without granting history through report, due-state or Save features.
E19 proves missionary self-import scope and target admission separately from retained upload/parser output; no raw load, second contact store or inferred candidate disclosure is allowed.
E20's actual source profile and copy/hold/outcome evidence are assessed before any shared adaptation. Its current code or narrow expiry window is not assumed correct for ordinary disposal.

E21 includes every reached old reader/writer and retained byte/URL family in migration and effective-permission checks; a current broad asset row or historical public bucket declaration is neither new authority nor deployed leak proof.
E22 keeps its complete manual first lane; offered scan/generated lanes have separate exact source/custody/renderer qualification. A document pointer is not a binary store or a posted transaction.

E23 retains ten elapsed minutes for the admission envelope and separately ten from durable preparation acceptance; Ready expires 24 hours from first Ready, failed payload no later than 24 hours from acceptance and minimized correlation 30 days. Cancel affects only the extract; lost current disclosure blocks the entire immutable file, no filtered residue or new export-ready notice. This profile is not a Q44/D26/official-document default.

requirements.title: Register each future consumer without back-gating the foundation
requirements.text: As a future domain owner, I want a precise file interface and activation condition, so that I can reuse the foundation without either bypassing my domain rules or waiting for every unrelated phase.
requirements.basis: Founder §§3,13,15–16; Q61-C02/C06 and all eleven future-consumer rows; current program delivery/owner contracts.

acceptance.text: F30 tests upload/parse/review versus actual target admission and source-specific correction; an imported CSV cannot certify financial coverage or replay historical effects.

F31 demonstrates actual destination custody evidence and original ambiguous-transfer recovery before claiming completion or authorizing source disposition. P31 absence does not disable ordinary browser download.

F34 binds the five BP-11 contracts individually: documents.requirement.accepted@1, documents.private-clean-upload.received@1, documents.current-evidence.source-accepted@1, roles.document-source-participant@1 and roles.document-source-reviewer@1. Each gets actual current producer/role/effect/recovery evidence, not merely a registry entry. BP-16 renewal, BP-06 expense follow-up and BP-09 care source contracts are separately qualified and cannot borrow ordinary acceptance or access clocks.
F37 tests participant scope, conditional required-document denial and actual permitted manual/registration alternatives without bypassing its existing source starting gate.

F38 tests denied existence/metadata/body across ordinary roles, exact emergency/lay/professional contexts, restricted egress and capable sealed-source recovery. No generic document role substitutes for the missing policy.

F39 tests only the admitted persistence profile and its revocation/lost-device/TTL/replay behavior. Online transfer resume never silently becomes offline collection, sharing, publication or deletion authority.

F40 tests current purpose/index/source/version/coverage and removal of stale/revoked entries; absent matches from an incomplete index are not a complete answer, and embedded instructions cannot cause tool or policy execution.

F41 tests exact application requirement/subject/readiness/receiving acknowledgment and retained evidence reuse; generic review acceptance or Q60 source correction cannot reopen an application or validate a signature.

F42 treats uploads as inert private artifacts; no dependency install, active HTML/SVG rendering, build or deployment occurs through File Manager. Copy/source/branch and release identities survive qualified migration and exit.
F43 exposes an honest unavailable attachment path until its exact source/channel cohort is qualified; neither a stored file nor an existing phone number authorizes SMS/MMS delivery.

F44 stores only actually required qualified trust/audit material under its source; no unlimited assertion archive or generic file capability is invented. Directory/sign-in repair cannot disclose unrelated bytes.

requirements.title: Operate finite workloads with accountable recovery
requirements.text: As a platform or source operator, I want bounded fair work and actionable failures, so that a large file or outage cannot starve requests, expose data or require routine raw SQL repair.
requirements.basis: Founder §§15–16,19; Q44/Q53/Q56/Q61-C15/B01–B06/M01–M08; exact P12/P23/P26 and consuming-source budgets.

acceptance.text: Before each profile activates, publish finite measured units for file/member counts, encoded/expanded/output bytes, names/manifest sizes, pixel/page/frame/cell limits, CPU/memory/scratch/wall time, concurrency/fairness, query/page work, lock/claim duration, retries/queue age, replay evidence and cleanup/retained-copy capacity. Unknown limits block that profile; vendor or avatar limits are not ordinary defaults.

Preserve exact inherited D32, D27 and P12 workloads and units. Use indexed set-wise current authorization, stable unique pagination and bounded history/result pages; no eager all-library count, provider listing per card, binary/base64 in ordinary rows, whole-input browser memory or global Tenant lock without a separately proved necessity.

Source-budget admission and actual usage account for staging, failed candidates, orphans and held copies, not only visible Ready objects. A hold does not excuse unlimited cost and a quota does not authorize wrongful deletion; contain new work and route actual records/capacity conflict.

Operations expose permitted counts, oldest age, cause and actual next action for stuck transfers, scans/previews, unknown provider results, integrity mismatch, orphan/reconciliation backlog, stale references, holds/disposal, quota pressure and restore/exit failure. Missing or departed owner has an actual capable scoped successor route.

Any verified cross-scope disclosure/mutation, duplicate business effect, stale revival, adverse cutoff breach, unsafe destructive admission or restore-suppression failure contains the affected door/cohort, preserves minimal evidence and requires corrected negative/native proof before reopening. Monitoring cannot waive a missing correctness gate.

Required follow-through missing/ownerless or beyond its qualified deadline remains unresolved and reaches its actual source/P9/P6 owner. Retry/reconcile reuses the original effect and permitted current scope; no new message purpose or resurrected ended occurrence follows from a file job.

Hard resource-bound exceedance stops or bounds affected work while preserving fairness and privacy. Alert windows, capacity/cost thresholds and response owners use the actual admitted profile and observed workload, not an invented universal number or zero-cost claim.

Security audit, business history and minimized diagnostics have distinct current access/retention. Opaque correlation and classified diagnostic codes support repair without raw private names, bodies, source narratives, locations, tokens or signed URLs in general logs/metrics/events.

A scoped kill switch stops new affected intake/processing/delivery/disposition admissions as its source requires while preserving lawful original-result recovery, retained reading, protection and cleanup. Reenablement does not resurrect ended intent, expired proofs or old dispatch generations.

User recovery remains available through supported source/operator actions rather than repeated provider-console or SQL edits. Known success survives a failed secondary refresh; unknown never becomes a fresh retry key, guessed failure, empty list or fabricated completion.

requirements.title: Qualify the shared boundary through real behavior and exact trace
requirements.text: As a release owner, I want evidence tied to each actual source and path, so that formal publication, a green mock suite or a service-role test cannot be mistaken for safe production capability.
requirements.basis: Founder §§3–4,16,19; Q61-C01–C16/P01–P16; all adopted source-specific proof obligations; confirmed `/to-spec` testing seams; REQ29-P01–P18.

acceptance.text: Trace each source family and consumer individually through adopted decision/glossary, requirement/AC, owning source projection, design/task, exact actual ticket when established, test evidence and release gate. The E/F ledger and mapping retain unknown producer/ticket/status facts explicitly. Do not mark an unsupported source behavior implementation-ready by naming a test.

Native tests exercise actual current actor/session/membership and source capability, application/database Tenant agreement and reset through success/error/cancel/retry. A prepared principal, user metadata, client actor argument, broad staff role or service token is not trusted source proof.

Qualify effective schema/table/column/sequence/default/named/inherited function EXECUTE and overload grants, old/resulting USING/WITH CHECK behavior, policy composition, SELECT/RETURNING, INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/UPSERT/MERGE/COPY/bulk, trigger-transformed rows, views/definers/owners/FORCE/BYPASS/search_path and every raw API/RPC/GraphQL/collection/service/NHI/worker/import/restore/storage door. Zero changed rows cannot report business success. Omitted WITH CHECK or DEFINER keywords alone do not prove effective behavior.

Use actual concurrent sessions and controlled ordering for receipt/correction/F, publication/withdrawal, share/revocation, use/hold/disposal and finalize/promotion/cleanup. Include after-wait authority, rollback/crash/lost response, late callback, finite handoff/lease expiry and old restore. Serial toy models and mocked promise orders are not native race evidence.

Recover matching original effects before fresh eligibility under current disclosure; reject changed intent, stale/ABA or unverifiable expired work after control cleanup/restore. Genuine later lawful acts remain possible under actual semantic identity; no blanket permanent digest lock. Required current history/result/follow-through are coherent with the source effect.

Prove actual private full/range/HEAD/conditional/cache/current stream behavior and all derived disclosure surfaces, source-specific processor fidelity/hostile corpus, immutable generations, complete use/copy coverage, provider partial/unknown outcomes, byte recovery and exit. Database row backup, fake Storage remove or public-avatar smoke does not pass this evidence.

Complete one real private request→review→authorized share journey and one public asset→placement→release→withdrawal journey, then all supported source/organization/resource/bulk/recovery cases. Keep direct/assisted camera and prepared-file alternatives qualified; actual unsupported format or inaccessible fallback is not a completed cohort.

Actual keyboard, screen reader, non-drag pointer, touch, mobile reflow/zoom, long international names, RTL/IME and weak-network/lost-response tasks pass with trustworthy current source states. Reused ReUI/Base UI or an axe scan does not certify them. Pilot evidence records actual participants, tasks, conditions, comprehension and recovery without invented results.

Apply per-source tests for every E01–E23 and F30–F44 row when that consumer lane is reached. A conditional F43/F44 lane can remain explicitly unsupported without inventing a feature; no whole future phase blocks an independently qualified foundation.

Source-policy material gaps, current producer/adaptor gaps, legacy census and native/user evidence gaps stay distinct with exact owner, safe behavior, closure evidence and requalification trigger. Affected destructive or private/public exposure actions remain unavailable until their gates pass; independently lawful work continues.

Formal requirements, structural validation, accepted review, issue publication and merged documentation do not count as implemented, qualified or activated. Keep implementation/acceptance tasks open until actual evidence exists; archive only under the repository's implementation-completion rule.

requirements.title: Apply the actual approved ordinary policy
requirements.text: As a request issuer, I want to apply the approved default or make a genuinely required authorized choice, so that I can issue safely without becoming a records administrator.

acceptance.text: A qualified default is shown and applied by the normal Issue action without another retention confirmation; an authorized required-choice case cannot issue before a valid choice.
Missing, incompatible and temporarily unknown policy results remain distinct, preserve independently lawful preparation and block only the affected consequential act.
A not-yet-occurred qualified trigger is displayed as not yet started; it is not replaced with today, upload time or a guessed period.

Map actual approved ordinary purpose/family/record/copy contracts to source policy/version and trusted applicability. Reject unapproved/incompatible scope; valid not-yet-triggered succeeds. No universal fallback.
Exercise one default, authorized alternative, source-required selection, absent choice power, missing policy and unknown check. One normal Issue under A; no selection/blur/Cancel effect.

Prove each draft/allocation/upload/finalization/new-use stage has its own lawful admission; templates/current source class and late contributions cannot import stale policy or retrospectively authorize data.

Trace each clause to canonical owner/OpenSpec projection/design/task and later ticket/native/release evidence; verify glossary/previous decisions, exact source binding/qualification, no unsafe writer or provider fallback, and per-cohort activation.

requirements.title: Explain policy without duplicating routine work
requirements.text: As a request issuer, I want to see a safe policy summary in the existing review, so that I understand the consequence in the fewest reasonable steps.

acceptance.text: The review displays approved name, covered purpose and start meaning; multiple classes are not presented as one false deletion date.
Change is offered only with a real authorized compatible alternative; policy inspection and selection do not issue, send or dispose.
Draft prose, staged bytes and processing have their own prior lawful admission; a later Issue cannot retroactively authorize them.

Real actors across Tenant/environment/source and capability/field boundaries: forged IDs, stale claims, anonymous versus authenticated role, former membership, restricted details, no-Party supported actor and current result disclosure. All relevant API/read/cache paths deny or safely project as intended.

Distinguish every relevant class/use and lifecycle event, including assembly inputs/output, copies, reuse, Checking, F/C, access change and valid event pending. Exact calendar/elapsed/date-zone boundaries, including DST/year boundaries and trusted actual event/effectivity after waits rather than transaction-start time or browser clock; no implicit universal timer.

Native catalog/role tests for PUBLIC/named/default/inherited schema/table/column/sequence/EXECUTE grants and overloads; null-complete scoped FK/check/unique/delete behavior including qualified global definitions; SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/MERGE/UPSERT/RETURNING, trigger-result rows, views/materializations/REST/GraphQL/RPC, actual function owner/search path/FORCE/BYPASS/service roles and every privileged/import/worker/operator/direct/Storage path. Exercise application/database context agreement and pooled success/error/cancel/retry cleanup. Attempt forbidden reparenting/attribution/current-head updates.

Intended staff and participant-safe journeys on actual UI: explain policy scope/start versus access, perform real choice/correction, recover unknown outcome. Keyboard/AT/reflow/RTL/IME/locale/weak network, deliberate focused-button activation via Enter/Space and no Issue/Correct assignment from IME confirmation, select/blur or unrelated controls, no hover-only meaning,320 CSS pixel ordinary vertical reflow and authored overlays never entirely obscuring focus; verify against shared design system.

requirements.title: Preserve original assignment and current applicability
requirements.text: As a records actor, I want to retain historical policy evidence while applying valid current changes, so that current duties and prior decisions remain understandable.

acceptance.text: Issuance and the exact actual default or chosen binding commit coherently with history and original result; failed refresh recovers that result.
A changed discretionary default affects new uses prospectively; mandatory current duties establish the current result or restrictive pending-impact fence before affected irreversible work.
Relevant material change requires deliberate re-review; unrelated edits do not. A still-valid deliberate choice survives a default change.
Retries preserve original actor, time and binding; same key with changed meaning conflicts and stale change-away-and-back intent cannot act.

Both-order races for issuance versus relevant default/purpose/choice/restriction changes, concurrent edits, stale reviewed basis and same-intent/different-payload replay. No duplicate or silent rebind; unchanged basis remains usable. Same-name changed meaning, preserved valid explicit choice, authorized no-op, stale change-away-and-back and later legitimate intent are separate cases.

Inject failures before commit, after commit/before reply, during refresh and after required secondary intent; expire source-qualified recovery/control evidence and verify old unverifiable intent cannot create a new effect after readable history cleanup or restore. Reconcile one original effect, correct attribution and known/unknown state with retained safe input; no reset or false retry success.

Actual current successor-impact and mistaken-assignment correction, wrong-correction correction, expected-basis conflict and later evidence. Review safe current/proposed assignment and consequence before deliberate correction, with trusted cause or concise required input and no blanket essay. A real factual correction remains attributable even if its effective policy/date is unchanged. Already-lost bytes permit only separately lawful qualified recovery, else truthful incident/source remediation. Preserve original version/trigger; no edit-time clock, independent hold release or request-state rewrite. Prove per-class current results or restrictive pending impact, with stale destructive work fenced; assignment correction is not physical completion.

Actual policy-owner repair, durable impact work, dead-letter/retry and safe operator evidence use existing source/P9 ownership. Repair returns to current review, not automatic issue. Logs carry no sensitive policy/body/token data.

Old/new code/schema, supported legacy evidence mapping, resumable backfill, kill switch and rollback/roll-forward with new data already admitted. Restore preserves current correction/hold/revocation before access.

requirements.title: Correct an assignment without erasing facts
requirements.text: As an authorized records actor, I want to correct a mistaken assignment or qualified trigger, so that the right current rule applies without rewriting history.

acceptance.text: Correct policy assignment shows exact current basis and proposed approved consequence, preserves history and records the real correction actor and evidence.
Correction never resets a clock to edit time, releases an independent hold, revives participant access or claims absent bytes restored.
Reused bytes and assembly inputs, output, history, messages and copies retain each actual class obligation; one use ending is not all-copy deletion.

Complete use/hold/processor coverage and physical-delete races, still-usable upload/writer fencing, unknown/partial provider outcome and expired cleanup leases that must not reopen promotion while deletion may complete, independent access containment, all-copy obligations, byte+metadata restoration and adverse-first serving.

requirements.title: Qualify policy application through every path
requirements.text: As a tenant administrator, I want to have policy admission and recovery enforce current source boundaries, so that a UI shortcut or old writer cannot bypass policy.

acceptance.text: Real-role mutation, result and restore tests prove same-scope relationships, trusted attribution, old and resulting row restrictions and pooled-context cleanup.
Limited summary/history rights never expose body or hold details; late responses after a scope change are discarded.
Unknown legacy bindings remain restrictive and repairable rather than receiving invented historical approval or destructive eligibility.

Record measured P12 logical and physical query plans, real-role option/mutation/history/impact limits, tenant skew, retry pressure and peak workloads. Prove stable deterministic options/history paging with a unique tie-breaker and current per-page rights under concurrent change. Preserve R6 logical ≤1 governance-row SELECT plus ≤1 ledger UPDATE where applicable and its written physical-shard carve-out; restricted hard-deny remains unstriped before egress and safety-uniformity takes precedence. Enforce actual finite budgets without lowering authorization.

requirements.title: Admit only expressly authorized automatic disposal
requirements.text: As an authorized records operator, I want to let approved routine disposal proceed for exact eligible targets, so that routine work needs no repeated release while required human cases remain protected.

acceptance.text: Discovery, preview and worker claim never authorize a provider delete; final fixed targets retain actual policy mode and qualified execution identity.
Manual-required, unknown-mode, specialist and unmapped legacy cohorts cannot enter the ordinary automatic route.
No new candidate joins an already authorized batch; blocked targets and source-declared indivisible groups retain correct distinct results.
Actual ordinary policy/profile authorizes automatic mode; missing/ambiguous/retired modes fail affected admission. P23/specialist/manual/transient-copy rules remain unchanged.
Candidate discovery/GET/render/prefetch/filters are inert; mandatory human release is deliberate and exact; no timeout approval. Distinct configuration/activation/authorization/execution history.
Actual typed policy events, effectivity, civil/elapsed/date-zone boundaries and after-wait time; no age/closure/assignment/creator-session default or retrospective fabricated approval.
Finite immutable batch membership, independently actionable versus source-indivisible groups, new targets excluded, correct per-target/aggregate partial results and shared-use identities.

Native human/system/NHI current context/capability, live delegation/owner ceiling and actual revocation/credential-epoch mechanism where the qualified source uses one, creator departure, forged job/tenant/policy/locator inputs and correct actual execution attribution. No generic new epoch column is mandated.

requirements.title: Order disposal against uses holds and writers
requirements.text: As a custody operator, I want to have one final current dispatch admission, so that concurrent new uses or restrictions cannot be missed.

acceptance.text: A committed conflicting hold, use or Stop before final admission prevents that admission; all participating finalization, promotion and restore paths honor the same fence.
An expired dispatch permit or worker generation cannot send a fresh call; its expiry does not clear an earlier possible effect.
After possible external dispatch, a later Stop reports may-have-started scope, protects remaining copies and reconciles the actual outcome without promising recall.
Both-order races at the actual final dispatch gate for policy/mode/hold/use/stop/correction/finalization/promotion; T01/T02 demonstrate early claim versus final gate and honest post-gate limits.

Crash/failure before/after final admission and before/after network IO; durable attempt/fence/history/result before external effect, finite dispatch permit/handoff validity and superseded-worker-generation checks, no long SQL/provider transaction assumption and no duplicate semantic effect. An expired permit prevents fresh late dispatch but does not erase earlier possible effects or their fences.

requirements.title: Reconcile actual copy outcomes
requirements.text: As a custody operator, I want to recover exact destructive attempts after ambiguous responses, so that retries do not cause unqualified additional deletion.

acceptance.text: Provider outcomes distinguish confirmed removal, qualified absence, failure, unknown and still-required copies; generic 404, envelope success and SQL metadata deletion are insufficient.
A takeover may reconcile original evidence, but every new destructive submission requires fresh current admission for the exact target.
Late qualified physical evidence can be recorded despite a new hold without authorizing another delete or overwriting a newer fact; retired locators cannot endanger new bytes.

Actual provider protocol/installed SDK exact path/version/generation, per-item/mixed/absent/denied responses, unknown timeout and complete copy proof; false whole-envelope success is rejected. Record true late physical facts even after adverse policy/hold changes, without granting further deletion or allowing stale evidence to overwrite newer verified results.

Lease expiry, error, stale worker, possible late delete/put, duplicate transport and control-history cleanup/restore cannot clear ambiguity or reopen reference/promotion. Distinguish evidence-only reconciliation from a retry capable of a new delete, which requires fresh current admission even with the same key; after a new hold/stop no newly unauthorized request may be sent. Negative proof excludes unsafe late effects.

requirements.title: Stop remaining work and repair without fictitious undo
requirements.text: As an authorized records actor, I want to contain preventable work and resolve its cause, so that mistakes are repairable with honest limits.

acceptance.text: Stop commits a cause-owned barrier against rediscovery across scans, new keys, workers and manual routes; canceling only one queue row fails acceptance.
Cause resolution permits only fresh current eligibility and preserves independent holds and unresolved possible effects.
Manual cases use sufficient permitted evidence and deliberate release; automatic routine cases need no per-file checkbox.
Mistaken loss preserves evidence and invokes independently lawful recovery or reports irrecoverable loss, never a forced recipient reupload or metadata-only recovery claim.

Stop cause persists across rediscovery/new keys/manual routes; original unknown attempts reconcile separately from fresh safe reconsideration. Same-state no-op, stale basis and later legitimate resolution preserve attribution and independent holds.
Separate source-use end versus physical removal; independent copies/assemblies/history/backup/external limits; mistaken-disposal loss/qualified recovery and adverse-first restore.

Measured bounded query plans/indexes/lock/target/copy/retry/impact budgets, stable unique paging/current per-page rights, tenant skew/provider throttling/fairness and applicable P12 R6 logical/physical/restricted limits.

requirements.title: Operate disposal with bounded private evidence
requirements.text: As a records operator, I want to see exact scoped progress and supported recovery, so that unsafe work does not disappear into a powerless queue.

acceptance.text: All private projections and real database/service/provider doors preserve current restrictions and immutable target identity.
Partial and unknown outcomes retain a capable owner and bounded reconciliation; operator status never claims deleted everywhere without qualified complete copy proof.
Mixed versions and restore preserve stops and possible-effect fences; unsupported old workers cannot resume destructive work.
Tenant/environment/source isolation and field/body/hold/proposal/count/history/result rights across API/direct/worker/operator paths, context changes and stale caches.
Actual capable source/records/P9 exception/manual/stop/required-deadline coverage, supported incident repair without SQL, truthful audit and no unselected notice/reminder effects.

Real UI users distinguish candidate, authorized, possible, partial, stopped and verified scope. Keyboard/AT/320CSSpx/zoom/RTL/long labels/weak-network/cookie-command origin checks, visible unobscured focus under sticky overlays and meaningful pending/partial/error/result announcements without focus theft. Focused-button Enter/Space remains usable; IME confirmation/select/blur/navigation cannot initiate destruction, Stop or cause-resolution. No forced preview, hover-only meaning or fake Undo.

Native constraints and effective named/PUBLIC/default/inherited schema/table/column/sequence/EXECUTE, overload/owner/search_path/FORCE/BYPASS/service, USING/resulting WITH CHECK, SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/RETURNING/UPSERT/MERGE/trigger, views/GraphQL/RPC/Storage and pooled-context tests. Reject target/tenant/actor/fence mutation; zero rows is not success.

Exact legacy census/mapping, compatible old/new readers/writers/jobs, bounded mode-change activation, stop/rollback/roll-forward and adverse-first metadata+byte restore. No new interpretation of old history.

Clause→source/ADR/OpenSpec projection/design/task→later ticket/test/release trace with actual installed provider qualification and current source evidence. Documentation or a specialized Eve test does not qualify ordinary disposal.

requirements.title: Admit an optional partner reference to exact accepted evidence
requirements.text: As an authorized partner staff member, I want to use qualifying collected evidence for ongoing partner work, so that I can reuse it without a second archive or automatic exposure.

acceptance.text: Collection/review/handoff works fully without a reference; acceptance or relationship creation never adds one automatically.
Use for partner reference binds exact accepted unit, requirement revision, provenance and dependencies; an approved sufficient subset truthfully states coverage.
Admission need not await unrelated whole-request completion, but cannot infer acceptance from upload, workflow or digest equality.
Actual narrow reference contract and P9 target integration; original request/P29/P12/GEN-05 owners remain separate. Prove no signature/legal/partner/money side effect.
Full collection works without reference; full qualified reference lifecycle works without configurable Workflow. No automatic Use from Accept/finish.

Exact multi-file/assembly/original provenance and adoption basis; sufficient source-qualified subset or narrower representation preserves required basis/dependencies and truthful coverage; byte equality never copies acceptance.

requirements.title: Separate reference authority identity and availability
requirements.text: As a partner staff member, I want to read or manage a permitted reference under its own purpose, so that ongoing work survives request-window expiry without broad access.

acceptance.text: Reference read requires target-purpose authority and continuing restrictions, not original request-browsing rights; it exposes no original transcript or unrelated history.
Multiple legitimate distinct references coexist; equivalent active effects deduplicate without permanent digest uniqueness blocking fresh lawful admission after End.
Admission and copy protection commit coherently against current restriction and deletion fences; incomplete preparation is never available operational evidence.
Available/restricted/unknown versus ended/replaced; same-basis blocker repair versus new acceptance; no automatic latest/revival.
Both orders of reference admission versus holds, restrictions, deletion claims, writers/processors/restore; all required components protected before favorable use.
Concurrent equivalent additions yield one actual effect; distinct legitimate uses coexist; ended historical identity does not permanently block fresh lawful admission or revive old commands.

requirements.title: Replace end and correct partner references deliberately
requirements.text: As an authorized reference manager, I want to replace or end an exact reference and make a fresh lawful admission, so that I can correct mistakes without rewriting evidence history.

acceptance.text: Replace commits the qualified successor and actual old-use end coherently; failed replacement retains only an independently lawful predecessor.
End works through sufficient permitted metadata even when reading or unrelated replacement is unavailable; wrong-target repair never reparents history.
An accidental End can be followed by a fresh linked admission under current authority after resolving the cause; no forced reupload or invented new business need is required.
A source acceptance correction immediately restricts unsupported reliance. Clearing a blocker can restore the same still-admitted basis, while a new acceptance basis requires deliberate adoption.

Actual atomic successor/end/protection semantics; failed candidate preserves lawful old use, unsafe old use remains restricted; End possible without unnecessary body-read grant or unrelated invalid/unsaved draft validation.

Crash/timeout around each source/history/result/follow-through boundary; changed intent same key, complete no-op, stale ABA and expired unverifiable intent; one semantic outcome and current disclosure.
Actual independent obligations/hold/use/copy coverage; no privacy-duty evasion by adding purpose, no end-as-delete, full Q62/Q63 disposition/unknown/restore proof.

Wrong partner, missing bytes, source correction, accidental End with a continuing lawful need, lost result and departed owner resolved through actual capable source actions; no routine SQL/public fallback/forced reupload.
Actual admitted/ended/replaced time, source acceptance/correction/policy facts and live restrictions; no backdating or read/retry clock resets. Business, security and telemetry evidence distinct.

requirements.title: Qualify partner reference usability and recovery
requirements.text: As a partner staff member, I want to use clear contextual reference controls, so that I can understand each use and recover safely.

acceptance.text: Use, Open, Replace and End stay in the qualified source context; End explains that collection history remains.
Cross-tenant, forged actor, unsafe cascade, direct RPC/Storage and late-response paths cannot disclose or transform the reference into forbidden scope.
Restore cannot revive ended uses or expired participant grants; missing native/policy/target qualification blocks only the affected adoption cohort.

Real permitted/forbidden roles, stale JWT, service/NHI, tenant switches and all C15 native DML/grant/function/view/Storage/worker/import/operator paths; trusted app/DB context/missing-mismatch denial/pool reset.
Null-complete same-scope FKs/equivalents, source-specific uniqueness, immutable actor/target/basis/time/history, no reparent/cascade/dangling active use; valid global definitions stay possible.

Target-only permitted metadata/body versus hidden original history/other uses, complete/HEAD/range/conditional reads, counts/search/provenance/export/log/cache/late responses; no access by relationship.
Actual retained-data census, source/reliance mappings, old/new reader/writer compatibility, guarded cohorts and kill/roll-forward behavior; no inferred old use or historical consent.
Real byte versus metadata restore and adverse control precedence; exact immutable provider target/copy semantics; no ended-use revival or physical-success claim from SQL.

Actual staff tasks for optional Add, exact Read, Replace, End, wrong target, correction/restriction and unknown result; keyboard/AT/mobile/RTL/reflow/weak-network proof with Base UI. No forced preview or routine extra governance form.
B01–B04 with declared units/load/skew, setwise current permissions, stable unique/current-page results and exact P12 R6 distinctions; bounds and recovery proven at/over limits.

requirements.title: Create and configure tenant-owned records policies
requirements.text: As an authorized tenant records actor, I want to create blank or copied policies and edit supported business values, so that my organization can change its policy without vendor intervention.

acceptance.text: Blank and authorized-copy drafts allow supported names, classes, applicability, event precision, units, retention/review bounds, mode and responsibility references without inheriting approval or assignments.
Valid shortening, lengthening and supported finite or continuing treatment are possible; no preset-only or original-author-only restriction is imposed.
Policies cannot define arbitrary SQL/event meaning or override independent duties; GF drafts remain an unapproved worked example and never ship to other tenants as active policy.
Actual ordinary tenant definition lifecycle and source bindings; specialist/P12/P29 owners intact, no GF or static-org identity shortcut.
Blank/copy/custom values, manager-only authoring, normal issuer flow, no required Asym ticket/code edit for supported business values.
Actual classes/units/precision/calendar/event boundaries, zero/invalid/unknown/continuing cases and compatible multiple obligations; no arbitrary cap or SQL.

requirements.title: Version activate retire and reactivate policy meaning
requirements.text: As an authorized tenant records actor, I want to change governing policy deliberately while preserving old meaning, so that history stays reliable and mistaken retirement is repairable.

acceptance.text: Activated governing meaning is immutable; material or uncertain edits create a successor while the operative version remains until qualified activation.
A proved non-operative metadata edit retains attribution and historical displays without a needless semantic version; the caller cannot self-classify it as harmless.
Retirement stops scoped new assignments but preserves existing obligations. Unchanged retired meaning can be deliberately reactivated after fresh qualification without duplicate version creation.
Activation records governing and recorded times honestly and fences unresolved mandatory current impact before affected irreversible actions.
Draft/effective meaning/default/applicability/retirement/reactivation/pause remain distinct, including valid accidental-retirement recovery.
Both race orders of publish/default/source restriction and issuance/disposal; actual mandatory existing impact fenced before unsafe effects.

requirements.title: Apply policy changes to existing records and pause independently
requirements.text: As an authorized tenant records actor, I want to review existing-record impact and pause new automatic disposal, so that I retain useful control without silently sweeping records.

acceptance.text: Apply to existing records uses reviewed exact source/class/use scope and current basis; hidden or unknown coverage never appears as zero or successful skipping.
Bounded partial impact reports per-target results; a qualified subset is possible while mandatory unresolved duties remain fenced.
Pause works independently of invalid drafts or replacement preparation and acknowledges possibly dispatched work separately.
Resume requires a new deliberate current act, complete eligibility and unresolved-effect checks; it cannot revive stale workers or command intent.
Exact scope/basis, current preview revalidation, eligible subsets, partial progress, no silent skip or widening, per-target recovery and completion truth.

requirements.title: Preserve policy classes and coherent current effects
requirements.text: As a tenant records actor, I want to have every policy change use trusted typed source facts, so that a flexible editor cannot corrupt authority or trigger dates.

acceptance.text: Date-only and instant rules, not-yet-started, unknown and continuing/review treatment remain distinct under actual source semantics.
Actual actor, approval, semantic version, current binding and source scope cannot be forged or changed by general updates.
Policy changes, Stop, holds, references and disposal order against the same effective boundary; retries recover originals and do not clear possible external effects.

Competing editors, ABA, same visible value with changed meaning, duplicate activation/assignment and current complete semantic no-op; a true no-op creates no new effective version, activation time or existing-record impact, while original replay recovers the original result with separately qualified current state. Prove cosmetic metadata versus governing-meaning classification at the source, not by caller flag.
Faults around each authoritative/history/result/follow-through/chunk boundary; original result recovery and expired unverifiable-intent rejection.
Actual roles, revoked/stale credentials, no-Party/NHI where supported, all C16 doors/grants/trigger/result rows and app/DB context/pool reset.
Scoped/null-complete keys/equivalents, immutable schema/meaning/actor/basis, safe deletes, valid states/default resolution and source-specific uniqueness.

Both orders with reference/use/hold/writer/dispatch and actual disposition authority/retention eligibility; finite handoff/current worker generation, fresh destructive-retry authorization and Stop persistence across new keys/versions. Expired permits or leases preserve earlier possible-effect fences; record late physical facts despite a new policy/Stop, without treating observation as a fresh delete or claiming instant recall.
Original assignments/trigger/admission vs current applicability and true recorded/effective dates; policy editing cannot manufacture past approvals.

requirements.title: Make policy administration usable and evolvable
requirements.text: As a tenant records actor, I want to use understandable accessible policy controls and safe upgrades, so that ordinary staff need not become policy-system experts.

acceptance.text: Routine request/reference work retains concise summaries; only policy managers see eligible editing actions with normal review and no universal second approver.
Policy interpretation is versioned with its values; old workers that cannot interpret a version deny new effects while preserving history and recovery.
Unknown legacy approval is not inferred from GF text, JSON, labels or upload times; supported correction and capable handoff remain available.
Policies, impact samples/counts, reasons/history/exports/logs/cache and late responses reveal only current allowed scope; manager power gives no body grant.
Wrong policy/scope, missing approval, unavailable evidence, partial impact, departed owner and paused work have actual capable supported correction.
Real census and policy-schema mapping, old/new compatibility, guard-before-writer sequencing, scoped kill/roll-forward; no JSON/name-derived approval.
Exact native/provider copies and actual byte recovery distinct from SQL; adverse control facts precede new effects and serving after restore.

Actual complete manager and issuer tasks, change review, independent pause and ambiguous-result recovery; visible unobscured focus, meaningful AT pending/partial/result announcements, preserved draft/focus through error/return, mobile/RTL/unit/date/reflow, and passive select/blur/navigation/IME versus deliberate focused Enter/Space.

B01–B04 under declared load/skew with finite lock/retry/work and safe at/over-bound outcomes. P12 R6 bounds each governed read to logical ≤1 governance-row SELECT + ≤1 ledger UPDATE, with its documented physical-shard carve-out; this is not a cap on all SQL in a policy mutation. Preserve restricted-tier safety/uniformity precedence and restricted-person/read-export unstriped conditional budget admission before first-row egress, denying zero-row admission. Verify setwise batch/stream behavior and current checks per chunk against the actual source.

requirements.title: Record supported actual external events
requirements.text: As an authorized source staff member, I want to record an actual supported event with its true date and provenance, so that records duties can use real facts without an unnecessary integration.

acceptance.text: The contextual form fixes qualified subject/event, requests only genuinely missing evidence and gives one specific Record event action with safe material consequences.
A staff report is labeled according to its actual accepted assertion; it cannot mint another owner's completion, legal validity, acceptance or settlement.
Late permitted reporting preserves occurred date/precision separately from server recorded time; future plans, invented midnight and missing-date defaults are rejected.
Initial recording, correction, policy editing and body reading require their distinct current powers.

For Actual owner/event/subject/capability/evidence profile, Exact source supports the event and accepted assertion; unsupported event and domain-completion impersonation denied. No invented GF/legal approval.
For Native auth and permission matrix, Valid, revoked, stale-claim, wrong-purpose, cross-tenant/environment, no-Party, NHI and dual-role cases enforce actual rights and current disclosure.

For Date and source precision boundary tests, Date-only/timezone/UTC-boundary, leap/calendar, ambiguous/nonexistent local time, past/future and unknown/partial inputs preserve actual meaning or reject with usable repair.

For Two-actor and native/manual/integration race tests, Both arrival orders yield correct same/distinct occurrence identities; contradictory facts follow source resolution; no last-write-wins or arbitrary conflict DoS.
For Accessible native interaction checks, Keyboard/AT/touch, 320 CSS pixels/zoom, long/RTL labels, date entry, error and focus/status behavior pass Core's actual UI requirements.

For Actual staff and restricted-role journey, Authorized person records, reviews consequence, corrects a mistake and recovers a lost response without developer intervention; restricted person cannot. Record observations, not claimed interviews.

requirements.title: Reconcile event recordings across producers
requirements.text: As a source operator, I want to reconcile the same business occurrence across staff and integration reports, so that duplicate delivery does not start duplicate records clocks.

acceptance.text: Business occurrence, command and delivery attempt have separate identities; subject/type/date alone is not universal dedupe for real repeating events.
Contradictory reports use source precedence/evidence resolution, not last arrival or human-always-wins; new corroboration can matter despite unchanged date.
Current interpretation, required safety effects and original result commit coherently with durable bounded impact. Unknown original outcomes are recovered before new work.

For Complete-intent/original-result tests, Same operation replay recovers its original result with separately qualified current corrected/retracted state; it cannot revive old effects. Changed intent or stale relevant/ABA basis conflicts; complete semantic no-op preserves attribution, while material corroboration remains possible without a new occurrence.
