Failed response or form close does not duplicate; current denial does not disclose old result.

For Crash/fault injection at authoritative and follow-through boundaries, No accepted occurrence without required history/result/control; no unsafe gap after commit; bounded retries recover true status.

For Hold/Stop/impact/disposal race and restore tests, Test both orderings, finite permit/worker generation and already possible external effect; expiry does not clear uncertainty. Each fresh destructive retry requalifies. Late physical evidence is recorded despite correction/retraction/Stop without issuing a new delete; no false restoration claim.

For Production-shaped capacity and fair-work evidence, Measured defined maximum supported input/fanout and skew complete within declared finite profiles, with stable unique setwise current-page/chunk projection and exact inherited P12 R6 logical/physical/restricted safety rules. Saturation is bounded/visible and cannot starve another tenant or bypass guards.

requirements.title: Correct retract and apply external facts without historical replay
requirements.text: As an authorized source actor, I want to correct an exact recording or retract mistaken reliance, so that current duties become accurate without rewriting history or resending old work.

acceptance.text: Correction preserves occurrence identity; retraction removes only reliance on that input and retains valid independent evidence.
Mistaken retraction permits fresh current acceptance of the same occurrence; wrong-target containment works independently of successful correct-target preparation.
Late facts may change current records obligations but cannot replay historical workflows, notices, access, collection or unrelated outward effects.
Later records use their own current applicability to the existing occurrence, never duplicate it just to start another clock.

For Correction/retraction/reacceptance/wrong-target tests, Original retained; independently valid evidence survives; mistaken retraction recovers same occurrence; wrong-target partial repair is explicit and safe.
For Historical and later-record consumer tests, Current lawful records impact works; old workflow notices/enrollments remain dark; later records reuse actual fact under correct class policy.

requirements.title: Qualify external-event capture across private and recovery paths
requirements.text: As a tenant administrator, I want to have event capture use existing trusted boundaries and accessible recovery, so that safe recording remains maintainable through outages and upgrades.

acceptance.text: Real roles, native revoked sessions, pools, all exposed APIs, workers and restore preserve source identity, immutable original facts and current disclosure.
Closing after submit does not claim cancellation; the user can recover the original outcome, while canceling unsent input remains inert.
No private-body fetching, persistent restricted offline queue, demo fallback or inferred historic-event backfill is added.
Whole-journey, native concurrency, mixed-version and intended-user evidence qualifies each actual event producer before activation.

For Database grant/RLS/function/Storage tests under real roles, Exercise old/resulting-row reparenting, actor forgery, broad permissive policy, view/definer/worker/REST/GraphQL/RPC bypass, pools and zero-row result.
For Privacy projection/cache/export/log tests, Names/counts/reasons/evidence/current result and late responses do not cross actual audience/scope; no private body/URL/token in logs.

For Mixed-version, legacy and rollout qualification, Both compatibility directions, unsupported meaning, source rename, actor deletion, feature disable and old snapshot preserve history/current controls; no guessed backfill.

For Trace and operating-readiness record, Every C/P ID maps to source requirement/design/task/test/release evidence; owners, finite deadlines, capable repair and monitor responses exist before activation.

requirements.title: Complete the representative native partner-document journey
requirements.text: As an authorized source staff member, I want to collect and review a partner document through native Asym commands, so that the complete ordinary path works before optional coordination.

acceptance.text: With Workflow Studio unavailable, one real source-qualified request proceeds through recipient confirmation, receipt, checking, exact review, source fulfillment and independent partner handoff without fabricated legal approval.
Every ratified optional cardinality and correction remains available in eligible states; the one-document example does not hardcode a one-item product.
GF drafts remain evidence to map, not an approved policy, installed tenant template or permission to collect or dispose.
A repeated optional Workflow call recovers the same source effect rather than duplicating requests, notices, tasks, acceptance or handoff.

Pin GEN-05/06/BP-11 and actual source binding; prove no signature/organization/partner/financial side effect from collection or acceptance. Test strongest alternatives and explicit applicability limits.
Every actual class/copy has approved applicable source/version/trigger/bounds/hold/mode or explicit blocked action. Test unknown/conflicting/changed policy and no fabricated historic/default values.
Run complete native journey with Studio unavailable. Repeated/late coordination receives exact source receipts once; one-item finish cannot complete other items or partner workflow.
Use real permitted and forbidden roles/sessions, profileless/wrong-account/forwarded/shared-address cases, role departure and tenant switching; no generic service/NHI/profile/default bypass.

Exercise immutable targets, byte/type validation, limits, scanner/preview failures, original/rendition full/HEAD/range/conditional reads, expired upload grants and exact weak-network resume. Race source admission/reference protection with cleanup and late admitted writers/processing: deletion-claimed input/output cannot be newly admitted or promoted; expiry alone does not prove writer closure. No overwrite, cross-scope read or public fallback.
Race new revision, withdrawal, cancellation, other review and requirement-set changes against accept/fulfillment; one coherent source result with correct original attribution and complete predicates.

Cover Q46–Q60 branches including staff supply, recipient replacement and post-acceptance remediation. Prove receipt/F/access clocks never reset by navigation/retry and terminal work is not silently reopened.

Fault between every authoritative write/result/outbox/provider step; lose responses and replay via another transport key; recover original outcome and repair actual handoff/notice without duplicating effects. Test changed intent under the same key, complete semantic no-op versus real equal-display correction, stale ABA basis and expired unverifiable intent; none creates false success or fresh authority.

Inspect effective PUBLIC/named/default/inherited schema/table/column/sequence/EXECUTE grants, overloads, function owner/search_path, ENABLE/FORCE/BYPASS/service behavior, policy composition, trigger-adjusted rows, views/materializations and deployed access paths. Run actual-role SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/RETURNING/UPSERT/MERGE, REST/GraphQL/direct/RPC/Storage/worker/import/legacy/operator cases. Reject tenant/source/actor/policy reparenting and immutable-history edits; prove trusted app/DB context agreement, missing/mismatch denial and pooled success/error/cancel/retry reset.
Shared bytes with different source obligations, duplicate names/digests and independent private uses remain distinct; ending one use cannot corrupt another's evidence or disclose it.

Test metadata/count/search/history/notification/export/log/cache and original-result disclosure under current field rights. Business history, security evidence and technical telemetry have distinct accurate purposes and retention.
Execute Q63's full current-admission, hold/writer/Stop/unknown-copy/provider/restore suite for actual source/adapter. Retain per-copy outcomes and no DB-only deletion/recovery claim.
Actual permitted operator resolves missing reviewer/policy/binding and reconciliation failures using supported commands; no empty queue masquerades as recovery or routine direct SQL.
Actual census and guarded adoption preserve old reliance/history; old/new readers/writers and kill/roll-forward/restore cannot bypass current restrictions or manufacture policy/approval.

Real staff and external participant tasks, including wrong-account, correction, review scope, failure/recovery and policy-summary comprehension, plus keyboard/AT/touch/reflow/RTL/long names. Agent walkthroughs are labeled separately.

Measure B01–B04 with declared workloads/units, indexed set-wise current checks and stable unique pagination with current per-page projection. Preserve the actual P12 R6 logical governance-read/ledger-write bound, its written physical-shard carve-out and restricted unstriped pre-egress/uniformity rules. Test boundary/over-bound cases, tenant skew/fairness and operational recovery without removing authorization; do not substitute borrowed example quotas.
